instructions: Preheat oven to 190-200Â°C (375-400Â°F) | Line a 20cm pie dish with baking paper | Place 1 sheet of puff pastry over the paper and trim the edges | Place diced bacon, sliced mushrooms, tomato, and diced onion evenly in the pastry case | Season with black pepper | Crack the eggs over the filling, spacing them evenly | Top the pie with the remaining sheet of puff pastry | Trim and crimp the edges to seal | Glaze the top of the pie with milk | Cut a small vent in the center of the pie to allow steam to escape | Bake for 20-25 minutes until the pastry is golden brown | Let cool for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1/2 cup bulgur wheat, 1 cup hot water, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes (with juice), 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 medium onions (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp ground cumin, 1 tbsp chili powder, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 2 green bell peppers (diced), 1 cup corn kernels (fresh or frozen), 1 can (400g) black beans (drained and rinsed), 1 can (400g) red kidney beans (drained and rinsed), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped)
instructions: Place bulgur wheat, hot water, and about 1 cup of the juice from the canned tomatoes in a small saucepan | Cover and bring to a boil over high heat, then lower the heat and simmer gently until the bulgur is cooked but still chewy | Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat | SautÃ© diced onions, minced garlic, cumin, chili powder, and cayenne until the onions are soft | Stir in diced bell peppers and sautÃ© for 2 to 3 minutes more | Chop the canned tomatoes if using whole, then add them to the pan with their remaining juice | Stir in corn, black beans, and kidney beans â€” heat thoroughly on low heat | When the bulgur is cooked, add it to the pan with its liquid | Cover and simmer for a few minutes for the flavors to meld | Add salt to taste | Serve hot topped with shredded cheddar cheese and fresh cilantro

ingredients: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup pineapple juice, 1 package (85g) lemon or unflavored gelatin, 1/4 cup cold water, 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple (drained), 1 cup cottage cheese, 1 cup whipped cream or whipped topping, 2 prepared graham cracker crusts (9-inch each)
instructions: Dissolve sugar in pineapple juice over low heat, stirring until fully dissolved | Soften gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes, then stir into the warm pineapple mixture until completely dissolved | Chill the mixture until partially set, about 1 hour | Fold in crushed pineapple, cottage cheese, and whipped cream until well combined | Pour the mixture evenly into the prepared graham cracker crusts | Chill overnight or until completely set | Slice and serve chilled

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 1 large egg, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1/2 tsp seasoning salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, 2 tbsp olive oil. For sauce: 1/2 cup grape jelly, 1/2 cup plum jam, 1/2 cup chili sauce, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Mix ground beef, egg, diced onion, seasoning salt, pepper, and breadcrumbs together | If the mixture falls apart easily, add more breadcrumbs; if too dry, add a bit of water | Form into walnut-sized balls (about 25 meatballs) | Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat | SautÃ© the meatballs, turning as needed, until browned on both sides and cooked through â€” set aside | In a crock pot on high setting, combine grape jelly, plum jam, chili sauce, diced tomatoes, ginger, and pepper â€” mix well | Add the meatballs to the sauce and simmer on high for at least 1 hour (more is better), stirring occasionally | Serve over white rice as a main dish or with toothpicks as an appetizer

ingredients: For batter: 3 large eggs, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup powdered sugar, 1/2 cup margarine, 1/4 cup shortening, pinch of salt. For filling: 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp margarine, 1 tsp vegetable oil, 2 tbsp pineapple juice, pinch of salt, 1 egg white. For topping: red sugar, peach gelatin powder, 1/4 cup vermouth
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Make the batter: mix all batter ingredients together except the flour â€” beat well | Blend in the flour until a smooth dough forms | Shape dough into balls about 1 to 1 1/4 inches in size | Place on ungreased cookie sheets and bake until golden brown, about 8 to 10 minutes | Once completely cooled, use a very sharp paring knife to carefully scoop out the center of each cookie | Make the filling: beat together sugar, margarine, and oil until smooth | Beat in pineapple juice, salt, and egg white | Fill each cookie with the filling, slightly underfilling but leaving some filling on the edges to act as glue | Press two cookies of similar size together to form a peach shape | Pour vermouth into a small bowl | Mix together red sugar and peach gelatin powder on a plate | Dip each assembled cookie in vermouth briefly, then roll in the sugar mixture to coat | Let dry for 3 hours before serving

ingredients: 300g dried small white beans (cooked until tender), 1 carrot (diced), 2 cloves, 1 bouquet garni, 1 tsp paprika, 2 pimientos (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), For dressing: 2 red onions (diced), 10 cl chicken or vegetable broth, 1 pinch pimento, 1 tbsp Xeres vinegar, 2 tbsp olive oil. For tomato sauce: 2 fresh tomatoes (thinly sliced), salt and pepper, 1 pinch pimento, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1 shallot (minced), 1 tbsp olive oil. For duck: 2 confit duck legs (skin removed, meat shredded), 2 slices fresh foie gras, butter for frying, fresh parsley
instructions: Cook the white beans with diced carrot, cloves, bouquet garni, pepper, paprika, pimientos, and garlic until tender â€” drain and remove aromatic herbs, reserving the beans | Make the dressing: in a jar, mix diced red onions with chicken or vegetable broth, pimento, Xeres vinegar, and olive oil â€” set aside | Make the tomato sauce: place thinly sliced tomatoes on a plate and season with salt, pepper, pimento, minced garlic, shallot, and olive oil â€” set aside | Remove skin from the confit duck legs and shred the meat | Poach the duck meat for 2 minutes in a small amount of water â€” drain and set aside | Fry fresh slices of foie gras in butter for 1-2 minutes per side â€” season with salt and pepper | Warm the white beans in their stock for about 2 minutes, then strain | Toss the beans with the fresh tomato mixture | Place the bean mixture in the center of each plate | Top with shredded duck meat and a slice of seared foie gras | Sprinkle with fresh parsley | Drizzle the red onion dressing around the plate

ingredients: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 2 medium onions (diced), 2 celery ribs (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 500g ground veal or beef, 250g ground pork, 100g pancetta or thick bacon (diced), 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1 cup dry white wine, 1 tbsp fresh thyme leaves, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a 6 to 8-quart heavy-bottomed pot, heat olive oil over medium heat until hot | Add diced onions, celery, carrots, and garlic â€” cook until the vegetables are translucent but not browned, about 5 minutes | Add ground veal, ground pork, and diced pancetta | Increase heat to high and brown the meat, stirring frequently | Add tomato paste, milk, wine, and thyme | Bring just to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until thick and rich, stirring occasionally | Season with salt and pepper | Remove from heat and let cool if not using immediately | The sauce can be refrigerated for up to 2 days or frozen for up to 1 month | Serve over pasta with grated Parmesan

ingredients: For marinade: 3 tbsp canola oil, 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground pepper, 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 2 green onions (sliced), 2 tbsp fresh lime juice. For fish: 4 swordfish steaks (about 150g each), 2 tbsp canola oil. For salsa: 1 cup mixed tropical fruit (mango, pineapple, papaya, diced), 2 tbsp red onion (diced), 1 tbsp fresh cilantro, 1 tbsp lime juice
instructions: Make the marinade: in a small bowl, whisk together canola oil, nutmeg, ginger, red pepper flakes, salt, pepper, cilantro, green onions, and lime juice | Pour into a large resealable plastic bag | Add the swordfish steaks, seal, and shake the bag to completely coat the fish | Refrigerate and marinate for at least 1 hour | Make the salsa: chop well-drained tropical fruit into small pieces | Combine fruit with red onion, cilantro, and lime juice in a bowl â€” refrigerate to let flavors meld while fish marinates | Heat 2 tablespoons canola oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat | Remove fish from marinade and pat dry | Cook for 5 minutes on each side until the fish is opaque and flakes easily | Serve the fish with the tropical salsa either on top or on the side

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 200g marzipan (cut into 1-inch pieces), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 3/4 cup whole milk, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1/2 tsp almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) and spray a muffin tin with nonstick spray or line with paper cups | In a large bowl, whisk flour, baking powder, and salt until well mixed â€” set aside | Place marzipan pieces in a food processor fitted with the chopping blade | Add sugar and pulse on and off until the mixture has a grainy consistency | Add the egg and process for 20 more seconds until the mixture forms a paste and then turns into a ball | With the machine running, pour milk in a slow stream through the feed tube, then add oil and almond extract | Process for 1 minute until a smooth, thick paste forms | Add the paste to the prepared flour mixture and stir just until the flour is incorporated â€” do not overmix | Fill the prepared muffin tins three-quarters full | Bake for 16 minutes until the tops are smooth and lightly browned and a toothpick comes out with a few moist crumbs attached | Set the pan on a wire rack to cool for 10 minutes | Gently rock each muffin back and forth to release it from the tin | Cool for 30 minutes more on the rack before serving | Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 24 hours or freeze for up to 1 month

ingredients: 2 cups granulated sugar, 2 cups water, 3 cups fresh citrus juice (orange, lemon, lime, or a blend), 3 cups cold water, ice cubes, fresh mint leaves and lemon slices for garnish
instructions: In a large saucepan over high heat, bring water and sugar to a boil, stirring until the sugar dissolves completely | Boil for 3 minutes | Transfer the syrup to a bowl or container, cover, and chill until cold â€” at least 3 hours but will keep for up to 1 week | In a large pitcher, mix together fresh citrus juices, 3 cups of the chilled syrup, and 3 cups cold water | Fill glasses with ice and pour the citrus cooler over | Garnish with fresh mint leaves and lemon slices | Leftover syrup is wonderful added to iced tea

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1 tsp chili powder, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 can (400g) stewed tomatoes, 1 cup water, 1 cup chicken broth, 1 cup long grain white rice, 1 tsp seasoning salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper
instructions: In a large skillet, cook ground beef with diced onion, green pepper, and red pepper flakes over medium-high heat until the meat is browned â€” drain excess fat | Add minced garlic, thyme, basil, and chili powder â€” continue to cook until the meat is fully browned, about 8 minutes | Stir in tomato paste, stewed tomatoes, water, chicken broth, rice, seasoning salt, and black pepper â€” bring to a boil | Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender | Fluff with a fork and serve hot

ingredients: 6 slices rye bread (toasted), 2 tbsp hot mustard, 6 slices orange, 6 slices salami, 6 slices pickled beets, 6 slices brick cheese, 12 slices onion, 6 slices Canadian cheddar cheese, 12 anchovy fillets, 3 tbsp butter (softened), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), gherkins for garnish
instructions: Toast rye bread slices and spread each slice with hot mustard | On each slice of toast, arrange 2 slices of orange, 1 slice of salami, 2 slices of beets, 1 slice of brick cheese, 2 slices of onion, and 1 slice of cheddar cheese | Arrange 2 anchovy fillets diagonally on top of the cheese | Butter the remaining bread slices and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese | Arrange all bread slices on a baking sheet, open-faced | Broil until the cheese melts slightly â€” remove from oven and slice each in half diagonally | Arrange on serving plates, placing Parmesan slices on each side of the anchovy slices | Garnish with gherkins and serve immediately

ingredients: 2 cans (400g each) condensed cream of potato or corn soup, 4 cups whole milk (plus extra if needed), 1 cup frozen corn kernels, 300g cooked baby shrimp, 1/2 tsp lemon pepper, 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 2 tbsp dry sherry or Marsala wine, 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped)
instructions: Combine condensed soup, 4 cups milk, corn, shrimp, lemon pepper, and crumbled bacon in a heavy-bottomed pot | Cook over medium-high heat until hot, stirring frequently | Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, adding more milk if the chowder becomes too thick | Stir in sherry or Marsala wine and simmer for 5 more minutes | Remove from heat, stir in fresh chives, and serve immediately

ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1 tbsp curry powder, 1 tsp white vinegar, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 2 tbsp onion (finely diced), 1/4 cup fresh parsley (chopped), 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 1 cucumber (sliced, for garnish), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, curry powder, vinegar, onion, cinnamon, salt, and pepper until well combined | Add diced chicken and diced celery â€” toss well to coat evenly | Chill for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld (can be refrigerated for up to 2 days) | Before serving, arrange cucumber slices around the edge of the serving dish | Serve chilled or at room temperature

ingredients: 400g spaghetti, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 3 tbsp butter (divided), 8 oz low-fat cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream, 1/2 cup milk, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/4 tsp Cajun seasoning (optional), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente | In a saucepan, sautÃ© minced garlic in 1 tablespoon butter over medium heat until tender | Add cream cheese, sour cream, milk, salt, onion powder, Cajun seasoning, white pepper, and the remaining 2 tablespoons butter | Cook and stir over low heat just until smooth â€” do not boil | Remove from heat | Drain spaghetti and toss with the cream sauce until evenly coated | Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve immediately

ingredients: 400g extra firm tofu (pressed and sliced into 6-8 slices, then halved), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp Montreal steak grill seasoning
instructions: Heat a George Foreman grill or panini press | Press tofu to remove excess moisture, then slice into about 6-8 slices and halve them to make 12-16 pieces | Sprinkle one side of the tofu liberally with Montreal steak grill seasoning | Place the seasoned side down on the hot grill | Season the other side of the tofu and drizzle lightly with olive oil before closing the grill top | Cook for 2-4 minutes until grill marks appear | Flip the tofu and grill for an additional 1-2 minutes until desired crispiness is reached | Serve immediately as a main dish or on salads

ingredients: 1 can (300g) mandarin oranges (undrained), 4 large eggs, 1 box yellow cake mix, 1/2 cup vegetable oil. For topping: 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix, 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple (undrained), 2 cups non-dairy whipped topping (thawed)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a 9 x 13-inch pan | Blend mandarin oranges with their juice, eggs, cake mix, and oil in a large bowl â€” beat for 3 minutes until smooth | Pour batter into the prepared pan | Bake for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean | Cool thoroughly | Make the topping: mix dry pudding mix with crushed pineapple and its juice â€” stir well | Fold in whipped topping until smooth | Spread over the cooled cake and refrigerate until ready to serve

ingredients: 1 bag (900g) frozen hash browns (thawed for 30 minutes), 8 slices bacon (cut into thin strips and fried until crispy), 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup, 1 cup light sour cream, 1/4 cup margarine (melted), 2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) and lightly coat a 9 x 13-inch pan with cooking spray | Thaw hash browns for 30 minutes | While hash browns are thawing, use clean scissors to cut bacon into thin strips horizontally â€” fry until crispy and set aside | In a large bowl, mix together soup, sour cream, salt, and pepper | Add melted margarine and mix well | Add shredded cheese and crispy bacon, then add the hash browns â€” continue mixing until well combined | Spread the mixture evenly into the prepared pan | Bake for 1 hour until the top is golden brown and the casserole is bubbly | Serve hot

ingredients: 12 large cabbage leaves, 500g ground beef, 250g ground pork, 1 cup cooked rice, 1 large egg, 1/4 cup milk, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp dried sweet basil, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1/4 cup celery (diced), 1/4 cup carrot (diced), 2 cans (400g each) tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil | Cut 12 large leaves off the cabbage head, cover with boiling water, and let stand until leaves are limp (2-3 minutes), then drain. Alternatively, core the cabbage head and boil until leaves are tender enough to remove easily (10-15 minutes) â€” carefully peel off 12 large leaves | Mix ground beef, ground pork, cooked rice, egg, milk, salt, pepper, basil, garlic powder, paprika, diced onion, celery, and carrot in a large bowl until well combined | Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Place 1-4 tablespoons of the meat mixture (depending on the size of the leaf) in the center of each cabbage leaf | Tuck in the sides and roll to cover the meat completely â€” roll any leftover filling into meatballs | Place cabbage rolls seam-side down in a baking dish | Mix tomato sauce with brown sugar and pour over the rolls | Cover and bake for 45-60 minutes until the meat is cooked through | Serve hot with the tomato sauce spooned over the top

ingredients: 6 slices bacon (diced), 1/2 red bell pepper (diced), 1/4 red onion (diced), 4 white mushrooms (sliced), 1 cup fresh spinach (chopped), 6 large eggs, 4 large egg whites, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | In a large skillet, cook diced bacon until crispy â€” remove and set aside | Add diced bell pepper, onion, and mushrooms to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes until softened | Remove from the skillet and stir in chopped spinach | In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, egg whites, salt, and pepper | Spray 8 standard muffin cups with nonstick cooking spray | Evenly divide the bacon and vegetable mixture among the prepared muffin cups | Sprinkle shredded cheese over the mixture | Evenly pour the egg mixture over the cheese in each muffin cup | Bake for 20-25 minutes until the tops are lightly browned and the centers are set | Cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then carefully remove and serve warm

ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets (about 150g each), 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp flat-leaf parsley (chopped), 2 tbsp olive oil, salt and black pepper to taste, 1 lemon (cut into wedges)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | In a shallow dish, combine grated Parmesan with paprika and chopped parsley â€” season with salt and pepper | Drizzle the fish fillets with olive oil on both sides | Dredge each fillet in the cheese mixture, pressing gently to coat evenly | Place on a foil-lined baking sheet | Bake until the fish is opaque in the thickest part, about 10 to 12 minutes | Serve immediately with lemon wedges on the side

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 cup chicken broth, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup Romano cheese (grated), 4 oz cream cheese (cut into small cubes), 1/4 cup heavy cream, cooked pasta for serving
instructions: Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat | Add flour and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until fragrant and nutty | Add chicken broth and simmer, whisking continuously, until nice and thick | Add milk, whisking constantly â€” simmer until the sauce has re-thickened | Add grated Romano cheese and cream cheese | Drop cream cheese in by spoonfuls to make it easier to break up â€” continue to whisk | If adding additional cooked ingredients like chicken and broccoli or crabmeat, add them now and simmer for a few minutes | When desired thickness is reached, remove from heat | Add heavy cream and whisk well until smooth and combined | Serve immediately over hot pasta

ingredients: 1 can frozen pink lemonade concentrate (thawed in the refrigerator), 1 can (355ml) vodka, 2 cans (355ml each) light beer, ice cubes for serving
instructions: Let the can of frozen pink lemonade thaw in the refrigerator â€” this prevents the beer from foaming up too much from excessive stirring | In a large pitcher, combine the thawed lemonade concentrate, vodka, and beer | Stir gently (not too vigorously or it will foam) | Serve over ice in glasses

ingredients: 12 tbsp unsalted butter (divided), 3/4 cup brown sugar (packed), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 large egg plus 1 egg yolk, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and preheat to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | Melt 9 tablespoons butter in a 12-inch cast-iron skillet over medium heat | Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until butter is dark golden brown with a nutty aroma and bubbling subsides, about 5 minutes â€” transfer to a large bowl | Stir the remaining 3 tablespoons butter into the hot butter until completely melted | Whisk brown sugar, granulated sugar, vanilla, and salt into the melted butter until smooth | Whisk in egg and yolk until smooth, about 30 seconds | Let the mixture sit for 3 minutes, then whisk for 30 seconds â€” repeat this process of resting and whisking 2 more times until the mixture is thick, smooth, and shiny | In a separate bowl, whisk together flour and baking soda | Stir the flour mixture into the butter mixture until just combined, about 1 minute | Stir in chocolate chips, making sure no flour pockets remain | Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels | Transfer the dough to the now-empty skillet and press into an even layer with a spatula | Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake until the cookie is golden brown and the edges are set, about 20 minutes, rotating the skillet halfway through | Using potholders, transfer the skillet to a wire rack and let cool for 30 minutes | Slice into wedges and serve

ingredients: For seasoning mix: 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/4 tsp dried basil, 1/4 tsp dried thyme. For dish: 6 slices bacon (diced), 4 cups onions (diced, divided), 2 cups bell peppers (diced, divided), 2 cups celery (diced, divided), 3 bay leaves, 500g dried black-eyed peas (divided), 2 tbsp fresh garlic (minced), 8 cups chicken stock (divided), 500g smoked sausage (sliced), 2 cups converted rice
instructions: Combine seasoning mix ingredients in a small bowl â€” set aside | Place diced bacon in a large ovenproof pot and cook over high heat until bacon begins to brown, about 6 minutes | Stir in 2 cups onions, 1 cup peppers, 1 cup celery, 2 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon seasoning mix, bay leaves, and half the black-eyed peas | Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes | Stir in minced garlic and 2 cups chicken stock â€” scrape the bottom of the pot | Bring to a boil and cook, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes | Add 1 cup stock and scrape the bottom of the pot again | Add sliced sausage, 6 cups stock, remaining onions, remaining peppers, remaining celery, remaining peas, and remaining seasoning mix | Cover and bring to a boil over high heat | Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until peas are tender, about 1 1/4 hours | Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Stir in rice and remaining stock | Bring to a boil over high heat | Cover the pot and bake in the oven for 15 minutes until the rice is tender | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 package vanilla pudding mix, 1 package strawberry gelatin dessert mix, 1 1/4 cups water, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 package whipped topping mix, 1/2 cup cold milk, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 2 cups fresh strawberries (sliced), 1 prepared graham cracker pie crust, extra strawberries and whipped cream for garnish
instructions: In a saucepan, cook pudding mix, strawberry gelatin, water, and lemon juice over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it comes to a boil | Remove from heat and chill the mixture until thick, about 1-2 hours | Prepare the whipped topping mix with milk and vanilla according to package directions | Fold the whipped topping into the chilled gelatin mixture until smooth | Stir in sliced strawberries | Pour the filling into the prepared pie crust and refrigerate until set, at least 3 hours | Garnish with additional fresh strawberries and whipped cream before serving

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 cup plain yogurt, 1/2 cup milk, 1 large egg, butter or oil for cooking, maple syrup for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt â€” stir well | In a separate bowl, whisk together yogurt, milk, and egg until smooth | Pour the wet ingredients into the dry mixture | Stir just until combined â€” the batter should be slightly lumpy (do not overmix) | Heat a skillet or griddle over medium-high heat and lightly grease with butter or oil | Scoop 1/4 cup of batter onto the skillet for each pancake | Cook until bubbles appear on the surface, about 2-3 minutes | Flip and cook until golden brown on the other side | Serve warm with maple syrup

ingredients: 400g rotini pasta, 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 1 can (400g) condensed cream of celery soup, 1 cup half-and-half, 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 cups fresh spinach (chopped), 3 green onions (sliced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp dried parsley, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp dried tarragon, 1 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese (shredded)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a very large casserole dish | Cook rotini according to package directions until al dente â€” drain, rinse, and set aside | Dice the chicken into bite-size chunks and set aside | Chop the spinach, slice green onions, and mince garlic â€” place in a medium bowl | Add condensed cream of celery soup, half-and-half, cream cheese, salt, pepper, parsley, basil, and tarragon | Gently mash and combine everything together into a nice smooth sauce | In the prepared casserole dish, layer the pasta, then the chicken, then the sauce | Top generously with shredded mozzarella cheese | Bake for about 30 minutes until the cheese is just nicely browned on top | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 kg baby carrots, 6 cups water, 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried tarragon, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Combine baby carrots and 6 cups water in a Dutch oven | Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until carrots are crisp-tender | Drain carrots and keep warm | Cook balsamic vinegar in a small saucepan over medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes or until the liquid is reduced by half | Stir in brown sugar and butter until smooth and fully melted | Pour the balsamic glaze over the warm carrots and toss to coat evenly | Stir in thyme, tarragon, salt, and pepper | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 lemons, 4 salmon fillets (about 150g each, skin-on), 3 tbsp fresh dill (chopped, divided), 1 English cucumber (sliced paper-thin), 1/4 red onion (thinly sliced), 2 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp kosher salt (plus extra), 2 tbsp olive oil (plus extra for brushing)
instructions: Zest the lemons to yield 2 tablespoons of zest â€” set remaining zest and whole lemons aside | Sprinkle salmon fillets with 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon zest and 1 1/2 tablespoons dill, dividing evenly among fillets and patting to adhere | Wrap fillets in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours and up to overnight | Slice cucumber paper-thin using a mandoline or handheld slicer | Thinly slice the red onion | In a bowl, whisk together cider vinegar, sugar, and 1/2 teaspoon salt | Add cucumber, onion, remaining lemon zest, and remaining dill â€” toss gently to coat and adjust seasoning if necessary | Prepare a grill for indirect heat (gas at 400Â°F or charcoal with coals mounded to one side) | Fold two 12 x 18-inch pieces of heavy-duty aluminum foil in half â€” poke holes about 2 inches apart and widen each to the size of a dime | Grease foil with olive oil and set over direct heat for 2 minutes | Brush salmon skin with oil and place 2 fillets skin-side down on each foil rectangle | Cover the grill and cook until skin is light brown and sizzling, 5 to 6 minutes | Slide foil to indirect heat, cover, and cook until all but the top 1/4 inch is cooked, 3 to 8 minutes | Slide back over direct heat, cover, and cook until fish is cooked through and skin is browned and crisp, about 3 minutes | Transfer foil with salmon to a baking sheet and gently free fish from foil using a thin spatula | Season each fillet with salt and a few drops of lemon juice | Serve with cucumber salad

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 cup no-salt-added ketchup, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 cup onion (finely diced), 2 tbsp tarragon vinegar, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp Tabasco sauce, 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat | Add ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, diced onion, tarragon vinegar, garlic powder, and Tabasco sauce â€” mix well | Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally | Add brandy and simmer for a further 5 minutes | Remove from heat and let cool | Serve as a dipping sauce or condiment for grilled meats

ingredients: 1 kg frying chicken pieces, 2 medium onions (chopped), 3 tbsp butter, 2 medium tomatoes (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 tsp Tabasco sauce, 2 tbsp sweet Hungarian paprika, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup sour cream, cooked noodles, macaroni, or spaetzle for serving
instructions: Chop onions and brown them in butter in a large skillet over medium heat until golden | Add chicken pieces and brown on all sides, about 8-10 minutes | Add diced tomatoes and bell pepper | Season with salt, pepper, Tabasco, and paprika â€” stir well | Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for half an hour until chicken is tender and cooked through | Remove from heat and stir in sour cream until smooth | Serve hot over macaroni, spaetzle, or egg noodles

ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes (sliced into 1/3-inch-thick fries), 8 tbsp extra virgin olive oil (divided), 1 whole roasting chicken (cut into 8 pieces, skin removed except wings), 1 large egg white, 1 cup breadcrumbs, 1/2 cup whole wheat flour, 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning, 1 tsp paprika, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) and position 2 racks in the upper and lower thirds | Slice potatoes into 1/3-inch-thick fries | Place on a baking sheet and drizzle with 2 tablespoons olive oil â€” toss to coat and arrange evenly | Bake in the upper third of the oven until crisp and golden, about 40 minutes | Meanwhile, remove and discard skin from chicken pieces except for the wings | In a large bowl, beat the egg white until frothy | Add chicken pieces and toss to coat | Line a baking sheet with parchment paper | In a medium bowl, mix breadcrumbs, flour, Cajun seasoning, and paprika â€” season with salt | Coat chicken pieces with the crumb mixture and transfer to the prepared baking sheet | In a large heavy skillet, heat 3 tablespoons olive oil over medium-high heat | Add 4 chicken pieces and cook, turning once, until golden, about 3 minutes | Transfer to a clean baking sheet and repeat with remaining 3 tablespoons oil and 4 pieces of chicken | On the bottom rack of the oven, bake the chicken until cooked through and crisp, about 22 minutes | Season fries with salt and serve with the chicken

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut into 1-inch cubes), 1/4 cup olive oil, 3 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp dried oregano, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 red onion (cut into chunks), 1 green bell pepper (cut into chunks), pita bread, tzatziki sauce, tomatoes, and lettuce for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper | Add chicken cubes and toss to coat â€” cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours | If using wooden skewers, soak in water for 30 minutes | Thread marinated chicken alternately with onion and bell pepper chunks onto skewers | Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat | Grill skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until chicken is golden and cooked through | Serve hot with warm pita bread, tzatziki sauce, sliced tomatoes, and lettuce

ingredients: 4 cups whole milk, 1 cup cake flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 3 tbsp margarine or butter (cold, rubbed into flour), cinnamon sugar for serving
instructions: Sift the flour and salt together into a bowl | Rub in cold margarine or butter with your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs | Bring the milk to a boil in a large saucepan over medium heat | Add the flour mixture to the boiling milk and beat continuously with a whisk | Lumps will form â€” keep stirring well | When the mixture is lumpy, cover with a lid and simmer for 5-8 minutes until cooked through | Serve hot in bowls sprinkled generously with cinnamon sugar

ingredients: 5 habanero peppers (stems removed), 1/4 cup dark corn syrup, 2 tbsp yellow mustard, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup white vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp ground cumin, 1/4 tsp cracked black pepper, 1/4 tsp ground coriander, 1/4 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp ground allspice, 1 ripe peach (peeled and diced)
instructions: Place habanero peppers, corn syrup, mustard, brown sugar, vinegar, and diced peach in a blender bowl | Pulse the blender 3-4 times to begin breaking down the ingredients | Add all the measured spices â€” paprika, cumin, black pepper, coriander, ginger, allspice, and salt | Blend on high until completely liquefied and smooth | Pour into a quart jar, cover, and refrigerate overnight before using to allow the flavors to meld | Use as a hot sauce for meats, tacos, or eggs

ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 2 tbsp nutritional yeast, 2 tbsp powdered sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground cinnamon (plus extra for dusting), 2 tbsp maple syrup, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 cups soy milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 6 slices bread (stale or fresh), 2 tbsp vegan butter for cooking
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together thoroughly â€” flour, cornstarch, nutritional yeast, powdered sugar, salt, and cinnamon | Add lemon juice to the soy milk and let it sit for 5 minutes to sour (this creates a vegan buttermilk) | Add maple syrup and vanilla to the soured milk mixture | Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and whisk until smooth | Heat a pan to medium and coat with about 1 teaspoon of vegan butter | Soak each slice of bread in the batter for about 1 minute per side | Cook for 1-2 minutes on the first side â€” meanwhile, dust the face-up side with extra cinnamon | Flip and cook the other side until golden brown, about 1-2 minutes more | Serve warm with maple syrup

ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice, 2 cups water, 1 can (355ml) beer, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1 tbsp dried parsley, 1/2 tsp salt
instructions: Mix rice, water, beer, paprika, onion powder, oregano, parsley, and salt together in a pot | Bring to a boil over high heat | Stir once, cover, and reduce heat to low | Cook for 15 minutes â€” do not lift the lid | Turn off the heat and allow to stand for 5 minutes without lifting the lid | Lift the lid and fluff the rice with a fork | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 head raw cauliflower (cut into small florets), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 2 tbsp pimiento (diced), 1/4 cup pitted black olives (sliced), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1 shallot (minced). For marinade: 3 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp sugar, 3 tbsp olive oil
instructions: Whisk all marinade ingredients together â€” lemon juice, red wine vinegar, salt, pepper, sugar, and olive oil â€” until smooth and emulsified | Place cauliflower florets, diced bell pepper, pimiento, black olives, onion, and shallot in a medium bowl | Pour the marinade over the salad ingredients and toss well to coat | Cover and refrigerate overnight or for at least a few hours to allow the flavors to meld | Serve chilled

ingredients: 1 large napa cabbage, 1/3 cup sea salt (for soaking), 10 tbsp sea salt (for seasoning), 1/2 cup Korean chili powder (gochugaru), 6 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 2 tbsp sugar, 4 green onions (cut into 2-inch pieces), water for soaking
instructions: Wash the napa cabbage thoroughly | In a large bowl, dissolve 1/3 cup salt in enough water to cover the cabbage | Place the cabbage in the salted water and let stand overnight | The next day, squeeze the cabbage gently to remove most of the water | Slice the cabbage into bite-size pieces | Place cabbage slices in a large mixing bowl | Add the 10 tablespoons salt, chili powder, minced garlic, grated ginger, and sugar | Toss gently to combine | Add the green onions and toss until well mixed | Pack the kimchi into a large jar, cover, and leave at room temperature for 1 day | Refrigerate before serving

ingredients: 2 cups rotisserie chicken (shredded), 3 scallions (sliced), 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1/2 tsp fresh coarse ground black pepper, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1 lime (zest and juice), 2 tbsp tamari or soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 3 cups napa cabbage (shredded), 1 tbsp vegetable oil
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat vegetable oil over medium heat | Add sliced scallions, grated ginger, black pepper, and red pepper flakes â€” cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant | Whisk in lime zest and lime juice | Then whisk in tamari and honey to combine â€” turn off heat | In a large bowl, toss the shredded chicken and shredded cabbage with the warm sauce until well combined | Serve immediately or chilled

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 3 cups cooked white rice, 2 cans (400g each) black beans (drained and rinsed), 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 cup salsa, 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped), 2 green onions (sliced), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat | SautÃ© diced onion and minced garlic until softened, about 5 minutes | Add cumin and stir for 30 seconds | Add the black beans and salsa â€” stir to combine and heat through | Add the cooked rice and mix everything together on the stove until heated through and well combined | Stir in fresh cilantro and green onions | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Serve hot as a side dish or main course

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1 tsp dried rosemary, 1 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 cup orange juice, salt to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Place chicken breasts in a shallow baking pan | Sprinkle diced onion, rosemary, paprika, and pepper over the chicken | In a small bowl, blend flour with orange juice until smooth | Pour the orange juice mixture over the chicken | Bake uncovered for 60 minutes, basting often with the pan juices, until the chicken is cooked through | Serve hot with the pan sauce spooned over the top

ingredients: 2 kg beef short ribs, 2 tbsp kosher salt, 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 Spanish onion (diced), 2 celery ribs (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 4 cloves garlic, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 cup red wine, 2 cups water, 4 sprigs fresh thyme, 2 bay leaves
instructions: Season each short rib generously with salt | Coat a large heavy pot with olive oil and bring to high heat | Add the short ribs and brown very well, about 2 to 3 minutes per side â€” do not overcrowd, cook in batches if necessary | Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | While short ribs are browning, purÃ©e onion, celery, carrots, and garlic in a food processor until it forms a coarse paste | When short ribs are very brown on all sides, remove them from the pan | Drain the fat, add fresh oil, and add the purÃ©ed vegetables | Season generously with salt and brown until very dark and a crust forms on the bottom of the pan, about 5 to 7 minutes | Scrape the crust and let it reform â€” scrape again and add tomato paste | Brown the tomato paste for 4 to 5 minutes | Add red wine and scrape the bottom of the pan â€” reduce the mixture by half | Return short ribs to the pan and add 2 cups water or until the meat is just about covered | Add thyme bundle and bay leaves | Cover and place in the preheated oven for 3 hours | Check periodically and add more water if needed â€” turn ribs over halfway through | Remove lid during the last 20 minutes to let the sauce reduce | Serve with the braising liquid

ingredients: 1 medium red cabbage (cored and chopped), 2 red onions (peeled and sliced), 2 apples (peeled, cored, and finely chopped), 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 cup red wine, 2 tbsp demerara sugar, salt and black pepper to taste, water as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 170Â°C (340Â°F) | Core and chop the red cabbage | Peel and slice the red onions | Peel, core, and finely chop the apples | Combine cabbage, onions, apples, red wine vinegar, cinnamon, red wine, and demerara sugar in a large oven-safe pot | Cover and place in the preheated oven for 1.5 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally | Check to ensure it has enough moisture â€” add a small amount of water if needed | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Serve hot

ingredients: 60ml raspberry vodka, 30ml limoncello, 20ml fresh lemon juice, 10ml simple syrup (optional), ice cubes, fresh raspberries and lemon twist for garnish
instructions: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice | Add raspberry vodka, limoncello, fresh lemon juice, and simple syrup if using | Shake vigorously for 15 seconds | Strain into a chilled martini glass | Garnish with fresh raspberries and a lemon twist | Serve immediately

ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles (uncooked), 3 cups tomato pasta sauce, 1 cup water, 2 bay leaves, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 400g firm tofu (crumbled), 2 cups mozzarella cheese (shredded), 1 cup cottage cheese, 1 cup ricotta cheese, 2 tbsp dried parsley, 3 cups fresh spinach, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Bring pasta sauce and water to a boil â€” add bay leaves, oregano, salt, and pepper, then reduce heat to a simmer (sauce should still be a little runny when assembling) | While sauce simmers, combine crumbled tofu, mozzarella, cottage cheese, ricotta, and parsley in a large mixing bowl â€” stir well | Spray the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch casserole pan with cooking spray and spoon in just enough sauce to cover the bottom | Place a layer of uncooked noodles on top of the sauce | Spread 1/4 of the cheese mixture evenly over the noodles | Sprinkle 1/4 of the spinach over the cheese | Pour 1/4 of the sauce evenly over the top | Repeat layers, ending with sauce, and top with Parmesan cheese | Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour | Let rest for 10 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach (thawed and squeezed dry), 1/2 cup feta cheese (crumbled), 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded), 3 scallions (sliced), 1 tsp dried dill weed, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 can refrigerated pizza dough, nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) and spray 15 muffin cups with nonstick cooking spray | Roll out pizza dough on a lightly floured surface to a 15 x 9-inch rectangle | Position dough so the long edge runs parallel to the edge of the work surface | Combine spinach, feta, Monterey Jack, green onions, dill, garlic powder, and pepper in a large bowl â€” mix well | Sprinkle the spinach mixture over the dough within 1 inch of the long edges | Starting at the long edge, roll up snugly, pinching the seam closed | Place seam-side down and cut the roll with a serrated knife into 1-inch wide slices | Place slices cut-side up into the prepared muffin tins | Cover with plastic wrap and let stand 30 minutes in a warm place until rolls are slightly puffy | Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden | Serve warm or at room temperature

ingredients: 1 cup dried black beans (soaked overnight), 1 cup dried white beans (soaked overnight), 1 cup dried kidney beans (soaked overnight), 2 medium onions (diced), 2 medium zucchini (diced), 1 can (400g) tomato purÃ©e, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp chili powder, 3 cups water, shredded cheddar and rice for serving
instructions: Soak the dried beans in water overnight â€” add 1 tsp baking soda to reduce stomach upset | Rinse beans and put in a crock pot | Add diced onions, diced zucchini, tomato purÃ©e, minced garlic, cumin, cayenne, red pepper flakes, black pepper, and chili powder | Add enough water to cover all contents | Cook on high for at least 8 hours â€” can subsequently be turned to low for extended serving | Serve with rice and shredded cheddar cheese

ingredients: 1 cup mascarpone cheese, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 3 tbsp sherry wine, 3 tbsp caster sugar (superfine sugar), 2 cups fresh blackberries, 2 tbsp confectioners sugar, cassis liqueur for drizzling (optional)
instructions: Beat heavy cream, mascarpone, sherry, and caster sugar together until smooth and thick | Divide the mixture between 4 small serving dishes and smooth the tops | Arrange fresh blackberries on top of each dish | Dust lightly with confectioners sugar | Just before serving, drizzle with a fruit liqueur like cassis if desired | Serve chilled

ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 4 large eggs, 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 tsp almond extract, 1/3 cup poppy seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 300Â°F (150Â°C) and grease and flour a loaf pan | Beat butter until very soft and shiny | Add sugar and beat for several minutes until light, fluffy, and whitish in color | In a small bowl, beat eggs and add vanilla and almond extracts | Add egg mixture to butter mixture and beat until fluffy | Alternately add flour and milk, mixing until combined | Stir in poppy seeds | Pour into the prepared loaf pan | Bake for approximately 1 hour and 40 minutes until a long toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean | Cool for 15 minutes before removing from pan

ingredients: 1 cup warm water, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 3/4 cup warm milk, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp salt, 3 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 large eggs (plus 1 for egg wash), 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour, dates or raisins for decoration
instructions: Place warm water in a large warm bowl | Sprinkle in yeast and stir until dissolved | Add warm milk, butter, sugar, salt, and 2 cups all-purpose flour â€” blend well | Stir in 2 eggs, whole wheat flour, and enough remaining all-purpose flour to make a stiff batter | Grease the top, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 2 to 24 hours | Remove from refrigerator and punch dough down | Remove dough to a lightly floured surface and divide into 4 equal portions | Shape 1 portion into a ball for the body â€” place on a greased baking sheet and flatten slightly | Divide 1 portion in half â€” break off a small piece for the nose and shape remaining into a ball for the head | Attach head to body and add nose | Divide remaining half into 6 pieces and attach as paws and ears | Press date pieces or raisins into dough for eyes and buttons | Repeat with remaining portions | Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 40 to 60 minutes | Beat remaining egg with 1 tablespoon water and brush over dough | Bake at 350Â°F (175Â°C) for 25 minutes until golden | Cool on wire racks

ingredients: For streusel: 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup rolled oats, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1/2 tsp cinnamon. For muffins: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp cinnamon, 1/8 tsp salt, 1 large egg, 3 ripe bananas (mashed), 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/3 cup vegetable oil, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners | Make the streusel: combine brown sugar, flour, oats, melted butter, and cinnamon â€” press together with a fork until crumbly and set aside | In a mixing bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt â€” set aside | In another bowl, combine egg, mashed bananas, sugar, and oil â€” mix well | Add wet mixture to flour mixture and stir until just moistened | Fold in chopped walnuts | Spoon batter into each muffin cup, about 2/3 full | Top each with streusel topping, enough to cover the batter | Bake for 20-25 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool in the pan for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack

ingredients: 4 slices bacon (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1/2 red bell pepper (diced), 1 jalapeÃ±o (minced), 2 cans (400g each) baked beans, 1/2 cup pineapple tidbits (drained), 1/4 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp ketchup, 1 tsp dry mustard
instructions: SautÃ© bacon pieces in a skillet until crispy â€” remove and drain on paper towels | In 1 tablespoon of the bacon grease, sautÃ© diced onion, bell pepper, and jalapeÃ±o until tender | In a large mixing bowl, combine beans, pineapple, brown sugar, ketchup, and dry mustard | Stir in the bacon pieces and sautÃ©ed vegetables | Pour into a large cast iron skillet | Place in a 250Â°F (120Â°C) smoker for 2 1/2 to 3 hours until hot and smoky | Serve hot

ingredients: 500g beef sirloin (thinly sliced), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 3 cups broccoli florets, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) condensed cream of broccoli or mushroom soup, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Slice beef into very thin strips | Heat oil in a skillet or wok over high heat | Add beef and stir-fry until browned and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes | Add broccoli florets and minced garlic â€” cook until broccoli is tender-crisp, about 3-4 minutes | Add soup, soy sauce, and vinegar â€” heat and stir until boiling and well combined | Serve immediately over steamed rice

ingredients: 400g fettuccine pasta, 1 medium zucchini (julienned), 2 carrots (julienned), 3 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1/4 cup black olives (sliced), 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions â€” after about 8 minutes of boiling, add julienned zucchini and carrots | Cook 2-4 more minutes until pasta is al dente and vegetables are tender | Meanwhile, combine diced tomatoes, olives, Parmesan cheese, garlic, olive oil, and black pepper in a large serving bowl | Drain pasta and vegetables, then add to the tomato mixture | Toss well to coat everything evenly | Serve warm or at room temperature

ingredients: 4 salmon steaks (about 150g each), 3 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 tbsp wasabi paste, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp sesame oil, steamed rice and stir-fried vegetables for serving
instructions: Mix ginger, wasabi paste, soy sauce, mirin, and sesame oil in a zip-lock bag | Add salmon steaks and marinate for 30 minutes | Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) | Place salmon and the marinade in a baking dish | Bake for 12 minutes or until salmon flakes easily with a fork, basting twice with the mixture every 5 minutes | Let rest for 5 minutes after baking | Serve with steamed rice and stir-fried vegetables

ingredients: 2 ripe bananas (peeled), 8 fresh strawberries, 200g chocolate melts or chocolate chips, 1 tsp coconut oil (optional)
instructions: Line an oven tray with baking paper | Place chocolate melts in a microwave-safe bowl â€” microwave on medium-low for 1 minute | Remove bowl and stir chocolate, then return to microwave | Repeat cooking and stirring in 30-second intervals until chocolate is fully melted and smooth | Dip fruit into the chocolate to coat about three-quarters of each piece | Place coated fruit on the prepared tray | Refrigerate until set | Serve chilled

ingredients: For dough: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 3 tbsp milk, 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour. For frosting: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 cup confectioners sugar, 1 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 1-2 tbsp milk
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy | Beat in egg, vanilla, and milk | Sift cocoa powder and flour together | Mix into butter mixture until thoroughly blended | Chill dough until firm enough to handle, about 30 minutes | Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease baking sheets | Using 2 teaspoons of dough, roll a rope about 12 inches long between your hands | Shape into a pretzel: make a loop about 1 1/2 inches in diameter by crossing the ends, leaving 1-inch tails â€” flip the loop down over the crossed ends and press firmly | Place pretzels on greased baking sheets | Bake for about 10 minutes | Make the frosting: mix cocoa powder and confectioners sugar, then gradually stir in butter and vanilla â€” thin with milk if needed | When pretzels are cool, spread with chocolate frosting

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 2 cans (400g each) condensed cream of chicken soup, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp black pepper, egg noodles or rice for serving
instructions: Place chicken breasts (thawed or frozen) in the crock pot | Cover with condensed soup â€” the more soup, the richer the gravy | Add garlic powder and black pepper | Cook on low for 6-8 hours until chicken is tender and cooked through | Serve over egg noodles or rice with the gravy spooned over the top

ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp gluten-free vanilla extract, 2 tbsp water, 1/2 cup gluten-free all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease an 8-inch square pan | Mix sugar, cocoa powder, salt, eggs, vanilla, water, and gluten-free flour together in a bowl until there are no lumps | Stir in chocolate chips | Pour into the prepared pan and spread evenly | Bake for 25 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean â€” do not overbake | Cool completely before cutting into squares

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup buttermilk, 1 tbsp orange zest, 1 can (400g) whole berry cranberry sauce, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped). For icing: 1 cup powdered sugar, 2 tbsp milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and coat a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with cooking spray | In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt | Using an electric mixer, beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes | Reduce mixer speed to low and gradually add the flour mixture, mixing just until incorporated | Spread half the batter into the prepared baking dish | Dollop half the can of cranberry sauce over the top and gently spread, swirling it into the batter | Top with remaining batter, then dollop with remaining cranberry sauce | Sprinkle walnuts over the top | Bake until golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean, about 45 to 50 minutes â€” let cool for 5 minutes | Make the icing: whisk together powdered sugar and milk until smooth | Drizzle over the warm cake and let cool completely before serving

ingredients: For crust: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted), 1/4 cup granulated sugar. For cake: 1 box white cake mix, 1 cup boiling water, 1 box strawberry gelatin, 1/2 cup vegetable oil, 4 large eggs. For filling: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg. For topping: 1 carton frozen sweetened strawberries (thawed). For frosting: 1 can sweetened condensed milk, 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup sugar, 8 oz whipped topping (thawed)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Make the crust: combine graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, and sugar â€” press into a 9 x 13-inch pan | Make the cake: mix together cake mix, boiling water, strawberry gelatin, oil, and eggs â€” pour over the crust | Make the filling: beat softened cream cheese, sugar, and egg until smooth â€” drop by spoonfuls into the cake mixture and swirl with a knife | Bake for 35-40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Pour the thawed strawberries over the hot cake | Let cool completely | Make the frosting: beat sweetened condensed milk, cream cheese, and sugar together â€” fold in whipped topping | Frost the cooled cake and refrigerate before serving

ingredients: For filling: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 2 cups fresh or frozen raspberries, 2 cups fresh or frozen blueberries, 2 cups fresh or frozen blackberries, 1 tbsp lemon juice. For topping: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/3 cup brown sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 cup cold butter (cubed), 1/3 cup hot water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) and grease a 4-quart casserole dish | Mix sugar and cornstarch in a Dutch oven | Add berries and lemon juice â€” toss until evenly coated | Heat to boiling and boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly | Spoon into the casserole dish | Mix flour, brown sugar, baking powder, salt, and nutmeg in a large bowl | Cut in cold butter until mixture looks like coarse crumbs | Stir in hot water until a soft dough forms | Spoon dough onto the berry mixture | Bake for 35 to 45 minutes until the top is golden brown | Serve warm with whipped cream

ingredients: 4 large corn tortillas, 2 cans (400g each) black beans (drained and rinsed), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 onion (diced), 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 cups mozzarella cheese (shredded), 2 cups cabbage (shredded), 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 450Â°F (230Â°C) | Add salt, pepper, garlic, onion, chili powder, and cumin to the beans â€” warm gently in a saucepan | Roughly purÃ©e the beans in a blender or food processor with a little of the liquid until spreadable | Place tortillas on a baking sheet | Evenly spread each tortilla with the bean mixture, then top with shredded cheese | Bake for 5 minutes, then sprinkle with shredded cabbage and cilantro | Bake another 5 minutes until the topping is hot and the tortilla is crisp on the edges | Cut into wedges and serve immediately

ingredients: 1/2 cup sultanas, 1/2 cup raisins, 1/4 cup glacÃ© ginger (chopped), 1 tbsp orange zest, 1/2 tsp mixed spice, 200g marzipan, 1 cup icing sugar, silver dragees for decoration, 2-3 tbsp orange juice
instructions: Put the sultanas, raisins, glacÃ© ginger, orange zest, and mixed spice in a food processor â€” chop finely | Add orange juice if the mixture is a little dry | Divide the mixture into eight and use your hands to shape them into small cakes, about 4cm square | Dust the work surface lightly with icing sugar and roll the marzipan out to a 16cm x 7.5cm rectangle | Cut out eight stars using a 4cm star cutter | Drape one star over each cake | Roll out the icing and do the same, draping the icing in the opposite direction to the marzipan on each cake | Decorate each icing star with six silver dragees | Store in an airtight box until needed

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 1 cup water, 2 cups fresh cranberries, 1/4 cup crystallized ginger (chopped), 1 cup fresh peaches (peeled and diced)
instructions: Stir sugar and 1 cup water in a heavy medium saucepan over high heat until the sugar dissolves and the syrup comes to a boil | Add cranberries and return mixture to a boil | Reduce heat to medium and simmer until cranberries burst and the sauce thickens slightly, about 10 minutes | Remove from heat and stir in chopped crystallized ginger â€” let stand for 5 minutes | Mix in diced peaches | Cool completely | Chill at least 2 hours and up to 3 days | Freezes well in an airtight container for up to 3 months | Makes about 3 cups

ingredients: 6 chicken thighs (bone-in, skin-on), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp butter, 1 shallot (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 cup chicken broth, 1/4 cup hot water, 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tbsp dried parsley, salt and pepper to taste, steamed rice for serving
instructions: In a large skillet, heat oil and butter together until hot | Add chicken thighs and season with salt and pepper â€” cook for about 3-4 minutes, then flip and season other side | Continue cooking on other side for about 3-5 minutes | Remove chicken from the pan onto a plate and reserve | Add another tablespoon of butter, then add diced shallot and minced garlic â€” cook for about 2 minutes until shallots are soft and garlic is fragrant | Add chicken broth and hot water, stirring well with the shallots and garlic | Add mirin, fish sauce, oyster sauce, lime juice, lemon juice, and dried parsley â€” taste and adjust to preference | Return chicken to the pan, including any juices from the plate | Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes, flipping the chicken a few times to incorporate the sauce | Serve over steamed rice

ingredients: 500g button mushrooms (cleaned and halved if large), 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil, 3 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp fresh parsley leaves (chopped), 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Combine mushrooms, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a bowl â€” toss well | Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours and up to several days, tossing occasionally | Taste and adjust seasoning before serving | Garnish with fresh chopped parsley and serve at room temperature

ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil, 3 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tsp hot paprika, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp Creole mustard, 2 tbsp celery (finely diced)
instructions: PurÃ©e all ingredients in a blender until smooth | Chill for at least 1 hour before serving | Serve cold with peel-and-eat shrimp

ingredients: 4 center-cut pork chops, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp butter, 1 medium onion (sliced), 1 apple (peeled and sliced), 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce, 1/4 cup apple juice, 1/2 cup beef broth, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp curry powder, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Season pork chops with salt and pepper â€” brown both sides in a skillet with olive oil | Remove chops to a 9 x 13-inch baking dish | In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat | Cook and stir sliced onions and apples in butter until caramelized, stirring up the browned bits | Stir in applesauce, apple juice, beef broth, minced garlic, and curry powder | Season to taste with salt and pepper â€” simmer on low heat until slightly thickened | Pour the apple-onion mixture over the chops in the baking dish and cover with foil | Bake for 45 minutes until the pork is tender | Serve hot

ingredients: 4 yellow sweet peppers (quartered, seeds removed), 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 3 cups vegetable broth, 1 medium sweet potato (peeled and diced), 1/4 cup fresh basil (chopped), 1 tbsp white wine vinegar, grape tomatoes and fresh basil for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) | Quarter peppers and remove stems, seeds, and white membranes | Place peppers cut-side down on a foil-lined baking sheet | Roast until skins are blistered and dark, about 20 minutes | Remove from oven, enclose peppers in the foil, and let stand for 15 minutes | Pull skins off the peppers and discard â€” set peppers aside | Cook diced onion and minced garlic in olive oil in a medium saucepan for 5 minutes until tender | Stir in roasted peppers, vegetable broth, and diced sweet potato | Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until sweet potato is tender | Cool slightly, then stir in basil and vinegar | PurÃ©e the soup in a blender in batches until smooth | Return to the saucepan and reheat | Ladle into small heatproof glasses and garnish with skewers threaded with tomato halves and basil leaves

ingredients: 1 kg beef stew meat (cubed), 2 medium potatoes (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 red bell peppers (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp salt, 2 cups beef broth, warm tortillas for serving
instructions: Combine beef cubes, diced potatoes, onion, bell peppers, and garlic in a large bowl | In a small bowl, mix together flour, chili powder, cumin, and salt | Toss the beef mixture with the flour mixture until evenly coated | Transfer the mixture to a slow cooker and pour in enough beef broth to barely cover the meat â€” if short, fill the rest with water | Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the beef is tender | Serve hot with warm tortillas

ingredients: 12 jumbo shrimp (peeled and deveined, tails on), 12 fresh sage leaves, 12 thin slices pancetta, 2 tbsp olive oil, toothpicks for securing
instructions: Clean and devein shrimp, leaving tails intact | Stuff one sage leaf inside each shrimp (along the deveined cut) | Wrap each shrimp with a slice of pancetta | Secure with a toothpick | Drizzle olive oil over the wrapped shrimp | Grill on a grill pan over medium-high heat for about 4 minutes per side until shrimp is pink and cooked through | Remove toothpicks and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, 2 1/2 cups water, 2 cans (400g each) black beans (drained and rinsed), 1 cup frozen corn, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with green chilies, 1/2 cup salsa, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 cup red onion (diced), 1/4 cup black olives (sliced), 1/2 cup Mexican blend cheese (for topping)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | In a large saucepan, bring rice and water to a boil â€” reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 35-40 minutes until tender | In a large bowl, combine cooked rice, black beans, corn, diced tomatoes with chilies, salsa, sour cream, cheddar cheese, and pepper | Transfer to a 2 1/2-quart baking dish coated with nonstick spray | Sprinkle diced onion and black olives over the top | Bake uncovered for 30 minutes | Sprinkle Mexican blend cheese over the top and bake 5-10 minutes longer until cheese is melted | Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

ingredients: For filling: 500g ground beef, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tsp dry mustard, 1/2 cup beef gravy. For pastry: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 3/4 cup lard or shortening, 1 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 large egg, 1 tbsp white vinegar, cold water
instructions: Make the filling: melt 2 tablespoons margarine in a skillet and cook diced onion for a few minutes | Add ground beef and cook slowly until all fat is melted â€” drain off fat | Add gravy and simmer for 10 minutes | Make the pastry: mix flour, lard, sugar, salt, and baking powder until crumbly | Beat egg in a 1-cup measuring cup, add vinegar, and fill the cup with cold water â€” add to the dry mixture | Mix as you would pie dough and roll out | Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Line small foil pie tins (4 1/2 inches across) with pastry | Half-fill with meat mixture and cover with pastry, crimping edges | Bake for 20 minutes until golden brown | Makes 24 pies â€” freezes well

ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup cold butter (cubed), 3-4 tbsp ice water, 3 cups fresh blackberries, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup butter (for basting), 1/4 cup sugar (for basting), confectioners sugar for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a baking pan | Sift flour, baking powder, and salt into a large bowl â€” cut in cold butter until crumbly | Add enough ice water to make a stiff dough | Let stand for a few minutes to rest | Clean blackberries and cover with sugar | Roll dough thinly on a floured board into an oblong sheet | Spread berries over the dough and roll up like a jelly roll | Place in the prepared pan and bake for 30 minutes | Mix basting butter and sugar together â€” baste the roll and return to the oven | Continue basting every 5 minutes while the roll bakes an additional 30 minutes | Serve from the baking dish, sprinkled lightly with confectioners sugar

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp dry mustard, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp chipotle chili powder (optional), 1 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup evaporated milk, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/2 cup Asiago cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), 2 tbsp tomato paste, 400g pasta (cooked al dente), 1 cup frozen peas (thawed)
instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat | Combine flour, dry mustard, chipotle chili powder, salt, and pepper â€” whisk into the melted butter and cook for about 1 minute until bubbly | Slowly add evaporated milk, stirring to combine, then add regular milk while stirring | Cook over medium heat until the sauce begins to thicken | Add all three cheeses and reduce heat to low â€” cook stirring frequently until the sauce is thick and smooth | Stir in tomato paste | Pour the cheese sauce over cooked pasta | Stir in peas | Serve immediately â€” or optionally top with buttered breadcrumbs and bake at 350Â°F for 10-15 minutes to brown

ingredients: 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 cup whole wheat flour, 1 1/2 cups white bread flour (plus up to 1 cup extra for kneading), 1/4 cup vegetable oil, 1 cup warm water (130Â°F), melted butter for brushing
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) and grease a baking sheet | Heat oil and water together until warm (about 130Â°F) â€” microwave for 90 seconds works well | Combine yeast, salt, sugar, whole wheat flour, and white flour in a large bowl â€” stir until well mixed | Pour the warm water and oil into the flour mixture | Turn the dough onto a floured countertop and knead, adding up to 1 additional cup of flour until the dough is no longer sticky | Cut the dough into 8 pieces and shape into rolls or breadsticks | Brush with water and sprinkle with desired toppings | Bake for 20-25 minutes until rolls are browned and the crust is crunchy (10-15 minutes for breadsticks) | Serve hot with butter

ingredients: 3 cups cooked rice (cooled), 1 cup cooked ham (diced), 1/2 cup small cooked shrimp, 1/2 cup celery (diced), 2 green onions (sliced), 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp curry powder, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp celery seed, 1 tbsp white sugar, 1/2 tsp accent seasoning (MSG), 1/2 cup frozen peas (thawed), 1/4 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions, being careful not to overcook â€” both minute rice and long grain work well | In a large bowl, toss together cooled rice, ham, shrimp, celery, green onions, and peas | Refrigerate long enough to let the peas thaw completely | In a separate bowl, whisk together soy sauce, curry powder, vinegar, salt, celery seed, sugar, accent seasoning, and vegetable oil â€” let the dressing sit for at least 1 hour at room temperature | Stir dressing well and pour over the salad just before serving â€” toss well to combine | Serve cold

ingredients: 6 flour tortillas, 4 hot dogs (sliced into thin rounds), 1 1/2 cups shredded cheese (cheddar or Mexican blend), 3 tsp fresh chives (chopped), 1/2 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 2 tsp vegetable oil, salsa and sour cream for serving
instructions: Place 3 tortillas on a work surface | Divide cheese and hot dog slices evenly among the tortillas | Sprinkle each portion with chives, a large pinch of chili powder, and a pinch of cumin | Top each with the remaining tortillas | In a medium skillet, heat 1 teaspoon oil over medium heat | Place 1 quesadilla in the pan, then rest a small plate on top to weigh it down â€” cook for about 2 minutes until golden underneath | Remove plate, flip quesadilla, weigh down with plate, and cook until cheese is melted and tortilla is crisp, about 2 minutes | Keep warm and repeat with remaining quesadillas | Cut each into 4 wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream

ingredients: 8 fresh peaches (peeled, pitted, and finely chopped), 2 cups granulated sugar, 1/2 cup peach nectar, 1/3 cup cider vinegar, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 habanero pepper (minced), 1/2 tsp salt, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 cup fresh raspberries
instructions: Wash, peel, and pit fresh peaches | Place half the peaches in a food processor or blender â€” process until very finely chopped | Transfer to a 6-quart saucepan and repeat with remaining peaches | Add sugar, peach nectar, vinegar, lemon juice, habanero pepper, salt, and garlic to the pot | Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes until desired consistency, stirring occasionally | Remove from heat and stir in raspberries | Ladle hot sauce into prepared jars leaving 1/4-inch headspace | Process in a boiling water bath for 15 minutes | Serve with broiled, roasted, or grilled poultry, pork, or ham

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1 ring smoked sausage (sliced), 3 medium new potatoes (cubed), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1 small head green cabbage (quartered and separated), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper
instructions: In a very large skillet, place ground beef and sliced sausage | Top with cubed potatoes, diced bell pepper, diced onion, salt, and pepper | Quarter the cabbage and separate the leaves â€” place on top of the other ingredients | Cover and cook over medium heat for about 30-40 minutes â€” do not lift the lid for 30 minutes | Test potatoes for doneness â€” add more time if needed | The drippings from the sausage and beef will steam and flavor the vegetables | Use a large slotted spoon to serve

ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese, 2 large eggs, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, vegetable oil for frying, powdered sugar for dusting
instructions: Mix ricotta, eggs, sugar, salt, and vanilla together in a bowl until smooth | Slowly incorporate the flour, mixing until a soft dough forms | Pick up small portions of dough and form into doughnut shapes | Heat vegetable oil in a deep pot to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Fry doughnuts in batches until golden brown on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side | Drain on paper towels | Dust generously with powdered sugar and serve warm

ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter (melted), 2 cups granulated sugar, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 4 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup pecans (chopped), 1/4 tsp salt, 2 cups mini marshmallows, 1 can chocolate frosting
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan in the oven | Mix sugar, flour, cocoa powder, eggs, vanilla, pecans, and salt together in a bowl | Add melted butter and stir well | Pour batter into the same 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 30 minutes | When done, place mini marshmallows on top of hot brownies about 2 inches apart and return to the oven until marshmallows are melted | Remove from oven and immediately spread frosting over the top, blending with the melted marshmallows until smooth | Cool before cutting into squares

ingredients: 2 large eggs, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/3 cup vegetable oil, 1 cup unsweetened applesauce, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup raisins, brown sugar for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) and prepare muffin pans with paper liners | Beat eggs slightly, then add sugar, oil, and applesauce â€” beat thoroughly | Add flour, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, and salt â€” blend until just combined | Stir in raisins | Spoon batter into prepared pans and sprinkle with brown sugar | Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1 can (400g) Rotel tomatoes with chilies, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with basil, oregano, and garlic, 1/2 medium onion (roughly chopped), 1/2 green bell pepper (roughly chopped), fresh cilantro for garnish
instructions: Finely chop the onion and green pepper | Combine all ingredients in a blender | Blend on the slowest setting just to mix them together â€” do not overblend | Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with fresh cilantro | Serve with tortilla chips

ingredients: 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (very cold, cubed), 1/4 tsp salt, 3-4 tbsp ice water
instructions: Measure flour into a food processor with the regular blade attached | Add very cold cubed butter and salt | Pulse three times with three counts per pulse to lightly mix the ingredients | With the motor running, pour ice water into the work bowl just until the dough starts to get noticeably crumbly â€” do not wait until it forms a clump | Stop the machine, dump the crumbly dough into a bowl, and gather into a ball with your hands â€” squeeze a bit to make it stick together | If it won't form a ball, add a tiny bit more water | Wrap the dough ball in plastic wrap and chill for about 30 minutes | Roll out on a cool surface and follow your pie recipe for baking

ingredients: 1/2 cup feta cheese (crumbled), 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 2 scallions (sliced), 1 can refrigerated biscuits (10 count), nonstick cooking spray
