instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | In a small serving bowl, combine feta, lemon juice, dill, and scallions â€” set aside | Spray ten 2-inch diameter muffin pan cups with nonstick cooking spray | Separate each biscuit into 2 thin layers of dough | Arrange 1 layer in the bottom of each sprayed cup, reserving the remaining layers | Place 1/10 of the cheese mixture over each biscuit in the cup | Top each with the remaining biscuit layer and press around the edges to seal | Bake until biscuits are golden brown, about 8 to 10 minutes | Remove to a wire rack and let cool

ingredients: 500g beef chuck (cubed), 6 cups water, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 parsnip (diced), 1 carrot (diced), 1 leek (sliced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 2 medium potatoes (cubed), 2 cups sorrel (chopped), 2 cups fresh spinach, 1 tsp sugar (if needed), sour cream for serving
instructions: Place beef in a large pot or Dutch oven | Add water, beef base, salt, and pepper | Cover, bring to a boil, and simmer for 1 hour | Add parsnip, carrot, leek, celery, and potatoes | Cover and simmer 30 minutes more until the meat is tender | Add sorrel and spinach and simmer until greens are tender, about 5-10 minutes | Taste and add sugar if it's too sour | Ladle into soup bowls and garnish with a dollop of sour cream

ingredients: 4 medium potatoes (boiled until tender, cooled, peeled, and cubed), 4 slices bacon (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1 tsp seasoning salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender â€” allow to cool, then peel and cube them, set aside | Fry diced bacon and onion together in a large skillet over medium heat until bacon is crispy | Add cubed potatoes and seasonings â€” cook until golden brown, stirring occasionally | Serve hot as a breakfast side

ingredients: 500g boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut into strips), 1 tsp chicken bouillon granules, 1/2 tsp dry mustard, 1/2 cup boiling water, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp paprika (plus extra for garnish)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Dissolve chicken bouillon granules and dry mustard in boiling water | Add minced garlic, Worcestershire sauce, oregano, and paprika â€” stir well | Place chicken strips in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish | Pour the herb mixture over the chicken | Bake uncovered for 30-35 minutes until chicken is tender and cooked through | Drain excess liquid | Sprinkle with additional paprika before serving

ingredients: 2 slices bread, 2 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp mayonnaise, 150g sliced turkey, 2 tbsp cranberry sauce, 1/4 cup alfalfa sprouts, 2 slices provolone cheese
instructions: Spread Dijon mustard on one slice of bread and mayonnaise on the other | Layer turkey generously on one slice, then top with cranberry sauce, alfalfa sprouts, and provolone cheese | Close with the other slice of bread | Slice in half and serve

ingredients: 1/4 cup granulated sugar (for topping), 1/4 cup chopped nuts, 2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 180Â°C (350Â°F) and grease a 23cm square cake tin â€” line with paper | Mix 1/4 cup sugar with chopped nuts and cinnamon â€” set aside | Cream butter with the remaining 1 cup sugar until light and fluffy | Add eggs, vanilla, and lemon juice â€” beat well | Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together in a bowl | Add the flour mixture and sour cream to the butter mixture in alternating additions, beating lightly | Pour batter into the prepared pan and sprinkle with the reserved cinnamon-nut mixture | Bake for 35-40 minutes until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean | Let sit in the pan for 10-15 minutes before turning out onto a cooling rack

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 3 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1/4 cup black olives (sliced), 1/2 cup feta cheese (crumbled), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2 tbsp fresh basil (chopped), 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Mix olive oil, minced garlic, diced tomatoes, black olives, crumbled feta, parsley, basil, and black pepper together in a small bowl | Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes to allow flavors to meld | Serve as a relish alongside grilled meats or on crusty bread

ingredients: For dressing: 1/2 cup vegetable oil, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 packet ramen noodle seasoning. For salad: 3 cups coleslaw mix, 1 package ramen noodles (crushed), 1 can (300g) mandarin oranges (drained), 1/4 cup sunflower seeds or sliced almonds, 2 green onions (sliced)
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, and the seasoning packet from the ramen noodles to make the dressing | Add coleslaw mix, crushed ramen noodles, mandarin oranges, sunflower seeds, and green onions | Mix well until everything is coated | Serve immediately for maximum crunch

ingredients: 400g gemelli pasta, 2 cups sugar snap peas, 1 tbsp fresh tarragon (chopped), 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1 cup ricotta cheese, 1 tbsp lemon zest, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp olive oil
instructions: Cook gemelli pasta according to package directions | During the last 2 minutes of cooking, add the sugar snap peas to the pasta water | Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water | Return pasta and peas to the pot | Add tarragon, salt, ricotta cheese, lemon zest, lemon juice, and olive oil â€” toss gently to coat | Stir in just enough of the reserved pasta water to create a creamy sauce | Serve immediately

ingredients: For cake: 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1 large egg, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 2 ripe bananas (mashed), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp baking soda. For frosting: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 2 cups confectioners sugar, 3 tbsp heavy cream, 1 tsp vanilla bean paste or extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) or 350Â°F if using a glass pan â€” grease an 8 x 8-inch pan | Cream together sugar, sour cream, egg, and softened butter | Add mashed bananas and vanilla â€” mix well | Add flour, salt, and baking soda â€” mix until just combined | Pour into the prepared pan and bake for 20-25 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool completely before frosting | Make the frosting: cream butter and confectioners sugar together until smooth | Slowly add heavy cream, stirring until smooth | Stir in vanilla bean paste | Spread over the cooled cake

ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce (chopped), 1 cup celery (diced), 1 cup frozen peas (thawed and drained), 1 cup Miracle Whip or mayonnaise, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 cup bacon bits
instructions: Drain peas on paper towels or a strainer | Place chopped lettuce in the bottom of a large bowl | Layer diced celery and peas over the lettuce | Spread Miracle Whip about 1/4 inch thick over the peas and celery | Sprinkle sugar and cheddar cheese over the Miracle Whip | Top with Parmesan cheese and bacon bits | Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve â€” do not toss

ingredients: 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup ketchup, 2 tbsp white vinegar, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1/4 cup cold water, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Combine all sauce ingredients in a saucepan â€” brown sugar, ketchup, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, garlic powder, minced garlic, onion, water, salt, and pepper | Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally | Pour over chops, wings, or ribs | Bake at 350Â°F (175Â°C) for 75 to 90 minutes until meat is tender and thoroughly cooked, basting occasionally and turning at least once | Skim excess fat before serving

ingredients: 1 unbaked 9-inch pie shell, 1 1/2 cups whole milk, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup sweetened shredded coconut, 3 large eggs, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and prepare the pastry shell in a pie plate | In a large bowl, combine milk, sugar, coconut, eggs, flour, melted butter, and vanilla â€” stir until well combined | Pour into the prepared pie shell | Bake for 50 minutes until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean | Cool to room temperature | Refrigerate leftovers

ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes (peeled and cubed), 1/2 cup whole milk, 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese (shredded, divided), 1/2 cup silken tofu (blended until smooth), 1/2 cup sour cream, 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | Boil potatoes until tender, then drain and mash | Add milk, blended tofu, sour cream, salt, and pepper â€” mix until smooth and creamy | Stir in crumbled bacon and 1 cup of the shredded cheese | Transfer to a greased casserole dish | Top with the remaining 1/2 cup cheese | Bake for 20-30 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly | Serve hot

ingredients: 3 large eggs, 1 cup light brown sugar, 1/2 cup plain yogurt, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp pumpkin pie spice, 1 1/2 cups gluten-free baking mix, 1 cup sweetened flaked coconut, 1 1/2 cups carrots (grated), 1/4 cup golden raisins, 1/4 cup pecans (chopped). For frosting: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/4 cup butter (softened), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 cups powdered sugar, 1 tsp lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a 9-inch springform cake pan | In a mixing bowl, beat eggs â€” add brown sugar and beat until smooth | Beat in yogurt, vanilla, cinnamon, and pumpkin pie spice | Add baking mix and beat until combined | Stir in coconut, grated carrots, raisins, and pecans with a wooden spoon | Spread batter evenly in the cake pan | Bake until the cake is firm and a wooden pick inserted into the center comes out clean, about 40-45 minutes | Cool on a wire rack | Make the frosting: beat cream cheese and butter until fluffy, add vanilla, then gradually add powdered sugar â€” squeeze in lemon juice and beat until smooth | Frost the cooled cake

ingredients: 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce, 2 tbsp pineapple juice, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut into chunks), 200g large shrimp (peeled and deveined), 1 cup pineapple chunks, 1 cup grape tomatoes, 1 red bell pepper (cut into chunks), 1 green bell pepper (cut into chunks), bamboo skewers (soaked in water)
instructions: Combine teriyaki sauce, pineapple juice, and oil â€” pour over chicken and shrimp in a shallow glass dish | Refrigerate and marinate for 1 hour, turning occasionally | Thread meat onto skewers, alternating with pineapple chunks, tomatoes, and bell peppers | Discard the remaining marinade | Grill 4 to 5 inches from heat, turning skewers and brushing with additional fresh teriyaki sauce, about 15 minutes until cooked through | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (cold, cubed), 1 large egg yolk, 3 tbsp ice water
instructions: Sift flour with salt into a bowl | With a pastry blender or fingertips, blend cold butter into the flour mixture until crumbly | Stir in egg yolk and ice water | Form the pastry into a ball, wrap in wax paper, and chill for 2 hours | Knead the pastry for 1 minute until it holds together | Roll out on a lightly floured board and fit into a 9-inch pie plate | Use as directed in your pie recipe

ingredients: 4 sirloin steaks (about 200g each), 2 tbsp butter, 1 tbsp vegetable oil, 1/4 cup Irish whiskey, 1 cup heavy cream, 1 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp sea salt
instructions: Dry the steaks with paper towels and season generously with black pepper | Heat butter and oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat | Add steaks and cook to your preferred doneness, turning once halfway through | Remove steaks to a warm plate and pour off the fat from the pan | Return the pan to the stove and add whiskey â€” stir, scraping up the drippings from the bottom | Reduce heat and add heavy cream | Simmer for a few minutes until the cream thickens | Season sauce with salt and pepper | Pour the sauce over the steaks and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth, 4 cloves garlic (thinly sliced), 2 tbsp fresh thyme (divided), 1/2 tsp sea salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1 kg Yukon Gold potatoes (peeled and very thinly sliced), 2 leeks (white and light green parts only, cleaned and thinly sliced), cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Place broth in a large saucepan with garlic, 1 1/2 teaspoons thyme, salt, and pepper | Trim the dark green parts off the leeks and discard â€” split the white and light green parts lengthwise and rinse thoroughly to remove all dirt, then slice into thin half-discs | Add leeks and thinly sliced potatoes to the seasoned broth | Heat contents of the saucepan to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce to a simmer | Cook until potatoes are tooth-tender, about 5 minutes | Divide the mixture among 6 individual gratin dishes, pressing down to level | Garnish with remaining thyme | Set dishes on a baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes | Apply a quick spray of cooking spray to the tops and cook an additional 10 minutes until potatoes are done and tops are crispy golden brown | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 cup Old English sharp cheddar cheese spread, 200g crabmeat (drained and picked), 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 1/4 tsp salt, 3 English muffins (halved)
instructions: Mix cheese spread, crabmeat, garlic powder, butter, and salt together in a bowl | Spread the mixture over the 6 English muffin halves | Place coated muffins in the freezer until firm, about 30 minutes | Cut each muffin half into 12 approximately equal pieces | To cook: cover a cookie sheet with aluminum foil and place the pieces cheese-side up | Broil for 10-15 minutes until the top is brown and bubbly | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/3 cup granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 large egg, 3/4 cup whole milk, 1/4 cup vegetable oil. Add-ins: 3/4 cup blueberries, 3/4 cup mashed banana, 3/4 cup chocolate chips, streusel topping (3 tbsp flour, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1/4 tsp cinnamon, 2 tbsp butter)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) and grease a muffin pan or line with paper bake cups | In a medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt â€” make a well in the center | In another bowl, combine egg, milk, and oil | Add egg mixture all at once to the flour mixture â€” stir just until moistened | Stir in your choice of add-in: blueberries, mashed banana (reduce milk to 1/2 cup), or chocolate chips | Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups | If desired, sprinkle streusel topping over the batter | Bake for 18 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup raisins, 1/2 cup muesli, 1/2 cup wheat bran, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 cup plain yogurt, 1/2 cup milk, 1/4 cup vegetable oil, 2 tbsp molasses, 2 tbsp rolled oats (for topping)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) and grease or line a muffin tin | In a large bowl, mix together flour, raisins, muesli, bran, brown sugar, baking soda, and salt | In a separate bowl, whisk together yogurt, milk, oil, and molasses | Stir the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix just until moistened | Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups, filling to the top | Sprinkle rolled oats over each muffin | Bake for 20 minutes until the tops are firm to the touch | Cool for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 4 cups romaine lettuce (chopped), 1/2 cup shredded Parmesan or similar cheese, 1 cup croutons, 1/4 cup Caesar or Italian dressing
instructions: Chill salad plates in the freezer | Place chopped lettuce in a large bowl | Add cheese, croutons, and salad dressing | Toss well to combine | Serve on the chilled plates

ingredients: For mango mayonnaise: 1 ripe mango (diced), 2 egg yolks, 1 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1/2 tsp mustard powder, 1/2 cup vegetable oil, salt and pepper. For skewers: 500g large prawns (peeled and deveined), 2 stalks lemongrass (finely chopped), 4 kaffir lime leaves (finely sliced), 1 tbsp palm sugar, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated)
instructions: Make the mango mayonnaise: place mango, egg yolks, lime juice, and mustard powder in a food processor â€” process until smooth | With the motor running, gradually add oil in a thin steady stream until the mixture is pale and creamy | Season with salt and pepper and refrigerate | Combine prawns, lemongrass, lime leaves, sugar, garlic, and ginger in a glass bowl | Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours to marinate | Thread prawns tail-end first onto pre-soaked bamboo skewers | Preheat a barbecue or chargrill to medium | Cook prawn skewers for 1-2 minutes each side until prawns change colour | Serve immediately with the mango mayonnaise

ingredients: 3 cups rolled oats, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp sea salt, 1/2 cup honey, 1/4 cup coconut oil, 2 tbsp almond butter, 1/2 tsp stevia or 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 325Â°F (160Â°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper | Mix oats, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt in a large bowl | In a small pot over low-medium heat, combine honey, coconut oil, almond butter, stevia, and vanilla â€” heat until thoroughly combined | Pour the liquid mixture over the dry ingredients and stir until everything is moist | Spread evenly over the parchment-lined baking sheet | Bake for 25-30 minutes to desired crunchiness, breaking up with a spatula halfway through | Remove from oven â€” the granola will harden and become more crunchy as it cools | Serve with milk or yogurt

ingredients: 1 bay leaf, 1 tbsp dried parsley flakes, 1 tsp seasoning salt, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp celery seed, 1/2 tsp instant minced garlic, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 450g dried kidney beans (soaked overnight), 2 cups long grain rice, 3 cups water, 2 smoked ham hocks, 200g smoked sausage (sliced), 1 tsp salt, fresh parsley for garnish
instructions: Combine the first 10 seasoning ingredients and set aside | Drain soaked beans and place in a Dutch oven | Add water to cover by 2 inches, bring to a boil, and boil for 2 minutes | Remove from heat and let stand for 1 hour | Drain beans and return to the pan | Add seasoning mix, 2 1/2 cups water, and ham hocks | Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours | Remove ham hocks, cut meat into bite-sized pieces, and return to the pan | Add sliced sausage, cover, and simmer 30-40 minutes until beans are tender | Meanwhile, combine rice, salt, and remaining water in a saucepan â€” bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 20 minutes | Spoon rice into bowls and top with bean mixture â€” garnish with parsley

ingredients: 2 tbsp butter or olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 shallots (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 kg carrots (peeled and chopped), 2 tbsp tomato paste, 4 cups chicken or vegetable stock, 1 can (400ml) coconut cream, 1 tsp fresh lemon juice, salt and black pepper to taste, fresh parsley for garnish
instructions: SautÃ© diced onion and shallots in butter or olive oil over medium heat for 2 minutes | Add grated ginger and minced garlic â€” sautÃ© on low for an additional 2 minutes until translucent, not browned | Add chopped carrots and tomato paste â€” mix well and sautÃ© 1-2 minutes on low | Deglaze the pan with chicken or vegetable stock | Bring to a simmer and cook on medium-high to reduce liquids by about a third, about 25 minutes â€” do not overcook | Carrots should be fork-tender | Transfer to a bowl and blend with an immersion blender or stand blender until smooth and thick | Add coconut cream and continue to blend | Return to the pot and reduce to desired thickness | Adjust salt and pepper to taste â€” add lemon juice | Serve hot with sprinkled parsley on top

ingredients: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 200g porcini mushrooms (sliced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh Italian parsley (chopped), 1/2 cup dry white wine, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 400g dry penne pasta, 1/2 cup Parmigiano Reggiano cheese (grated, plus extra for serving), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat | SautÃ© sliced porcini mushrooms with garlic and parsley until tender, about 5 minutes â€” season with salt and pepper | Add white wine and let it simmer until the wine evaporates, about 5-8 minutes | Add diced tomatoes and cook for 5 to 7 minutes (if using reconstituted dried porcini, add the reserved soaking liquid now) | Meanwhile, boil penne until al dente | Drain pasta and add to the sauce together with the grated Parmigiano | Let cook for 2 minutes at low heat | Taste and adjust seasoning | Serve piping hot with extra cheese on the side

ingredients: 1/3 cup barbecue sauce, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp cider vinegar, 1 chipotle chili in adobo (minced), 2 large portobello mushroom caps (gills removed, diced), 2 tbsp canola oil (divided), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 4 whole wheat tortillas, 3/4 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded)
instructions: Combine barbecue sauce, tomato paste, vinegar, and chipotle in a medium bowl | Gently scrape off and discard the gills from the mushroom caps â€” dice the caps | Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat | Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes | Add onion and cook until mushrooms and onion are beginning to brown, 5-7 minutes | Transfer to the bowl with the barbecue sauce â€” stir to combine and wipe out the skillet | Place tortillas on a work surface â€” spread cheese on half of each tortilla and top with 1/4 of the filling | Fold tortillas in half, pressing gently | Heat 1 teaspoon oil in the pan over medium heat â€” add 2 quesadillas and cook, turning once, until golden on both sides, 3-4 minutes total | Repeat with remaining quesadillas | Cut into wedges and serve

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white flour, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 1 large egg, 1/2 cup hot water, 1/4 cup raspberry jam, 3-4 fresh peaches (peeled and quartered). For syrup: 1 orange (juiced), 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup water
instructions: Grease a 9-inch cake pan | Combine flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in a mixer bowl | Add softened butter and beat together for 2 minutes | Add the egg while the mixer is running, then slowly add the hot water | You'll have a very sticky dough â€” use oil spray on your hands to press the dough into the bottom of the prepared pan, stretching to cover | Spread raspberry jam evenly on top of the cake | Arrange peach quarters on top, pressing lightly | Cover with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour | Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) â€” remove plastic wrap and bake for 25 minutes | While the cake bakes, juice the orange into a small saucepan â€” add sugar and water, stir well, and cook over medium heat to reduce for 7 minutes | Remove cake from oven and brush the syrup mixture generously over the hot cake | Let cool for at least 30-45 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1 quart praline ice cream (softened), 1 prepared graham cracker or chocolate cookie crust, 1/4 cup caramel topping, 1/2 cup pecans (toasted in butter until aromatic), extra pecans for garnish
instructions: Allow ice cream to sit at room temperature just long enough to soften â€” do not let it melt | Spread the softened ice cream evenly into the crust | Top with caramel topping and toasted pecans | For extra rich flavor, toast pecans in real butter until they become aromatic and slightly roasted | Freeze until firm, at least 2 hours | Slice and serve

ingredients: 3 large sweet potatoes (peeled and cubed), 1 Spanish onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 cup pecan halves, 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) | In a large bowl, combine sweet potatoes, diced onion, minced garlic, olive oil, and thyme â€” toss well to coat | Pour vegetables into a shallow roasting or jelly roll pan | Bake, turning frequently, for about 40 to 45 minutes until vegetables are soft and golden brown | Add pecan halves during the last 10 minutes of roasting | Remove from oven and drizzle with balsamic vinegar | Season with salt and pepper and serve hot

ingredients: 2 1/4 cups warm water (110Â°F), 1/4 cup molasses, 3 tsp active dry yeast, 1 cup whole wheat flour, 1/2 cup semolina flour, 2 cups bread flour (plus extra as needed), 2 tbsp vital wheat gluten, 1/2 cup rolled oats, 2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp ground flax seeds, 2 tbsp whole flax seeds, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted)
instructions: In a 4-cup measure, combine warm water, molasses, and yeast â€” let proof for 5-10 minutes until foamy | In a large mixing bowl, combine whole wheat flour, semolina, bread flour, vital wheat gluten, rolled oats, salt, and flax seeds â€” stir dry ingredients together well | Whisk melted butter into the proofed yeast mixture | Add wet ingredients to dry and stir until dough is shaggy â€” add more bread flour if too wet, or a bit of water if too dry | Knead with a dough hook for about 7 minutes (10 minutes by hand) | Turn dough onto a floured board and knead by hand for a couple of minutes until elastic and not sticky | Place in a large buttered bowl, cover with a damp tea towel, and let rise in the oven with the light on for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until doubled | Punch down, divide in half, and form into two loaves | Let rise covered in the oven with the light on for 1 hour until doubled | Bake at 375Â°F (190Â°C) for 30 minutes until the loaves sound hollow when tapped | Remove from pans and cool on a rack

ingredients: 1.5 kg boneless pork roast, 2 tbsp fennel seed, 1 tsp lemon pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 325Â°F (160Â°C) | Combine fennel seed, lemon pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, oregano, and salt together | Coat the roast evenly with the seasoning mixture | Place in a shallow roasting pan | Roast for 45 minutes to 1 hour until a meat thermometer reads 155Â°F (68Â°C) | Let the roast rest for 5 to 10 minutes before carving | Slice and serve

ingredients: 500g fresh green beans (trimmed), 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, olive oil cooking spray, 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat | Combine soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and white pepper in a small bowl â€” stir until sugar dissolves | Spray the pan with olive oil and add green beans | SautÃ© until bright green and brown in spots, about 10 minutes | Add minced garlic and red pepper flakes â€” sautÃ© for another minute | Add the soy sauce mixture and cook until reduced and the beans are glazed | Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and serve immediately

ingredients: 2 cans (200g each) tuna (drained and flaked), 2 hard-boiled eggs (chopped), 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 1 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh basil (chopped), 1/4 tsp onion powder, 8 slices bread (toasted), 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded)
instructions: In a small bowl, combine tuna, chopped eggs, mayonnaise, chives, parsley, basil, and onion powder â€” mix well | Place 4 slices of toast on an ungreased baking sheet | Top with the tuna mixture and sprinkle with shredded cheese | Broil 3-4 inches from the heat for 1-2 minutes until cheese is melted | Remove from oven and top with the remaining 4 slices of toast | Serve immediately

ingredients: 500g asparagus spears (trimmed), 2 ripe tomatoes (halved, seeded, and diced), 1/4 cup olive oil, 2 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 tbsp honey, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Bring 1 inch of water to a boil in a large pan â€” generously salt the water | Add asparagus and cook until tender, about 3 to 5 minutes | While water is coming to a boil, cut tomatoes in half, squeeze out seeds, discard, and coarsely chop | In a small saucepan, heat olive oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper â€” add chopped tomatoes and heat throughout so flavors meld, about 10 minutes | Drain asparagus, arrange on a platter, and top with the warm tomato mixture | Serve immediately

ingredients: For sauce: 1/2 cup fresh tarragon leaves, 1/3 cup fresh chives (chopped), 1 shallot (roughly chopped), 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard. For salmon: 1/2 cup dry white wine, 1 cup water, 6 salmon fillets (skin-on, about 150g each), salt and pepper. For serving: 200g fingerling potatoes (very thinly sliced), 1 cup sugar snap peas
instructions: Make the sauce: purÃ©e tarragon, chives, shallot, parsley, mayonnaise, vinegar, and mustard in a food processor until smooth â€” season with salt and pepper | Refrigerate until needed, then bring to cool room temperature before serving | In a deep 10-inch skillet, bring wine and water to a simmer, covered | Cut salmon into 6 pieces and season with salt and pepper | Submerge 3 salmon pieces skin-side down in the simmering liquid â€” add hot water if necessary to just cover | Poach at a bare simmer, covered, for 8 minutes until just cooked through | Transfer to a platter and repeat with remaining salmon | When cool enough, peel off the skin | Steam the thinly sliced potatoes until just tender, about 4 to 5 minutes | Spoon sauce onto 6 plates and arrange potatoes in a circle on top | Season potatoes with salt and arrange salmon on top | Garnish with sugar snap peas and serve

ingredients: 4 cups fresh or frozen blueberries, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1/2 cup water, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 tbsp lemon zest, 3 tbsp cold unsalted butter (cubed), 1/2 cup whole milk, vanilla ice cream for serving
instructions: Combine blueberries, granulated sugar, brown sugar, lemon juice, and water in a large saucepan | Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer | Simmer for 5-10 minutes until the blueberries release their juices | Meanwhile, combine flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and lemon zest in a bowl â€” mix well | Cut in the cold butter until the mixture is crumbly and incorporated throughout | Stir in milk all at once and mix until just combined | Drop the dumpling mixture by spoonfuls into the simmering blueberry mixture (approximately 6 dumplings) | Cover and simmer for 15 minutes â€” do not lift the lid during this time | Using a large spoon, transfer dumplings to bowls and cover with blueberry sauce | Serve warm with vanilla ice cream

ingredients: 12 large white mushrooms (stems removed, stems finely chopped), 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp onion (finely diced), 1/2 tsp Tabasco sauce, 2 tbsp celery (finely diced), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 cup crabmeat (optional), salt to taste, water for baking dish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Remove stems from mushrooms and wipe the caps clean | Arrange caps upside down in a single layer in a glass baking dish | Rinse and finely chop the mushroom stems | In a mixing bowl, combine chopped stems with crabmeat (if using), diced onion, softened cream cheese, mayonnaise, and Tabasco | Add diced celery if desired | Salt to taste | Fill each mushroom cap generously with the mixture | Add enough water to cover the bottom of the baking dish | Sprinkle each cap with Parmesan cheese | Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until hot through and the cheese has browned | Serve immediately

ingredients: For muffins: 1 large egg, 1/2 cup low-fat milk, 1/3 cup margarine (melted), 1 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg. For coating: 1/3 cup margarine (melted), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) and lightly spray a muffin tin | Beat egg, then add 1/2 cup milk and 1/3 cup melted margarine â€” mix well | Combine flour, 3/4 cup sugar, baking powder, salt, and nutmeg â€” blend well with the egg mixture | Fill greased muffin tins 1/2 full | Bake for 15 minutes until browned | Immediately remove muffins from the pan and dip each in the remaining 1/3 cup melted margarine | Roll in the cinnamon-sugar-vanilla mixture until evenly coated | Serve warm

ingredients: 300g cod fillets (baked and broken into 1-inch pieces), 200g clams (cooked), 200g shrimp (cooked), 100g crabmeat, 300g radiatore pasta (cooked al dente), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 cups whole milk, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp olive oil, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 cup dry sherry, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking spray | Bake cod fillets uncovered for 5 to 6 minutes until the fish flakes easily â€” remove immediately to prevent overcooking | When cooled, break fillets in half lengthwise, then into approximately 1-inch pieces â€” set aside | In a heavy non-aluminum 3-quart pot, melt butter, add flour, and cook on moderate heat for 3 minutes, stirring constantly with a wire whisk â€” do not brown | Add milk and salt and bring to just below boiling, whisking constantly â€” remove from heat and keep warm | Heat olive oil in a sautÃ© pan over medium heat, then sautÃ© minced garlic until white throughout â€” add to the warm bÃ©chamel sauce | Add sherry to the pan in which the garlic was sautÃ©ed, simmer strongly for 1 minute, then add to the warmed sauce | Add cooked pasta to the sauce | Bring the sautÃ© pan back to medium heat and dry sautÃ© clams, shrimp, and crabmeat for 2-3 minutes â€” add cod and sautÃ© for 1 minute more | Add all seafood and chopped parsley to the warm bÃ©chamel sauce and blend thoroughly | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 tbsp plus 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 1 cup lukewarm water, 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 3/4 cup buttermilk, 4 tbsp unsalted butter (melted, divided), 6 tbsp roasted garlic (divided), 1 can (400g) Rotel tomatoes with chilies, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, salt for sprinkling
instructions: Sprinkle 1 tablespoon sugar and the yeast into lukewarm water â€” let stand until foamy, about 5 minutes | Using a standing mixer with a paddle attachment, combine flour, salt, and baking powder at low speed | In a medium bowl, stir together buttermilk and 2 tablespoons melted butter â€” add to the dry ingredients along with the yeast mixture and 3 tablespoons roasted garlic | Mix at low speed until just combined, then switch to the dough hook and knead at medium speed until smooth, elastic, and slightly sticky, about 5 minutes | Grease a large bowl with 1 tablespoon melted butter and roll the dough in the butter to coat â€” cover with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour | Meanwhile, make the chutney: bring tomatoes, vinegar, remaining 1/4 cup sugar, and remaining roasted garlic to a boil, stirring constantly â€” lower heat and simmer until thickened, about 15 minutes, then season with salt | Preheat a griddle or large heavy skillet over medium heat | Cut dough into 8 pieces, roll each into a 6-inch oval, and cook on the hot skillet, turning once, until puffed and golden, about 3 minutes total | Brush flatbreads with remaining melted butter and sprinkle with salt | Serve with the chutney

ingredients: 4 sole fillets or other white fish (about 150g each), 1/4 cup dry white wine, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 2 shallots (diced), 1 cup half-and-half, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup green seedless grapes (halved), salt and ground white pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Rinse fish, pat dry, and season with salt and pepper | Place fish in a baking pan and pour wine, lemon juice, and melted butter over the fish | Sprinkle with diced shallots | Cover the pan with foil and bake for 25 minutes until the fish is opaque | Pour the drippings from the fish into a saucepan and reduce slightly over medium heat | Add half-and-half and bring to a gentle simmer | Using a fork, cut together the flour and softened butter to form a paste (beurre maniÃ©) | Add the flour-butter mixture to the fish drippings and stir until the sauce thickens | Remove the saucepan from heat and add the halved grapes | Pour the sauce with grapes over the fish and serve immediately

ingredients: 500g fresh green beans (ends trimmed), 1/2 cup water, 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/3 cup slivered almonds (toasted), 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice (optional)
instructions: Snap one or both ends off the beans, leaving them whole â€” may cut in half if desired | In a large deep skillet, add water and bring to a boil | Add beans and quickly simmer, tossing frequently, for approximately 3-5 minutes until crisp-tender | Drain beans and remove water from the skillet | In the same skillet, melt butter and return the green beans | Cover the skillet, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook on low heat for approximately 6-7 minutes, turning beans occasionally | Drain off any excess butter | Add toasted slivered almonds and toss beans to combine | Lightly salt and add a squeeze of lemon juice if desired | Serve immediately

ingredients: 450g dried lima beans (soaked overnight in cold water), 8 cups fresh water, 1 medium onion (chopped), 1 carrot (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 vegetable bouillon cube, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (finely diced, for sautÃ©ing), kosher salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Soak lima beans in cold water overnight | Drain and rinse beans in several changes of water to float away as many loosened shells as possible | Place beans in a crockpot with 8 cups fresh water, chopped onion, diced carrot, minced garlic, and bouillon cube | Cover tightly and cook on low for 18 to 24 hours until beans are very tender | Remove from heat and let cool slightly | Meanwhile, heat butter in a skillet and sautÃ© the finely diced onion until very brown and caramelized | Ladle soup in batches into a blender or food processor and purÃ©e until all soup is smooth | Return purÃ©ed soup to the pot and stir in the browned onions | Taste and season with salt and pepper | Serve hot

ingredients: For dough: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tbsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/3 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed), 1 large egg, 3/4 cup heavy cream. For filling: 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1/2 cup pecans (chopped), 1/3 cup dark brown sugar (packed), 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 2 tbsp sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) and prepare a baking sheet with parchment paper | In a small bowl, stir together flour, baking powder, salt, and 2 tablespoons sugar | Using a pastry blender or your fingertips, cut the cold butter into the dry ingredients until it resembles coarse cornmeal | In a small bowl, combine egg and cream, then add to the flour mixture â€” mix until just blended together | Turn out the dough onto a lightly floured board and knead for 1 minute | Roll dough into a rectangle approximately 8 x 12 inches | Brush the dough with melted butter | Combine filling ingredients (pecans, brown sugar, cinnamon, and sour cream) and spread evenly on the dough | Roll up jelly-roll fashion and seal the long seam by pinching it together lightly with your fingers | Cut the roll into twelve 1-inch thick slices | Lay slices on the baking sheet and bake for 12 to 15 minutes until scones are golden | Serve warm

ingredients: 400g penne pasta, 3 tbsp olive oil, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 anchovy fillets, 1 can (400g) plum tomatoes (crushed), 2 cans (200g each) tuna in olive oil (drained and flaked), 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Cook penne in salted boiling water until al dente â€” drain and set aside | Heat olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat | Add diced onions and sautÃ© for 5 minutes | Add minced garlic and cook until onions start to brown | Add anchovy fillets and crush them with a spoon until they dissolve into the oil | Add crushed tomatoes and simmer covered to form a sauce, about 15 minutes | Drain the tuna and break into large flakes â€” add tuna to the sauce with a little black pepper (the anchovies and tuna are already salty) | Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes until the juices evaporate and the sauce thickens | Toss the sauce with the cooked penne | Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve immediately

ingredients: 3 large leeks (halved lengthwise and sliced), 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 bay leaf, 4 medium potatoes (peeled and thinly sliced), 6 cups chicken or vegetable stock, 2 cloves garlic (cracked), 4 slices thick slab bacon (cut into matchsticks), 2 cups bread cubes, 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), salt and fresh cracked black pepper to taste, olive oil for croutons
instructions: Cut leeks in half lengthwise and slice into 1/2-inch pieces â€” place in a colander and clean under cold running water, then drain well | Heat a medium soup pot over medium-high heat with 2 tablespoons olive oil and the bay leaf | Add leeks and season with salt and pepper | Thinly slice potatoes, adding them to the pot as you go | Season potatoes with a little salt, add stock, cover, and bring to a boil | Uncover and simmer 12 to 15 minutes until potatoes are very tender â€” break up potatoes to slightly thicken the soup, then remove bay leaf | While soup simmers, rub the inside of a large bowl with cracked garlic â€” add bread cubes, drizzle generously with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss | Spread on a baking sheet and toast in a 350Â°F oven until golden, about 6 to 8 minutes | Cook bacon matchsticks in a small nonstick pan over medium-high heat until crisp â€” drain on paper towels | Ladle soup into bowls and top with bacon, croutons, chives, and cracked pepper | Serve with crusty bread

ingredients: 4 cups fresh or frozen rhubarb (chopped), 2 medium onions (diced), 1 cup cider vinegar, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup raisins, 1/4 cup dried currants, 2 tbsp crystallized ginger (chopped), 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1 tsp curry powder
instructions: In a large stainless steel saucepan, combine rhubarb, onions, vinegar, both sugars, raisins, currants, ginger, salt, cinnamon, cloves, and curry powder | Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer | Cook uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring frequently, until thickened | Remove from heat and allow to cool to room temperature â€” makes about 8 cups | To freeze: allow to cool completely, spoon into containers, and freeze for up to 1 year | Serve as a condiment with roasted meats or cheese

ingredients: For biscuits: 2 cups Bisquick mix, 1/2 cup soy milk. For gravy: 3 tbsp vegan butter, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 cups water, 1 tbsp vegetable bouillon, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1 tbsp Bragg's amino acids or soy sauce, 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water
instructions: Make the biscuits: combine Bisquick mix and soy milk â€” stir until a soft dough forms | Bake at 450Â°F (230Â°C) for 8 minutes until golden | Meanwhile, melt vegan butter in a skillet and cook diced onion until translucent | While onion cooks, dissolve vegetable bouillon in water and add garlic powder, black pepper, and Bragg's â€” set aside | When onion is done, stir in flour and gradually add the water mixture to form the gravy | Add the cornstarch slurry and stir until the gravy thickens | Pour gravy over warm biscuits and serve immediately

ingredients: 500g red snapper fillets (cut into bite-size pieces), 1 carrot (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 medium tomatoes (diced), 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp dried basil, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 cup chicken broth, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1 cup couscous, 1 tbsp garlic butter
instructions: SautÃ© diced onions, carrots, and bell pepper in olive oil over medium-high heat for approximately 10 minutes | Cut snapper into bite-size pieces and add to the pan with diced tomatoes, salt, pepper, and basil | Stir well, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes | Prepare couscous: bring chicken broth, crushed red pepper flakes, and garlic butter to a boil in a saucepan â€” add couscous, cover, and remove from heat | Let stand for 5 minutes | Fluff couscous with a fork and place on plates | Serve the snapper mixture over the couscous

ingredients: 3 ripe plantains (yellow with black spots), cooking spray, pinch of salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450Â°F (230Â°C) and coat a nonstick cookie sheet with cooking spray | Cut the ends off the plantains and peel | Slice each plantain on the diagonal into 1/2-inch thick slices | Arrange in a single layer on the prepared sheet and coat the tops with cooking spray | Bake, turning occasionally, for 10-15 minutes until plantains are golden brown and very tender | Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and serve hot

ingredients: 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 large yellow onion (diced), 6 cloves garlic (minced), 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 1 tbsp dried basil, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1 can (400g) crushed tomatoes, 1 can (400g) whole canned tomatoes, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with green chilies, 3 tbsp tomato paste, 1/2 cup dry red wine
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large deep pot | SautÃ© diced onion, minced garlic, and sliced mushrooms until soft and slightly browned | Add basil, oregano, black pepper, salt, and crushed red pepper flakes â€” sautÃ© for an additional 10 minutes, stirring frequently | Add all canned tomatoes and tomato paste â€” stir well and bring to a boil | Boil for about 10 minutes and use a potato masher to crush the whole tomatoes | Add red wine and continue to boil for another 2 minutes | Reduce to a low simmer and cook for at least 6 hours, partially covered for the first 3 hours and uncovered for the last 3 hours to reduce | The sauce should end up a nice deep rich red color | Serve over your favorite pasta

ingredients: 2 ripe avocados, 100g white mushrooms (diced), 2 tbsp vinaigrette dressing, 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1/4 tsp salt
instructions: Dice mushrooms and place in a bowl â€” mix with vinaigrette and let sit 5 minutes to marinate | While mushrooms are marinating, peel and pit avocados | Add avocado, cilantro, lime juice, and salt to the bowl with the mushrooms | Mash the avocado as you mix everything together until desired consistency is reached | Serve immediately with tortilla chips

ingredients: 2 large pita breads, 2 cheese wedges (Laughing Cow or similar), 1/4 cup pizza sauce, 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), 12 slices pepperoni
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Spread 1 cheese wedge on each pita bread | Next, evenly divide the pizza sauce between the pitas and spread it over the cheese | Sprinkle on the mozzarella, then top with pepperoni slices | Bake for roughly 7 minutes until the cheese has melted | Slice and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 whole roasting chicken (cut into pieces), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 cup beer, 1/2 cup green olives, cooked rice or noodles for serving
instructions: Season chicken pieces with salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic powder | Place in a crock pot | Mix tomato paste and beer together and pour over the chicken | Add olives | Cover and cook on low for 10 hours (or high for 6 hours) until chicken is tender | Serve over rice or noodles

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1 large egg, 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp water, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 cup provolone cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded)
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together egg, breadcrumbs, minced garlic, water, Italian seasoning, and half the salt and pepper | Add ground beef and stir with a fork until combined | With wet hands, form 4 patties of 1/2-inch thickness | In an ovenproof skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat â€” add patties and cook about 6 minutes until the bottom is golden | Flip the patties and cook for 2 more minutes | Meanwhile, mix diced tomatoes, bell pepper, onion, parsley, and remaining salt and pepper | Spoon this mixture over the patties and top with shredded provolone and mozzarella | Broil 4 inches from the heat for about 4 minutes until cheese begins to brown and beef is no longer pink inside | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 English muffin (split and toasted), 2 large eggs, 2 tbsp half-and-half, 2 tsp butter, 4 slices bacon (cooked until crispy), 2 slices smoked Gouda cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) â€” if baking bacon, place on a rack over a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes until crispy | In a small bowl, whisk together eggs and half-and-half | Melt butter on a hot griddle or skillet over medium-low heat | Pour eggs onto the griddle and cook without disturbing until done â€” when almost set, cut in half and fold into smaller portions | Toast the English muffin and butter both halves | Assemble: place eggs on the bottom half, top with Gouda slices and bacon, then close with the muffin top | Serve immediately

ingredients: 8 large chocolate chip or chocolate cookies, 2 tsp instant coffee granules, 1 tbsp hot water, 1 cup nonfat vanilla ice cream or frozen yogurt
instructions: Tear off eight 8 x 12-inch sheets of foil | In a small cup, stir together instant coffee and hot water until dissolved | To assemble: place one cookie on the center of each foil sheet â€” top each cookie with 2 tablespoons ice cream | Working quickly, use a fork to slightly flatten the ice cream | Spoon 1/2 teaspoon of the coffee mixture over each serving | Lightly press remaining cookies on top of the ice cream | Fold the long sides of the foil so they overlap at the center â€” twist the ends so the packet resembles a wrapped candy | Place in the freezer for at least 1 hour or up to 1 week before serving

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1/4 cup fresh lime juice, 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, and minced garlic | Season generously with salt and pepper | Add chicken breasts, making sure they are well-coated with the marinade | Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours, preferably overnight | Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Remove chicken from marinade and discard the marinade | Arrange chicken in a shallow baking pan | Season with additional salt and pepper and roast for 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 cups whole milk, 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 2 cups powdered sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Mix flour and milk in a small saucepan â€” whisk until smooth | Over medium heat, stir constantly while bringing to a slow boil | Boil until thickened, then remove from heat and place the pan in the refrigerator to cool completely | While the flour mixture cools, cream together softened butter, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract with a mixer | When the boiled mixture is completely cool, add it to the butter mixture and beat until very fluffy and thick | Spread on cooled cake

ingredients: 2 medium zucchini (cut into 3/4-inch rounds), 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 2 green onions (minced), 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, pinch of black pepper, 1/4 cup crushed cracker crumbs
instructions: Cut zucchini into 3/4-inch thick slices | Arrange slices in a single layer in a vegetable steamer | Cover and steam over boiling water until barely tender, about 5 minutes | Drain, cool, and blot dry with paper towels | Mix mayonnaise, minced green onion, Parmesan, oregano, garlic powder, and pepper together | Frost one side of each zucchini slice with the mayonnaise mixture | Crush crackers to make 1/4 cup crumbs â€” dip the frosted side of each slice in the crumbs | Place on a cookie sheet, top side up | Broil about 4 inches from heat until lightly browned, about 3 to 6 minutes | Serve warm

ingredients: 1 ripe plantain (peeled and sliced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 3 slices bacon (diced), 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable stock, 1/3 cup heavy cream (divided), salt and fresh coarse ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat a Dutch oven over medium-high heat and add diced onion, garlic, and bacon | Cook until the bacon is crisp, about 12 to 15 minutes | Stir in the stock and 1/4 cup of the heavy cream | Reduce the heat to medium-low and add the sliced plantains | Simmer until the plantains are tender, about 5 to 8 minutes | Add the remaining cream, salt, and pepper | Mash together until well combined, adding a little more stock if too dry | Transfer to a serving bowl and serve hot

ingredients: 1 box brownie mix (plus eggs, water, and oil as directed on package), 2 cups pretzel twists, 1/2 cup caramel sauce, 1 tsp coarse sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°F) and line a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with parchment paper | Prepare brownie batter according to package instructions using eggs, water, and oil as directed | Pour 1/3 of the batter into the prepared pan and spread until the bottom is evenly coated | Add two even layers of pretzels, covering the entire surface | Carefully spoon the remaining brownie batter on top to cover the pretzels | Bake for 30 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean â€” cool on a wire rack | Spoon caramel sauce over the top in an even layer (if too thick, microwave for 30 seconds) | Sprinkle with a few pinches of coarse sea salt | Let set before cutting into squares

ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut butter, 2 cups water, 500g lamb shoulder (cubed), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 2 sprigs fresh thyme, 1 tsp ground dried shrimp or shrimp powder (optional), 2 carrots (sliced), 2 cups cabbage (chopped), 2 sweet potatoes (peeled and cubed), 1 tsp salt
instructions: Boil water and stir in peanut butter â€” simmer for 20 minutes to reduce, skimming off any accumulated fat from the surface | Meanwhile, in a Dutch oven, brown the lamb in oil over medium-high heat | Stir in diced onion and cook until translucent, about 10 minutes | Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds | Stir in diced tomatoes, thyme, shrimp powder if using, and salt | Add carrots, cabbage, and the peanut butter reduction â€” simmer for another 20 minutes | Add sweet potatoes and cook until all vegetables are tender, about 40 minutes | Serve hot over rice or with flatbread

ingredients: 500g beef or pork (with bone), 6 cups water, 3 medium beetroots (boiled separately, peeled and diced), 3 medium potatoes (peeled and cubed), 1/2 cup sour cream, salt and black pepper to taste, fresh dill for garnish
instructions: In a large pot, boil the meat in water over low heat for 2 to 3 hours until tender â€” remove meat and set aside | Add cubed potatoes and other vegetables to the broth and boil until tender | Meanwhile, in a separate pot, boil the beetroots until tender, reserving the red cooking water | Peel and dice the beetroots and add them to the soup along with the red beet water â€” do not boil after this, just heat gently | Cut the meat into cubes and return to the soup | Serve hot with a generous dollop of sour cream and fresh dill

ingredients: 6 chicken legs and thighs, 2 tbsp English mustard powder, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 cup hard cider, 1/4 cup honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Place chicken pieces in a single layer in a large ovenproof dish | Combine mustard powder, salt, pepper, cider, and honey â€” pour over the chicken | Allow to stand for a minimum of 1 hour | Bake slowly for approximately 1 hour, basting the pieces periodically as they cook, until the chicken is golden and cooked through | Serve hot with steamed greens and mashed or baked potatoes

ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice, 1 can (400g) condensed beef consommÃ© or beef broth, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/4 cup water, 1/2 tsp onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325Â°F (160Â°C) | Place all ingredients in a 1-quart baking dish and stir well | Bake for 25 minutes | Stir and continue baking for an additional 25 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed | Fluff with a fork and serve hot

ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, 200g fresh mushrooms (halved), 1/2 purple onion (sliced), 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 1 yellow bell pepper (sliced), 1/2 cup low-sodium chicken broth, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp dried rosemary, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 cloves garlic (minced)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) | Place mushroom caps, chicken breasts, onion, and bell peppers in a roasting pan coated with cooking spray | In a small bowl, mix together chicken broth, olive oil, rosemary, salt, pepper, and garlic | Pour half of the broth mixture into the roasting pan | Bake uncovered for 20 minutes | Stir and pour the remaining broth mixture into the pan | Bake an additional 10-15 minutes until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through | Cut chicken into bite-size pieces, mix with the vegetables, and serve

ingredients: 8 lasagna noodles (cooked and drained), 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese, 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese (shredded), 1 large egg, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated, divided), 1/4 cup fat-free chicken broth, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 100g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 1 tbsp dried parsley, 2 tbsp red wine (optional), 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 cups cooked chicken (shredded)
instructions: In a bowl, combine cottage cheese, mozzarella, egg, and 2 tablespoons Parmesan â€” cover and refrigerate | Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat â€” add chicken broth, onion, and garlic and sautÃ© until tender | Add tomato sauce, tomato paste, mushrooms, parsley, wine, oregano, and pepper â€” bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally | Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions â€” drain well | Spread 1 cup of the tomato mixture in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish | Stir shredded chicken into the remaining sauce | Spread 1/4 cup of the cheese mixture down each noodle and top with 2 tablespoons of the tomato-chicken mixture | Roll up and place seam-side down in the pan | Spoon the remaining sauce over the rolls and sprinkle with remaining Parmesan | Cover and bake at 350Â°F for 30 minutes until heated through | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 cups old-fashioned rolled oats, 1/3 cup brown sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 cups whole milk, 1 large egg, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 apples (peeled and diced), 1/4 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease an 8-inch square baking dish | In a large bowl, combine oats, brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt | In another bowl, whisk together milk, egg, melted butter, and vanilla | Add the wet ingredients to the dry and stir until combined | Fold in diced apples and chopped walnuts | Pour into the prepared baking dish and spread evenly | Bake for 35-40 minutes until the top is golden and the oatmeal is set | Serve warm with additional milk or a dollop of yogurt

ingredients: 4 ripe tomatoes (halved), 2 cloves garlic (peeled), 1 baguette (sliced into rounds and toasted), 2 tbsp kosher salt, 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Cut each tomato in half and, holding the skin side, rub the cut side on the coarse side of a cheese grater to pulp the tomato â€” be sure to catch all the juice | To serve, place a clove of garlic and a couple of rounds of toast on each plate | Rub the garlic clove lightly over the toast | Drizzle olive oil liberally over the bread, followed by spoonfuls of the freshly pulped tomato | Finish with a sprinkling of kosher salt | Serve immediately

ingredients: 6 large eggs, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1/4 tsp curry powder, pinch of cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp sea salt, 1 tbsp fresh chives or chervil (chopped), paprika for garnish
instructions: Place eggs in a large saucepan with enough water to cover by 2 inches â€” add a pinch of salt | Bring to a boil over high heat | As soon as it boils, remove from heat, cover, and let stand for 10 minutes | Pour off the hot water, fill the pan with cold water, and let stand for about 10 minutes | Gently crack the shells under water to loosen, then peel | Halve the eggs lengthwise and scoop out the yolks | Mash the yolks well with a fork, then add mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, curry powder, cayenne, and sea salt â€” mix until smooth | Taste and adjust seasoning | Fill the egg white halves with the yolk mixture | Sprinkle with paprika and chopped chives or chervil just before serving

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/8 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 large egg, 1 cup whole milk, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 tsp vanilla extract. For topping: 2 tbsp butter, 3 ripe peaches (sliced), 1/4 cup maple syrup, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1/2 tsp cinnamon
instructions: Preheat a large skillet or griddle to medium heat and preheat oven to low (180-200Â°F) | In a medium bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg | In another bowl, whisk egg until frothy â€” add milk, oil, and vanilla and whisk until combined | Make a well in the dry ingredients and pour in the wet ingredients all at once â€” stir until just combined | Make the peach topping: melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat â€” add peach slices, maple syrup, lemon juice, and cinnamon â€” toss to coat and cook for 5-10 minutes until peaches are softened and a sauce forms | Using a 1/4 cup measure, pour batter onto a hot greased skillet | Cook for 2-4 minutes until bubbles form on the surface â€” flip and cook another 2 minutes until golden | Serve pancakes hot with the warm peach topping

ingredients: For filling: 4 cups blackberries, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup light brown sugar, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 1 tbsp dark rum or bourbon, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon. For topping: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup masa harina or cornmeal, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup powdered sugar, 1 large egg, 3/4 cup buttermilk
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) and butter a shallow 3-quart baking dish | Combine blackberries, sugars, cornstarch, rum, lemon zest, and cinnamon in a large bowl â€” transfer to the prepared dish | Make the topping: sift together flour, masa harina or cornmeal, baking powder, baking soda, cloves, and salt | Cream butter and powdered sugar until fluffy â€” beat in the egg | Add the flour mixture alternately with the buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour | Scoop the thick batter into a pastry bag fitted with a 1/2-inch plain tip and pipe over the berries in a lattice pattern | Bake for 25-30 minutes until bubbly and lightly browned | Serve hot or at room temperature

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 200g cremini mushrooms (diced), 100g shiitake mushrooms (diced), 1/2 yellow onion (diced), 2 shallots (diced), 1/2 red bell pepper (diced), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 cup chicken or vegetable stock, 1/4 cup dry white wine, 1 large egg yolk, 1/4 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, melt butter | SautÃ© all mushrooms, onion, shallots, and bell pepper until tender, about 8 minutes | Add flour and cook for 3 minutes, stirring constantly | Whisk in stock and cook until thickened, about 10 minutes | Stir in wine and reduce heat â€” simmer for 20 minutes | In a small bowl, mix egg yolk and cream together | Whisk into the mushroom mixture | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Stir in chives and parsley | Serve hot with crackers or crostini

ingredients: 6 slices bread (crusts removed), 2 tbsp butter (melted), 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded, divided), 4 large eggs, 1 cup whole milk, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 can (400g) salmon (drained and flaked), 2 green onions (sliced)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and butter a 9-inch pie plate | Arrange bread slices in a spiral pattern in the prepared plate, arranging the edges to form a crown | Sprinkle 1/2 cup of the cheese over the bread | Whisk together eggs, milk, salt, and pepper until well combined | Stir in flaked salmon, sliced green onions, and the remaining 1 cup cheese | Pour the egg mixture evenly over the bread | Bake for 35-40 minutes until the center is set â€” check after 15-20 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese, 1/2 cup nonfat milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1-2 packets stevia or 1 tbsp sugar substitute, 1/2 cup ice cubes
instructions: Place cottage cheese, milk, vanilla extract, sweetener, and ice cubes in a blender | Blend on high until smooth and thick â€” the cottage cheese will become creamy and gives it a cheesecake batter taste | Pour into a glass and serve immediately

ingredients: 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 3/4 cup brown sugar, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 large eggs, 2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | In a small bowl, combine flour, baking soda, and salt | In a large bowl, beat butter, both sugars, and vanilla until creamy | Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition | Gradually add the flour mixture, then stir in chocolate chips | Drop by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheets | Bake for about 10 minutes until golden brown | Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes, then transfer to wire racks

ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes (peeled and chunked), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1/2 tsp salt, 200g Velveeta cheese (cubed), 1 tbsp dried parsley, 1/4 tsp black pepper, water for boiling
instructions: Cut potatoes into large chunks and place in a saucepan | Add diced onion and salt | Cover with water, cover, and boil until a fork goes easily into the potatoes | Drain all but about 3/4 cup water from the pan | Add cubed Velveeta, cover, and return to the burner on low heat | When mostly melted, stir gently to combine | Top with parsley and pepper | Let cool for 5 minutes before serving â€” the longer they sit, the better they get

ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 large eggs, 3 ripe bananas (mashed), 1/3 cup vegetable oil, 2 tbsp water, 1 cup white chocolate chips, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan | Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl | Beat eggs in a small bowl â€” stir in mashed bananas, oil, and water | Add to the flour mixture and stir just until moistened | Stir in white chocolate chips and walnuts | Pour into the prepared loaf pan | Bake for 55 to 65 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean | Cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then remove and cool completely on a wire rack

ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 3 tbsp cold butter or margarine, 3/4 cup whole milk (approximately)
instructions: Preheat oven to 200Â°C (400Â°F) | Rub together flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, and cold butter until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs | Mix to a soft dough with milk, adding gradually until the dough comes together | Roll out thinly â€” working with a small piece of dough at a time is easier | Cut out large triangles and roll from the wide end toward the point | Curve the ends to form a crescent shape | Place on a greased baking sheet and bake for about 5 minutes | Brush with milk and continue baking for about another 5 minutes until golden brown | Serve warm

ingredients: 1.5 kg beef roast (chuck or rump), 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried thyme, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 medium onion (sliced), 2 red bell peppers (sliced), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Place the roast in a roaster and drizzle red wine vinegar over it | Season with salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme | Top with minced garlic, sliced peppers, and sliced onion | Cover the roaster and roast for about 3 hours until deep brown and tender, though not dried out | Slice and serve with the pan juices and peppers

ingredients: For dough: 1 cup whole milk (scalded), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp salt, 4 cups all-purpose flour. For fillings: apricot, prune, pineapple, poppy seed, cream cheese, or sausage (see instructions)
instructions: Scald the milk over medium heat â€” add sugar and butter and stir to dissolve | Allow to cool to warm (not hot), then add yeast and let it begin to work â€” add eggs | Put the milk mixture in a large mixing bowl | Measure flour and salt into another bowl and gradually work into the wet mixture | When the dough becomes too thick for a mixer, work in the flour by hand | When the dough comes together and leaves the sides of the bowl, form into a ball and cover â€” let rise in a warm place until doubled | Turn out on a lightly floured surface and knead gently until soft and elastic | Divide into egg-size pieces, flatten, and make a depression in the center with your floured thumb | Fill each with 1 rounded teaspoon of desired filling | Let filled kolaches rise about 20 minutes â€” brush tops with beaten egg mixed with a little milk and sugar | Bake at 350Â°F (175Â°C) for 15-20 minutes until lightly browned | Sprinkle with powdered sugar before serving

ingredients: 4 large sweet onions (sliced), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 cup crushed cracker crumbs, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a 1-quart casserole with butter | SautÃ© sliced onions in butter over medium heat until tender, about 10 minutes | Remove from heat and stir in sour cream | Spoon half the mixture into the prepared dish and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese | Top with the remaining onions and sprinkle with cracker crumbs | Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbly and golden | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 large eggs, 1/4 tsp salt, 3 tbsp olive oil (divided), 2 green onions (sliced), 1 medium carrot (diced), 1/2 cup frozen peas, 3 cups cooked cold rice, 1 chicken bouillon cube (low-sodium, dissolved in 2 tbsp water), 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tbsp light soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large saucepan or wok over low heat | Cook beaten egg briefly, breaking into pieces â€” remove and set aside | Add the remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil to the wok â€” add green onions, diced carrot, and peas | Stir-fry for 2 minutes | Dissolve the chicken bouillon cube in 2 tablespoons water and add to the pan along with cold rice, garlic powder, soy sauce, and sesame oil | Toss lightly to mix well and heat through for 3 minutes | Add the cooked egg pieces back in and mix | Add additional soy sauce to taste if desired | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 cups whole milk, 1 cup GruyÃ¨re cheese (shredded), 1/4 tsp kosher salt, 1/8 tsp fresh ground white pepper
instructions: Melt butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat | Add flour and stir for 2 minutes â€” do not brown | Gradually whisk in 1 1/2 cups milk | Increase heat to high and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium and simmer until thickened, stirring constantly, about 4 minutes | Remove from heat | Add shredded GruyÃ¨re and stir until melted and smooth | Season with salt and white pepper | Can be made 2 hours ahead â€” let stand at room temperature and rewarm before using, adding more milk if too thick
