ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup cornmeal, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 large egg, 1/2 cup pecans (finely chopped), 24 pecan halves for topping
instructions: Beat butter at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy | Add flour, cornmeal, sugar, salt, egg, and chopped pecans â€” beat at low speed until blended | Wrap dough in plastic wrap and chill for 1 hour | Shape dough into 2 logs (about 9 inches long) â€” wrap in plastic wrap and chill for 1 more hour | Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Slice dough into 1/2-inch thick rounds and place on lightly greased baking sheets â€” top each round with a pecan half | Bake for 25 minutes until lightly browned | Remove to wire racks and cool completely

ingredients: 1 French bread loaf (sliced but not through the bottom crust), 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp dried rosemary, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried marjoram, 1/4 tsp garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | In a bowl, combine softened butter with paprika, rosemary, thyme, marjoram, and garlic powder â€” mix well | Spread the seasoned butter generously between each slice of the loaf | Reassemble the loaf and wrap in heavy-duty foil | Bake for 15-20 minutes until heated through and the bread is crisp | Unwrap and serve immediately

ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, 2 tbsp ghee, 4 cardamom pods (lightly crushed), 4 whole cloves, 1 tsp black peppercorns, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp saffron threads, 3 1/2 cups water
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice in several changes of water until the water runs clear | Leave the rice to soak for 30 minutes, then drain and set aside | Heat ghee in a large heavy-based saucepan over medium heat | Add cardamom pods, cloves, and peppercorns â€” fry, stirring, for 1 minute | Add the drained rice and stir-fry for a further 2 minutes | Add salt, saffron, and water â€” stir once and bring to a boil | Reduce heat to low, cover the saucepan tightly, and simmer for 20 minutes until all the water has evaporated | Remove from heat and let stand covered for 5 minutes | Fluff with a fork, transfer to a warm serving dish, and serve hot

ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 4 cups water or vegetable broth, 2 medium tomatoes (diced), 2 cans (400g each) cannellini beans (drained and rinsed), 1 zucchini (diced), 1 carrot (diced), 2 tbsp flat-leaf parsley (chopped), 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, Parmesan cheese for serving
instructions: Lightly spray a 4 to 5-quart pot with cooking spray and place over medium heat | Add olive oil, diced onion, and minced garlic â€” cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently | Stir in water or broth, tomatoes, cannellini beans, zucchini, carrot, parsley, thyme, and pepper | Bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally, and simmer for 10 minutes | Ladle into bowls and sprinkle with freshly grated Parmesan cheese | Serve hot

ingredients: For marinade: 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 green onions (chopped), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp English mustard, 1 tbsp lemon juice. For pork: 2 pork tenderloins, 200g fresh chorizo sausage (casing removed), 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 4 large Swiss chard leaves (stems removed), butcher's twine
instructions: Make the marinade: mix olive oil, green onions, garlic, vinegar, mustard, and lemon juice â€” set aside | Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat â€” add green onions, crumbled chorizo, and paprika | Cook until the sausage crumbles and begins to brown â€” add chives, stir, and remove from heat to cool | Butterfly tenderloins lengthwise and pound with a mallet until 1/2-inch thick | Lay Swiss chard leaves over the tenderloins, covering the entire surface without overlapping | Place a wide line of chorizo stuffing lengthwise down the center | Roll pork into a log and tie with butcher's twine at 2-inch intervals | Place rolls in a shallow dish and pour over the marinade â€” refrigerate for 3 hours | Preheat grill to medium-high heat â€” sear all sides, then move to indirect heat and cook to an internal temperature of 160Â°F (71Â°C), about 20 minutes | Let rest tented with foil for 10 minutes before slicing

ingredients: 1 large Italian or French bread loaf (sliced but bottom crust intact), 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/4 tsp dried oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Slice the loaf into thick slices without cutting through the bottom crust | Mix softened butter with minced garlic, Parmesan, basil, and oregano â€” let sit for a while for the flavors to infuse | Place the loaf on a large piece of foil | Very gently spread the slices apart and spread each slice with the butter mixture | Use any leftover butter to spread over the top of the loaf | Wrap the sides of the foil up, leaving the top uncovered â€” twist the ends of the foil | Bake on a tray for 20-30 minutes until hot and the bread is crusty | Serve immediately with spaghetti or lasagna

ingredients: 4 halibut steaks (about 150g each), 200g mushrooms (sliced), 1 cup cherry tomatoes (halved), 1 lemon (thinly sliced), 1 green bell pepper (sliced), 1/2 cup lemon-lime soda or white wine, 1/4 tsp black pepper, heavy-duty aluminum foil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | Place each fish steak in the center of a 20 x 14-inch piece of heavy-duty foil | Arrange mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, lemon slices, and bell pepper around the fish | Fold the edges of the foil up and pour the soda or wine over the fish | Fold the foil tightly to seal into a packet | Bake for 20-25 minutes until the fish flakes easily with a fork | Open the foil carefully to allow steam to escape | Sprinkle with black pepper and serve immediately

ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (chopped), 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place chopped chocolate and whipping cream in a medium glass bowl | Microwave at high for 1 minute until melted and smooth, stirring once â€” or use a double boiler | Let cool slightly until the ganache reaches a spreadable consistency | If refrigerating, do not let it set too much or it will become a solid block of chocolate | Use to frost the top and sides of a double-layer cake | For a pourable glaze, use while still slightly warm

ingredients: 400g orecchiette pasta, 2 tbsp olive oil, 3 leeks (white and light green parts, sliced), 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 cup frozen peas, 3/4 cup heavy cream, 1 cup Pecorino Romano cheese (grated, divided), 1 tbsp lemon zest, 2 tbsp fresh mint leaves (chopped)
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions until al dente | Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat | Add sliced leeks, season with salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper, and cook until soft, about 7 minutes | Add minced garlic and frozen peas â€” cook for 2 minutes more | Stir in heavy cream and 3/4 cup of the Pecorino â€” simmer until the sauce has thickened slightly, about 4 minutes | Drain the pasta and return it to the pot â€” add the sauce, lemon zest, and mint and toss | Divide among shallow bowls and sprinkle with the remaining Pecorino and pepper | Serve immediately

ingredients: 500g carrots (peeled and sliced), 1/4 tsp salt, 3 tbsp amaretto liqueur, 1/4 tsp almond extract, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water, 1 tbsp honey
instructions: Place sliced carrots in a medium saucepan and cover with water (about 1 1/2 cups) â€” add salt | Cook over medium heat until fork-tender, about 10 minutes | Remove carrots to a warm dish and set aside â€” reserve a tablespoon or two of the cooking liquid and let it cool | Add amaretto, almond extract, and butter to the saucepan â€” stir constantly until butter is melted | Whisk the cornstarch mixture into the saucepan and continue cooking until the sauce thickens | Stir in honey | Return carrots to the pan and heat through | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 kg pork ribs (cut into individual pieces), 1 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup chili sauce, 1/2 cup ketchup, 1/3 cup dark rum, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp dry mustard, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (180Â°C) | Line a roasting pan with a double thickness of foil â€” place ribs in the pan and seal tightly in foil | Bake for 45 minutes | Unwrap ribs and pour off the drippings | Combine brown sugar, chili sauce, ketchup, rum, soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, dry mustard, garlic, and pepper â€” pour half the sauce over the ribs | Return to the oven and bake for about 1 1/2 hours until the meat is tender, turning ribs occasionally and basting with the remaining sauce | Serve hot

ingredients: 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp seasoned salt, 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, 1/4 cup Worcestershire sauce, 1 flank steak (about 750g)
instructions: Using a dinner fork, stab the flank steak all over to create holes for the marinade to penetrate | Combine minced garlic, seasoned salt, red pepper flakes, and Worcestershire sauce in a large sealable bag | Add the steak, seal, and shake to coat | Marinate in the refrigerator for 4 hours, turning once | Grill or broil to your preferred temperature â€” let rest for 5-10 minutes before slicing against the grain

ingredients: For sauce: 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, 1/2 cup dry white wine, 1 cup heavy cream, 3 tbsp unsalted butter. For chicken: 4 chicken breasts (pounded thin), 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp butter, 1 tbsp olive oil, 100g pancetta (diced), 200g mushrooms (sliced), 1 can (400g) artichoke hearts (drained), 2 tbsp capers, 400g pasta (cooked), fresh parsley for garnish
instructions: Make the sauce: heat lemon juice and white wine in a saucepan over medium heat â€” bring to a boil and reduce by one-third | Add heavy cream and simmer until thickened, 3-4 minutes | Slowly whisk in butter until completely incorporated â€” season with salt and pepper and keep warm | Cook pasta according to package directions and drain | Heat olive oil and 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet | Dredge chicken in flour and sautÃ© until golden and cooked through, turning once â€” remove from the pan | Add pancetta, mushrooms, artichoke hearts, and capers to the same skillet â€” cook until mushrooms soften | Return chicken to the pan and add half the butter sauce â€” toss to combine | Place pasta on each plate, top with chicken mixture, and drizzle with additional sauce | Garnish with fresh parsley

ingredients: 400g rotini pasta, 500g spicy Italian sausage (casing removed), 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 1 green bell pepper (sliced), 2 shallots (sliced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 4 plum tomatoes (diced), 1/2 cup beef broth, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions â€” drain and set aside | Brown the sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart, for 5 to 6 minutes until no longer pink â€” remove from pan and drain | Wipe the skillet clean | SautÃ© sliced peppers and shallots in the same skillet in 2 tablespoons hot oil over medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp-tender | Stir in diced tomatoes, beef broth, and the cooked sausage â€” cook for 3 minutes until tomatoes are tender and the mixture thickens slightly | Remove from heat and add the cooked pasta â€” toss to combine | Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with Parmesan and parsley

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 cup light brown sugar, 7 pineapple rings, maraschino cherries (halved), 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp baking soda, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1/2 cup skim milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Drain pineapple and reserve 2 tablespoons of juice | Melt 2 tablespoons butter and pour into the bottom of a 9-inch round cake pan | Top with brown sugar and swirl together with a fork to make an even layer | Place 1 pineapple ring in the center and arrange 6 more around it â€” place cherry halves cut-side up in the center of each ring | In a medium bowl, combine flour, baking powder, and baking soda â€” set aside | In a separate bowl, whisk together melted butter, granulated sugar, eggs, milk, vanilla, and reserved pineapple juice | Add flour mixture in batches and mix until blended | Pour batter over the pineapple in the pan | Bake for 30-35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool for 2 minutes, then invert onto a serving plate | Serve warm or at room temperature

ingredients: 2 cups carrots (peeled, chopped, steamed, and purÃ©ed with 1/2 cup cooking liquid), 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp baking powder, 2 tbsp stevia or sweetener, 1/2 cup plain Greek yogurt, 2 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup liquid egg whites
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) and spray an 8 x 8-inch pan with cooking spray | Chop carrots into 1-inch discs and steam until a fork inserted comes out easily, about 12 minutes | While carrots cook, mix all dry ingredients (cinnamon through stevia) in a large bowl | PurÃ©e the cooked carrots with 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid and Greek yogurt in a blender for about 30 seconds | Transfer the carrot mixture to the bowl of dry ingredients | Add vanilla and liquid egg whites â€” stir until everything is well combined | Pour the batter into the prepared pan | Bake for 30-40 minutes until set | Cool before slicing

ingredients: 1/2 cup roasted cashews (ground until smooth), 3/4 cup plain low-fat yogurt, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 jalapeÃ±o (seeded and minced), 1 tsp ground coriander, 1/2 tsp ground cardamom, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1/2 tsp salt, 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1/2 cup fresh pineapple (diced), 1/4 cup cashews (chopped), fresh cilantro for garnish
instructions: Place 1/2 cup cashews in a food processor and process until smooth, about 2 minutes, scraping down the sides â€” add yogurt and process until well blended, then set aside | Combine diced onion, lemon juice, ginger, and jalapeÃ±o in a blender and process until finely chopped | Combine all spices (coriander through cloves) with salt in a large zip-lock bag â€” add chicken, seal, and shake to coat | Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat â€” cook chicken pieces for 4 minutes per side until done, then remove and keep warm | Add the onion mixture to the pan â€” reduce heat to medium and cook for 3 minutes until liquid evaporates | Add the yogurt-cashew mixture and cook for 3 minutes until heated through | Spoon yogurt sauce onto each plate, top with chicken, and garnish with pineapple, chopped cashews, and cilantro

ingredients: For chipotle spread: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, 1 chipotle chili in adobo sauce, 1 tsp adobo sauce, 2 tbsp water, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp light brown sugar. For avocado spread: 1 ripe avocado, 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh lime juice. For assembly: 8 slices focaccia bread, 2 cooked chicken breasts (sliced), 4 slices bacon (cooked), 1 tomato (sliced), red onion (sliced)
instructions: Make the chipotle spread: in a blender or food processor, pulse sun-dried tomatoes, chipotle, adobo sauce, water, oil, mustard, and brown sugar until smooth â€” season with salt and pepper | Make the avocado spread: mash the avocado with half the cilantro and the lime juice â€” season generously with salt and pepper | Spread 4 slices of bread with the avocado mixture | Spread the remaining 4 slices with the chipotle spread | Layer on sliced chicken, bacon, tomato, onion, and remaining cilantro | Close the sandwiches, cut in half, and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 cup wild rice (rinsed), 1 cup apple cider, 1 cup water, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/4 cup pecans (chopped), 2 tbsp golden raisins, 2 tbsp dried currants, 2 tbsp dried cranberries, 1 tbsp candied ginger (chopped), 1 shallot (diced), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/8 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 apple (cored and diced)
instructions: Wash the wild rice three times and drain well | Combine wild rice, apple cider, and water in a saucepan â€” bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45 to 60 minutes until tender | In a large frying pan, melt butter over low heat â€” add pecans, raisins, currants, cranberries, ginger, and shallots, stirring for 5 minutes | Add salt, pepper, cinnamon, nutmeg, the diced apple, and the cooked wild rice | Cook on low for 2 minutes until heated through | Serve warm

ingredients: 1/2 cup shortening, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 1 cup canned pumpkin purÃ©e, 2 tbsp molasses, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | Cream shortening and sugar together until light and fluffy | Mix in pumpkin, egg, and molasses â€” beat well | Stir in flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, and raisins until combined | Drop by spoonfuls onto an ungreased baking sheet | Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until lightly golden | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1/2 cup peach preserves, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 2 chipotle chilies in adobo (minced), 1 tbsp adobo sauce, 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp salt
instructions: Spray the grill with cooking spray and heat for direct heat cooking | In a small saucepan, combine peach preserves, lime juice, chopped chipotle, and adobo sauce â€” heat over low heat until the preserves melt | Stir in cilantro and set aside | In a small dish, combine garlic powder, pepper, cumin, and salt â€” sprinkle over the chicken breasts | Grill chicken over medium heat for 15-20 minutes, turning once or twice, brushing with the preserve mixture during the last 3 minutes â€” cook until juices run clear | Heat any remaining preserve mixture to boiling and boil for 1 minute â€” serve alongside the chicken

ingredients: For crust: 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup confectioners sugar, 1 tsp salt, 2 cups all-purpose flour. For topping: 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 3 large eggs, 1 cup light brown sugar, 1/2 cup dark corn syrup, 2 cups pecans (chopped), 1/2 cup sweetened flaked coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | Using an electric mixer, beat softened butter, confectioners sugar, and 1 teaspoon salt until light | Beat in 2 cups flour until it forms a mass | Transfer to a 9 x 13-inch pan and press evenly into the bottom | Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until the edges are golden | Meanwhile, whisk together remaining 2 tablespoons flour, remaining teaspoon salt, and baking powder | Beat eggs, brown sugar, and corn syrup until light â€” fold in the flour mixture, then pecans and coconut | Pour over the baked crust | Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until set | Run a metal spatula around the edges while still warm, then cool completely in the pan before cutting into bars

ingredients: 4 salmon fillets (about 150g each), 4 cups water, 1 tbsp salt, 1 bay leaf, 3 peppercorns, 2 lemon slices
instructions: Fill a large skillet or saucepan with water and add salt, bay leaf, peppercorns, and lemon slices | Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat (not a rolling boil) | Carefully add the salmon fillets, skin-side down, ensuring they are submerged | Reduce heat to low and poach for 8-10 minutes until the salmon is opaque and flakes easily with a fork | Remove salmon with a slotted spatula and serve immediately with lemon wedges and fresh dill

ingredients: 2 medium zucchini (sliced), 2 carrots (julienned), 2 tbsp olive oil (divided), 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 box frozen chopped spinach (thawed and squeezed dry), 9 lasagna noodles (cooked), 2 cups provolone cheese (shredded, divided), 2 cups tomato sauce, salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | SautÃ© sliced zucchini and julienned carrots separately in 1/2 tablespoon oil each until tender-crisp | Combine eggs and Parmesan in a small bowl | Spoon 2/3 cup tomato sauce into a 9-inch square baking dish | Place half the noodles over the sauce | Spread spinach over noodles, then top with 1/3 of the provolone, the carrots, 2/3 cup sauce, another 1/3 of provolone, and the zucchini | Top with remaining noodles, then remaining sauce | Cover tightly with foil and bake for 30 minutes | Remove foil, sprinkle with remaining provolone, and bake 10 minutes more uncovered | Let rest 10 minutes before cutting

ingredients: 500g ground beef (browned and drained), 2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded, divided), 1 box frozen spinach (thawed and squeezed dry), 2 cups mild salsa, 2 cups cooked couscous, tortilla chips for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | Brown the ground beef, drain, and let cool slightly | In a large bowl, mix together the browned beef, salsa, cooked couscous, and spinach until well combined | Spread the mixture into a greased baking pan | Cover with the shredded cheese and cover with aluminum foil | Bake for 1 hour until hot and bubbly | Serve with tortilla chips

ingredients: 2 cups broccoli florets (steamed until tender), 1 cup fresh basil leaves, 2 cloves garlic, 2 tbsp pine nuts (toasted), 1/2 tsp coarse salt, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 1/3 cup olive oil, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)
instructions: Place steamed broccoli in a food processor or blender | Add basil, garlic, pine nuts, salt, pepper, and olive oil | Process until smooth, scraping down the sides as needed | Transfer to a bowl and stir in the grated Parmesan cheese | Toss with warm buttered pasta to serve | Can be refrigerated in a tightly covered jar for up to a week | May be frozen â€” if freezing, do not stir in cheese until after defrosting

ingredients: 2 cups cake flour, 1 1/4 cups granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup shortening, 1 cup whole milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 3 large eggs. For frosting: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 2 cups confectioners sugar, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 2-3 tbsp milk, 2 cups sweetened flaked coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) â€” grease and flour two 8-inch round cake pans | Sift together cake flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt | Add shortening, milk, and vanilla â€” mix well, scraping sides and bottom often | Add eggs and beat 30 seconds longer | Divide batter evenly between the pans | Bake for 25-30 minutes until a tester comes out clean â€” cool completely | Make the frosting: cream butter with confectioners sugar using an electric mixer | Add vanilla and milk 1 tablespoon at a time until desired spreading consistency is reached | Frost the cake and immediately pat the entire surface with flaked coconut

ingredients: 8 cups popped popcorn, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, pinch of salt
instructions: Pop the popcorn and place in a large bowl | Melt butter and stir in brown sugar until dissolved | Drizzle the butter mixture over the popcorn and toss to coat | Sprinkle with cinnamon and a pinch of salt | Toss again and serve immediately

ingredients: 8 slices Italian bread, 8 slices provolone cheese, 2 roasted red peppers (sliced), 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted)
instructions: Roast the red peppers, remove the skin, and slice into pieces to fit the sandwiches (bottled roasted peppers can be used) | Melt butter in a small microwave-safe bowl | Brush one side of each bread slice with melted butter, making sure to cover the edges | Place bread butter-side down on a grill or griddle | Place 2 slices of provolone on each bread slice, then top with roasted pepper slices | Top with remaining bread slices, butter-side up | Grill at 325-350Â°F until golden brown on both sides, carefully flipping once | Remove, slice diagonally, and serve immediately

ingredients: 4 cups whole milk, 2 cups cooked rice, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 100g dark chocolate (chopped), 1 tsp vanilla extract, pinch of salt
instructions: Combine milk, cooked rice, sugar, chocolate, and salt in a 2 or 3-quart pan | Place over medium heat and cook, stirring often, until the pudding is thick and creamy, about 20 minutes | Remove from heat and stir in vanilla | Spoon into serving dishes and let cool for about 10 minutes | Serve warm or chilled

ingredients: 500g carrots (peeled and cooked until tender), 4 oz fat-free cream cheese, 1/4 cup nonfat yogurt, 2 tbsp brown sugar (divided), 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 2 tbsp raisins
instructions: Place cooked carrots in a 1 1/2-quart microwave-safe bowl â€” add enough water to cover and microwave on high for 10 minutes until tender, then drain | Place carrots in a food processor with cream cheese, yogurt, and 1 tablespoon brown sugar â€” process until well blended | Transfer to a serving bowl | Mix remaining 1 tablespoon brown sugar, raisins, and cinnamon â€” sprinkle over the carrot mixture | Serve warm

ingredients: 1 bottle prepared borscht (chilled), 2 medium potatoes (cooked and diced), low-fat sour cream for serving, fresh ground black pepper, fresh dill for garnish
instructions: Chill the bottle of borscht thoroughly | Cook diced potatoes in boiling water until just fork-tender â€” drain | Place hot potatoes in soup bowls and pour cold borscht over them | Spoon some of the chopped beets from the bottle over the soup | Add black pepper to taste | Top with a dollop of sour cream and fresh dill | For a creamier version, blend 1 cup borscht with sour cream and return to the bottle, shaking to combine

ingredients: 1 kg chicken pieces (cut up), 1 cup orange juice, 1/2 cup water, 1 large egg, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 3 cups crushed corn flakes, cooking spray
instructions: Mix orange juice, water, egg, and soy sauce in a large bowl | Add chicken pieces and marinate covered in the refrigerator overnight or longer, rotating pieces 2-3 times â€” add more water if needed to cover | Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | Crush corn flakes in a gallon-size zip-lock bag using a rolling pin | Individually coat each piece of chicken with the crushed corn flakes and place on a greased baking sheet | Cover with foil and bake for 15-20 minutes | Remove cover, turn each piece, and bake an additional 20-30 minutes until golden and crispy | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 2 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1/2 tsp hot pepper sauce (or to taste)
instructions: Place butter in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave on high for 1 minute until melted | Whisk in Dijon mustard and hot pepper sauce to taste | Serve as a spicy butter for corn on the cob, grilled meats, or vegetables

ingredients: 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup white sugar, 1 large egg, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup M&M's candies (plus extra for tops)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and line baking sheets with parchment paper | Sift together flour, baking soda, and salt â€” set aside | Beat butter and peanut butter until combined â€” add both sugars and beat until combined | Add egg and vanilla â€” mix well | Slowly add dry ingredients and mix until no white streaks remain | Stir in M&M's | Drop tablespoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart onto prepared sheets â€” press a few extra M&M's on top of each | Bake for 10-12 minutes until lightly browned and the center has set, rotating pans halfway through | Cool for 2 minutes on the pan before transferring to wire racks

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups warm water, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp salt, 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped), 1/2 cup dark chocolate chips
instructions: Put warm water in a large mixing bowl and sprinkle in yeast â€” stir and let dissolve for 5 minutes | Add flour, sugar, salt, and eggs â€” beat until well blended | Beat in butter gradually until the batter is smooth | Cover with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled | Stir batter down and add walnuts and chocolate chips | Spoon into 2 greased 8 x 4-inch loaf pans (pans should be half full) | Bake in a preheated 350Â°F (175Â°C) oven for about 45 minutes | Cool in pans for 5 minutes, then turn out onto racks

ingredients: 1/2 cup dried fava beans (soaked and skinned), 1/2 cup dried chickpeas (soaked and skinned), 2 medium onions (diced), 500g lamb (cubed), 1 tsp ground turmeric, 1 tsp ground ginger, 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/2 tsp caraway seeds, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 litres water, 3 tomatoes (finely chopped), 1/4 cup fresh parsley (chopped), 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped), 1/2 cup lentils, juice of 1 lemon, 1/4 cup all-purpose flour mixed with 1/2 cup water, 100g vermicelli or small pasta, salt and pepper to taste, lemon wedges for serving
instructions: Soak fava beans and chickpeas overnight, then drain and remove skins | In a large soup pot over medium heat, cook onions and lamb until onions are soft and translucent | Add turmeric, ginger, paprika, and 2 litres water â€” cover and bring to a rolling boil | Reduce heat to medium-low, add fava beans and chickpeas, and cook covered until beans are tender, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours | Finely chop tomatoes, parsley, and cilantro together â€” add to the pot along with tomato paste, lentils, pepper, lemon juice (drop in half the squeezed lemon), and salt | Cover and cook until lentils are tender, 20 to 25 minutes | Bring back to a boil and whisk in the flour-water slurry, stirring briskly to avoid lumps â€” boil 1 minute | Add nutmeg and caraway, then add vermicelli and cook until soft | Ladle into bowls and serve immediately with lemon wedges and Moroccan flatbread

ingredients: For crust: 1 cup wafer crumbs, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), pinch of salt. For filling: 4 large egg yolks, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 tbsp lemon zest, 1 tbsp orange zest, 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice, 1/4 cup fresh orange juice, 1 cup heavy whipping cream, toasted coconut for garnish
instructions: Line a 5 x 9-inch loaf pan with plastic wrap, allowing a 4-inch overhang on all sides | Stir together wafer crumbs, melted butter, and salt â€” press evenly into the bottom of the pan and freeze | In a double boiler, whisk egg yolks and sugar until the sugar dissolves, about 3 minutes | Slowly whisk in citrus zest and juices over low heat until thickened, about 10 to 12 minutes â€” let cool for 10 minutes | Whip the cream until soft peaks form and fold into the custard | Pour the filling over the frozen crust, fold the plastic wrap over, and freeze for at least 5 hours or overnight | To serve, run a wet knife around the sides, invert onto a platter, remove plastic wrap, and sprinkle with toasted coconut

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 6 cups water, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp dried parsley, 2 celery stalks (diced), 2 medium potatoes (diced), 1 carrot (diced), 1/2 cup raw cashews, 2 cups water (for blending), 1 head cauliflower (cut into florets), 1 cup frozen peas
instructions: In a large 4-quart pot, sautÃ© diced onion in olive oil until clear | Pour in 6 cups water, add seasonings, and bring to a boil | Add celery, potatoes, and carrot â€” simmer over low heat until cooked | Place cashews and 2 cups water in a blender and blend until creamy and smooth | Add the blended cashew mixture to the soup stock and bring to a boil, stirring constantly â€” reduce heat | Add cauliflower florets and peas 5 minutes before serving â€” cook until tender | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp vanilla extract, 3 tbsp self-rising flour, 2 tbsp raisins, 2 tbsp muesli, 1-2 tsp water if needed, pinch of salt

ingredients: 4 cups brewed black tea (cooled), 1 cup apricot nectar, 1/2 cup cranberry juice, 1 tbsp granulated sugar (or to taste), ice cubes, orange slices for garnish
instructions: Brew the black tea and let it cool completely | Mix the tea, apricot nectar, and cranberry juice together in a pitcher | Add sugar to taste and stir until dissolved | Pour over ice and garnish with a slice of orange | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 cup hard candies (various colors, unwrapped), metal cookie cutters (greased), aluminum foil, cooking spray, toothpick for making holes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and line a baking sheet with foil â€” spray with cooking spray | Grease metal cookie cutters thoroughly and place them on the prepared baking sheet | Place some hard candies in the center of each cookie cutter, filling evenly | Bake for about 20 minutes until the candies have melted and spread to fill the cutters | Cool for 5 minutes, then use a toothpick to make a hole at the top of each for hanging | Cool completely before removing from the cutters

recipe_name: Sweet Pork with Apples and Prunes
ingredients: 4 pork chops, 2 tbsp olive oil (divided), 2 red onions (sliced), 2 green apples (cored and sliced), 1/2 cup prunes (halved), 1/2 cup chicken stock, 1 tbsp fresh sage (chopped, plus extra for garnish), salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large frying pan over medium heat â€” cook pork chops for 1 minute each side until lightly browned, then transfer to a plate | Heat remaining oil in the pan, add sliced onions, and cook for 2-3 minutes until softened | Add apple slices and toss in the pan, stirring frequently, until the apple begins to color | Place onion-apple mixture in the bottom of a slow cooker | Add stock, prunes, 1 tablespoon fresh sage, and the browned pork chops | Cover and cook on high for 3-4 hours or low for 6-8 hours | Season to taste and serve with a sprinkle of fresh sage

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter (divided), 200g mushrooms (sliced), 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 box frozen chopped spinach (thawed and squeezed dry), 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 cups chicken or vegetable broth, 1 cup milk, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1 cup havarti cheese (shredded), 1 cup Gouda cheese (shredded), 9 no-boil lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large sautÃ© pan over medium-high heat â€” add mushrooms and cook until golden, about 5 minutes | Add onions and garlic and sautÃ© for 3 minutes | Add drained spinach, salt, and pepper â€” stir well and sautÃ© for 5 minutes | In a saucepan, melt 4 tablespoons butter over medium heat â€” add flour and cook, stirring constantly | Gradually add broth and milk â€” cook, stirring, until smooth and thickened, about 5 minutes | Remove from heat when it begins to boil and add thyme and basil | Combine shredded cheeses | Pour 1/2 cup sauce into a 9 x 13-inch pan | Layer 5 noodles, half the mushroom-spinach mixture, half the cheese, and half the sauce â€” repeat layers | Cover tightly with foil and bake for 45 minutes | Remove foil and bake 15 minutes longer | Let rest before serving

ingredients: 500g fresh morel mushrooms (sliced lengthwise, soaked overnight in salted water), 1 cup tempura batter mix, 1 cup cold water, 1 cup Crisco shortening (for frying), 1 tsp seasoned salt
instructions: Slice morels lengthwise and soak overnight in salted water in the refrigerator | Drain and rinse mushrooms in cold water, then dry on a towel | Mix the tempura batter with cold water and seasoned salt | In a large skillet, melt Crisco over high heat until very hot (375-400Â°F) | Dip each mushroom half in batter and carefully place in the hot oil â€” fry in batches without crowding | Fry until golden brown, turning once | Drain on paper towels and serve hot

ingredients: 2 ripe avocados, 1/3 cup sour cream, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp red onion (finely diced), 100g goat cheese (crumbled)
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine avocados, sour cream, lemon juice, garlic, pepper, salt, and goat cheese | Mash with a fork until well combined but still slightly chunky | Stir in diced red onion | Serve with tortilla chips or crackers

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with juice, 1 cup tomato juice, 1/4 cup dry sherry, 1/2 cup pearl barley, 1 bay leaf, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 2 cups clam juice, 200g crabmeat, 200g medium shrimp (peeled), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over medium-high heat | Add onion and celery â€” sautÃ© until tender, about 6 minutes | Add clam juice, diced tomatoes with their juices, and sherry â€” bring to a boil | Add barley, bay leaf, Worcestershire sauce, oregano, garlic powder, and cayenne | Simmer until barley is tender, stirring often, about 25 minutes | Add crabmeat and shrimp â€” simmer until shrimp are cooked through, about 3 minutes | Season with salt and pepper and serve hot

ingredients: 1 medium onion (diced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 150g chorizo sausage (diced), 1 tbsp harissa (or 1 tbsp tomato paste + 1/4 tsp cayenne), 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, 1/2 cup dry white wine, 1/2 cup chicken stock, 1 kg fresh mussels (cleaned and debearded), 1/2 cup heavy cream, crusty French bread for serving
instructions: In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, cook diced onion in butter over medium heat until soft, about 5 minutes | Add garlic and chorizo â€” cook until the sausage loses its raw color, about 5 minutes | Add harissa and red pepper flakes, then turn heat to high | Deglaze the pan with white wine, allowing it to bubble for a minute | Lower heat to medium, add chicken stock, and bring to a simmer | Add the cleaned mussels, cover, and steam until the mussels open, 3 to 4 minutes â€” discard any that do not open | Add cream and stir | Serve immediately with crusty French bread for dipping

ingredients: 6 Roma tomatoes (roughly chopped), 2 shallots (roughly chopped), 1 red bell pepper (roughly chopped), 4 cloves garlic, 2 red chilies (seeds removed for less heat), 2 tbsp fresh coriander, 1/4 cup water, 1 tsp cumin seeds (toasted and ground), 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp olive oil, salt to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 180Â°C (350Â°F) | Roughly chop tomatoes, shallots, bell pepper, garlic, and chilies | Place on a lined baking tray and lightly brush with olive oil | Roast until tomatoes and capsicum start to blacken | Meanwhile, lightly toast cumin seeds in a dry pan until fragrant â€” remove from heat and grind | Place all ingredients in a blender and blend to combine but not purÃ©e â€” leave some texture | Serve with tortilla chips

ingredients: 1 bell pepper (diced), 3 spring onions (sliced), 6 cherry tomatoes (halved), 6 large eggs, 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1 cup fresh spinach (chopped), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, hot sauce (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 200Â°C (390Â°F) | Wash and dice the pepper, onions, and tomatoes â€” place in a large mixing bowl | Wash and roughly chop the spinach â€” add to the bowl | Crack eggs into the bowl, add salt, and mix well | Grease a muffin tin with oil and pour the egg mixture evenly into the slots | Top each muffin with shredded cheese if desired | Bake for 15-18 minutes until the tops are firm to the touch | Serve hot

ingredients: 4 salmon fillets (about 150g each), 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 tbsp Italian seasoning, 2 tbsp olive oil
instructions: Heat olive oil in a sautÃ© pan over medium-high heat | Combine Parmesan cheese and Italian seasoning on a plate | Dredge the salmon fillets in the cheese mixture, pressing to coat evenly | Place in the hot pan and cook for approximately 3 minutes on each side until the crust is golden and the salmon is cooked through | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 chicken breasts (boiled, deboned, and cut into pieces, broth reserved), 1 can (400g) cream of chicken soup, 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1/2 cup milk, 1/2 cup margarine (melted), 1 package Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix, 1 1/2 cups reserved chicken broth
instructions: Boil chicken until tender â€” reserve broth, debone, and cut meat into small pieces | Place chicken in the bottom of a greased casserole pan | Mix soups and milk together and pour over the chicken | Melt margarine, toss with the stuffing mix, and moisten with about 1 1/2 cups of the reserved broth | Layer the stuffing mixture on top of the soup mixture | Bake at 350Â°F (175Â°C) for 30 minutes until hot and golden | Serve warm

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tsp kosher salt, 1 tbsp chili powder, 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup cottage cheese, 1 can (200g) diced green chilies, 1/4 cup sliced black olives, 2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded), 4 cups tortilla chips (crushed)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and butter a 9 x 13-inch casserole pan | Brown the ground beef and onion together â€” drain | Add salt, chili powder, and tomato sauce â€” simmer for 10 minutes | Crush tortilla chips and place half in the bottom of the prepared dish | Add the meat sauce, then layer with sour cream, cottage cheese, green chilies, and olives | Top with cheddar cheese, then the remaining chips | Bake for 45 minutes until hot and bubbly | Serve hot

ingredients: 1.5 kg oxtails (seasoned with salt and pepper), 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 celery stalks (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 green onions (sliced), 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 bottle dark beer, 1 tsp ground allspice, 2 cups low-sodium beef broth, salt and fresh ground black pepper, jasmine rice for serving
instructions: Season oxtails with salt and pepper | Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat â€” add half the oxtails and brown on all sides, about 3-4 minutes per side, then repeat with remaining oxtails | When all oxtails are browned, add onion, celery, and carrots â€” sautÃ© until softened | Add garlic, green onion, and ginger â€” sautÃ© about 1 minute, stirring often | Add tomato paste and stir well, then sprinkle flour over vegetables and stir to combine â€” cook for 2 minutes | Add beer and turn up heat to medium-high â€” bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes | Add allspice, stock, and oxtails â€” return to a boil, cover, reduce heat, and simmer until oxtails are tender, about 2 hours | Serve over jasmine rice

ingredients: 1/2 cup chili sauce, 1/4 cup onion (diced), 2 tbsp prepared horseradish, 1/2 tsp Tabasco sauce, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 500g cold boiled shrimp for dipping
instructions: Place chili sauce, onion, horseradish, Tabasco, and Worcestershire sauce in a blender â€” blend until thoroughly mixed | Chill for at least 1 hour | Serve as a dip for cold boiled shrimp

ingredients: 1.5 kg pork shoulder (cut into large pieces), 6 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp salt, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp orange zest, 1/4 cup white vinegar, 1/4 cup fresh orange juice, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 2 large onions (sliced), 1/2 cup vegetable broth
instructions: In a large bowl, combine garlic, salt, oregano, cumin, black pepper, and orange zest to make a paste | Stir in vinegar, orange juice, and lime juice | Add the pork pieces and toss until evenly coated â€” set aside to marinate | Slice onions and arrange in an even layer in the bottom of a slow cooker | Pour broth over the onions | Arrange the pork in an even layer over the onions, pouring over any reserved marinade | Cover and cook on high for 4 to 4 1/2 hours (or 8 hours on low) until the pork is fork-tender | Remove from heat, crack the lid to cool slightly, then gently stir the pork with the onions and serve

ingredients: 1 kg boneless pork loin (cut into pieces), 3 Scotch bonnet peppers (seeded), 6 sprigs fresh thyme, 1 tbsp ground allspice, 1 whole bulb garlic (peeled), 2 medium onions (roughly chopped), 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground black pepper, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 2 tbsp white vinegar, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated)
instructions: Chop onions, garlic, and peppers roughly â€” these will be blended | Blend all ingredients except the pork in a blender to make the jerk sauce | Cut the pork into smaller pieces and poke holes in them with a fork | Rub the sauce into the meat, reserving some for basting and dipping | Marinate overnight in the refrigerator | Grill the meat slowly over charcoal (ideally over pimento wood) or cook in the oven at 350Â°F (175Â°C), turning regularly and basting with reserved marinade until cooked through | Serve with salad

ingredients: 4 carrots (cut into chunks), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 celery ribs (cut into chunks), 200g fresh green beans (trimmed), 1 whole broiler-fryer chicken (about 1.5 kg), 2 slices bacon (diced), 1 cup hot water, 1 tsp chicken bouillon granules, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/4 tsp black pepper

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 can (200g) diced green chilies, 2 tbsp apricot or peach jam, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), tortilla chips for serving
instructions: Blend cream cheese, green chilies, and jam together until smooth â€” spread into a shallow serving dish | Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the top | Cover and refrigerate until chilled | Serve with tortilla chips

ingredients: 1 rotisserie chicken (meat removed from bones, skin and bones discarded), 1 yellow onion (diced), 3 russet potatoes (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 4 Roma tomatoes (diced), 1 cup cooked brown rice, 1 can (400g) white beans (drained), 4 cups chicken broth, 1 tsp dried thyme, 1 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water (for thickening)
instructions: Separate chicken from the bone, discarding skin and bones, keeping only the meat | Add all remaining ingredients except cornstarch to a large pot and bring to a boil | Simmer for 2 hours, or transfer to a crockpot and cook on low for 6-8 hours | Add cornstarch-water mixture to thicken as needed | Serve hot

ingredients: 500g beef stew meat (cubed), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 2 medium onions (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 tsp ground cumin, 2 tbsp curry powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp ground cardamom, 2 cups water, 2 sweet potatoes (peeled and cubed), 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped), steamed rice or naan for serving
instructions: Mix beef with salt and turmeric in a bowl | Heat oil in a pot over medium heat â€” add onion, garlic, and ginger and sautÃ© for 3 minutes | Add the beef mixture and all spices â€” sautÃ© for 5 minutes | Add water, cover, and simmer until the beef is tender, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours | Add sweet potatoes and simmer another 20 minutes until tender | If the curry is bitter, add a pinch of sugar | Serve over rice or as a stew with naan bread, garnished with fresh cilantro

ingredients: For starter: 1/2 cup warm water, 1 tsp fresh yeast, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour. For dough: 1 cup warm water, 2 tbsp honey, 3 tsp fresh yeast, 2 tbsp vegetable shortening, 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup Kalamata olives (pitted and halved)
instructions: Make the starter: combine warm water and yeast, stir to dissolve â€” add flour and stir until fully incorporated | Cover and ferment at room temperature for 30 minutes | For the dough: combine warm water, honey, and yeast in the bowl of a stand mixer â€” stir to dissolve | Add shortening, flour, salt, starter, and olives | Mix on low speed until the dough is fully developed | Divide dough into 2 pieces, roll into smooth balls, and cover with a warm damp cloth to rest for 30 minutes | Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Form into loaves, proof for 30 minutes, score with a sharp knife, spray with water, and bake for 30-40 minutes until deep golden brown and the center reaches 190-200Â°F | Cool on a wire rack for 30 minutes before slicing

ingredients: 4 salmon fillets (about 150g each), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup fresh strawberries (halved), 1/2 cup blueberries, 1/2 cup blackberries, 1 tsp sugar (optional)
instructions: Place berries in a small saucepan over medium-low heat | Crush berries with a spoon or potato masher to release juices | Cook until the liquid reduces by half, about 30 minutes, stirring often to prevent burning â€” add 1 teaspoon sugar if desired | Meanwhile, salt the non-skin side of the salmon fillets and brush with olive oil | Grill on low heat or pan-sear until the fish flakes easily | Serve hot with the berry reduction sauce spooned over the top

ingredients: 1 whole chicken (cut into pieces), 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 3 tbsp olive oil (divided), 4 slices streaky bacon (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 1/2 cup dry white wine, 1 can (400g) whole tomatoes, 1/2 cup chicken stock, salt and black pepper to taste, creamy mashed potatoes for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Season chicken pieces well with salt and pepper, then dust with flour | Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large flameproof casserole over high heat â€” add chicken skin-side down with the bacon and cook for 5-8 minutes on each side until golden | Remove and set aside | Reduce heat to low, add remaining oil and onion with a pinch of salt â€” sweat for 5 minutes until soft, then add garlic, celery, and carrots â€” sweat for 5-6 minutes | Increase heat to high, add wine, and boil until the alcohol evaporates | Add tomatoes with their juices and stock â€” gently boil for a few minutes | Reduce heat to a simmer, return chicken and bacon to the pot, stir through, cover, and transfer to the oven | Cook for about 1 hour, topping up with stock or water if needed | Serve with creamy mashed potatoes

ingredients: 12 slices Italian baguette (halved), 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 24 slices prosciutto, 12 small fresh mozzarella balls (halved), 12 cherry tomato slices, salt, 2 tbsp fresh flat-leaf parsley (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) | Cut each slice of bread in half | Lightly brush each half slice with olive oil | Place 2 slices of prosciutto on each piece of bread | Place a halved mozzarella ball atop the prosciutto | Place a tomato slice atop each piece of cheese and salt very lightly | Place canapÃ©s on a cookie sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes until the cheese has melted | Sprinkle parsley over the canapÃ©s to garnish and serve immediately

ingredients: 500g chicken pieces, 2 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 tsp whole peppercorns, 2 medium potatoes (cubed), 2 hot green chili peppers (slit), 1 can (400ml) coconut milk, 1 tsp salt, 10 curry leaves, 2 cups water, 1/2 cup coconut cream, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Place chicken, ginger, peppercorns, potatoes, chilies, curry leaves, water, coconut milk, and salt in a saucepan | Bring to a boil, then lower heat and cook for 20 minutes | Add coconut cream and simmer for 5 more minutes | Serve hot over steamed rice

ingredients: For shrimp: 24 large shrimp, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 cloves garlic (minced), juice of 1 lemon, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. instructions: Soak bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes â€” thread about 4 shrimp on each skewer | Whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, paprika, cayenne, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper â€” pour over the shrimp and marinate in the refrigerator for 20 minutes | Make the butter sauce: melt butter and add lemon juice and hot sauce â€” set aside | Make the mayonnaise: combine mayonnaise, shallot, Dijon, and capers â€” refrigerate | Preheat grill to medium-high â€” grill shrimp skewers for about 4 minutes total, flipping once | Remove shrimp from skewers and toss in the butter sauce | Spread the mayonnaise on both sides of the toasted baguette, top with shrimp, shredded lettuce, and sliced tomatoes | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 sugar cube or 1/2 tsp granulated sugar, 3 dashes Angostura bitters, 60ml rye or bourbon whiskey, ice cubes, 1 strip lemon peel, 1 maraschino cherry
instructions: In an old-fashioned tumbler, muddle bitters with sugar until the sugar is dissolved | Add ice cubes and pour in the whiskey | Twist the lemon peel over the drink to extract the oils, then drop it in | Garnish with a maraschino cherry and serve

ingredients: 400g fettuccine pasta, 500g raw shrimp (peeled and deveined), 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 cup low-sodium chicken broth, 1 cup heavy cream, Cajun seasoning to taste
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions | Sprinkle shrimp with salt, pepper, and toss to combine | Sprinkle 1 tablespoon flour over the shrimp and toss to coat â€” repeat with the second tablespoon | Melt butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat | When hot, add shrimp in a single layer and cook on each side, flipping once, until golden brown, approximately 2-3 minutes per side â€” remove to a plate | Pour in chicken broth â€” cook for about 5 minutes, whisking to deglaze the pan | Reduce heat to medium, pour in cream, and whisk constantly â€” cook until bubbly and thickened, about 5 minutes | Season the sauce to taste | Add drained pasta and shrimp to the sauce and stir to combine | If the sauce won't thicken, add 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 4 tablespoons cold water | Serve immediately

ingredients: For crumble: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/3 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup pecans (chopped), 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed). For filling: 1 can (400g) sweetened condensed milk, 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp orange juice, 2 cups fresh strawberries (sliced), 2 cups heavy whipping cream (whipped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Make the crumble: combine flour, brown sugar, and pecans â€” cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs | Spread into an ungreased 15 x 10-inch baking pan | Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown â€” cool completely | In a large bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice, and orange juice â€” mix well | Fold in sliced strawberries and whipped cream | Spoon 1 tablespoon crumb mixture into each parfait glass, top with about 3 tablespoons berry mixture, and repeat layers | Freeze until firm | Remove from the freezer 20-30 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 tsp almond extract, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup confectioners sugar, 1 tbsp cornstarch, 1/3 cup rainbow sprinkles
instructions: Preheat oven to 325Â°F (160Â°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper | Cream together softened butter, eggs, sugar, and sour cream | Add vanilla, almond extract, baking powder, baking soda, salt, nutmeg, cinnamon, sprinkles, confectioners sugar, and cornstarch â€” mix well | Slowly add flour until fully incorporated (dough should be sticky) | Dollop dough onto the parchment-lined pan (if shaping is desired, refrigerate for about an hour before rolling) | Bake for 9-13 minutes until the bottoms are golden and the center is cooked through | Serve and enjoy

ingredients: 500g rump steak (thinly sliced), 3 stalks lemongrass (finely chopped), 1 medium onion (sliced), 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1/4 cup roasted peanuts (chopped), fresh cilantro for garnish, steamed rice or noodles for serving
instructions: Place beef, lemongrass, onion, fish sauce, and sugar in a bowl â€” marinate in the refrigerator for about 4 hours | Heat oil in a wok over high heat | Stir-fry the beef in a few batches for about 3 minutes or until just browned â€” move the meat constantly so the onion and lemongrass don't burn | Return all the meat to the wok and add the peanuts | Serve immediately over rice or noodles, garnished with chopped cilantro

ingredients: 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 3/4 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup light brown sugar, 1 large egg, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 tbsp milk
instructions: In a bowl, combine flour, baking powder, and salt â€” set aside | Beat butter and both sugars on medium-high speed until light, 2-3 minutes | Beat in egg and vanilla until combined | Alternately beat in flour mixture with milk until just combined | Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes | Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and coat baking sheets with cooking spray | Drop dough by heaping tablespoonfuls at least 2 inches apart | Bake for 10-12 minutes until browned around edges | Cool for 5 minutes on the pan, then transfer to wire racks | For variations: add peanut butter and peanut butter cups, cocoa powder and three types of chocolate chips, dried cranberries and orange zest, or mixed nuts and toffee bits

ingredients: 2 cups frozen corn (thawed), 2 large eggs, 1 cup whole milk, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted, plus extra for topping), 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a casserole dish | Beat eggs into the milk until combined | Stir in corn, flour, sugar, salt, pepper, and 2 tablespoons melted butter | Pour into the prepared casserole dish | Mix remaining butter with breadcrumbs and sprinkle on top | Bake for 40 minutes until set and golden | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa (parboiled and drained), 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 lime (zest and juice), 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes (chopped), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 red chili (finely chopped)
instructions: Parboil the quinoa for about half the cooking time until soft but with some texture â€” drain | Zest and juice the lime | Finely chop the garlic and chili â€” chop the sun-dried tomatoes, leaving them a bit chunky | Mix all ingredients together in a small mixing bowl | Season with salt and pepper to taste and let sit for about 30 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1 cup plus 2 tbsp semi-sweet chocolate chips (divided), 1/4 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 tsp orange extract, 1 tbsp shortening, vanilla chips for drizzling
instructions: Place 1 cup chocolate chips in a blender and process for about 30 seconds | In a small bowl, microwave cream and butter on high until almost boiling | With the blender running, gradually pour in the hot liquid and orange extract â€” process until smooth | Pour into a bowl and chill for 20-30 minutes until firm â€” roll into 1-inch balls | Line a cookie sheet with waxed paper | Melt shortening and the remaining 2 tablespoons chocolate chips in the microwave in 10-second intervals â€” stir until smooth | Dip truffle balls into the chocolate and place on waxed paper to harden | Melt vanilla chips in a zippered bag, snip off a corner, and drizzle over the truffles | Store covered in the refrigerator

ingredients: For crust: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/3 cup unsalted butter (cold, cubed). For topping: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 2 tbsp milk, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 1/4 cup walnuts (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Combine flour and brown sugar in a large bowl â€” cut in cold butter until mixture forms fine crumbs | Reserve 1 cup for topping and press the remainder into the bottom of an 8 x 8-inch ungreased baking pan | Bake for 12-15 minutes until lightly browned but not completely done | Cream together cream cheese and granulated sugar until smooth | Add egg, milk, lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla â€” beat well | Spread batter over the partially baked crust | Combine walnuts with the reserved crumb mixture and sprinkle over the top | Bake for 20-25 minutes | Cool and cut into squares

ingredients: 3 litres water, 4 green onions, 3-inch piece fresh ginger (sliced), 2 tsp sea salt, 4 chicken breast halves, 500g chicken wings and backs, 2 tbsp light brown sugar, 200g rice noodles (cooked), 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped), Thai basil, mung bean sprouts, lime wedges, fish sauce, and chili-garlic sauce for serving

ingredients: 4 ripe tomatoes (divided), 1 green bell pepper (divided), 1 seedless cucumber (divided), 1/2 red onion (divided), 1 slice white bread (crust removed), 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 cloves garlic, 2 cups tomato juice, 1 cup vegetable broth, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/2 tsp fresh ground black pepper, salt to taste

ingredients: 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 3 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 cup pecan pieces, 2 cups water, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 cup cooked sweet potato (mashed), 1 tbsp cane syrup, 2 green onions (sliced)

ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup powdered sugar (plus 1/4 cup for dusting), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 cup pecan halves (finely chopped), 36 chocolate kiss candies (unwrapped)

ingredients: 6 slices bread (buttered), 4 slices ham, 3 large eggs, 1 cup whole milk, 1 cup cheddar cheese (grated), salt and black pepper to taste

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 cups whole milk, 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese (shredded), 1 tsp dried dill, 2 green onions (sliced), 2 cans (200g each) tuna (drained and flaked), 300g egg noodles (cooked), 1 cup frozen peas and carrots, salt and pepper to taste. instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat â€” whisk in flour and cook until slightly colored and fragrant | Whisk in milk slowly and bring to a low boil, stirring constantly | Reduce heat when thickened and stir in cheese until melted | Add dill, salt, and pepper to taste | Spray a casserole pan with oil and add cooked noodles, frozen vegetables, green onions, and tuna | Stir in the cheese sauce and adjust seasoning | Top with breadcrumbs mixed with melted butter and parsley | Bake for approximately 30 minutes until the topping is brown and bubbling at the edges | Let sit for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 2 cans (400g each) black beans (drained and rinsed), 1/2 cup salsa, 8 whole wheat tortillas, 2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded), additional salsa and sour cream for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | In a bowl, mash the drained beans with a fork | Add salsa and mix together | Place 4 tortillas on a baking sheet | Divide the bean mixture evenly among the tortillas | Top each with shredded cheese | Cover with the remaining tortillas | Bake for 15-18 minutes until the cheese is melted | Cut into wedges and serve with additional salsa and sour cream

instructions: Preheat oven to 180Â°C (350Â°F) and line a muffin tray with 12 paper cases | Mash the bananas well | Beat together eggs and oil | Put flour, baking powder, and sugar in a large bowl and stir â€” mix in the mashed bananas and egg mixture | Fold in white chocolate chunks and coconut | Spoon evenly into cases | Bake for 20 minutes until the muffins come away from the side of the pan when touched | Rest on a wire rack for 5 minutes, then remove muffins and cool another 5 minutes

ingredients: 1/3 cup canola oil, 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 3/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp baking soda

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 tbsp instant coffee powder, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp hot water, 2 cups chilled milk, 2 tbsp heavy cream, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, cinnamon for garnish

ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix, 1 cup water, 1/3 cup vegetable oil, 3 large eggs, 3 ripe bananas (mashed)

ingredients: 2 cups instant potato flakes, 1 cup hot water, 1 tsp salt, 1 large egg, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1/4 cup breadcrumbs for topping
instructions: Combine potato flakes with hot water and let sit for 1 minute | Add salt, egg, flour, and melted butter in that order â€” mix well | Form into 2-inch balls with floured hands | Cook in boiling salted water until they rise to the top | Remove with a slotted spoon and place in a buttered casserole dish | Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and drizzle with additional melted butter | Cover with foil and bake at 325Â°F for 5-10 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 200g mushrooms (sliced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 3 green onions (sliced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 4 large eggs, 1 cup whole milk, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp seasoned salt, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 1/2 cup cooked ham (diced), 1/2 cup Swiss cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 2 tbsp dry white wine, 1 prepared 9-inch pie shell

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1 cup frozen corn, 1/4 cup picante sauce, 1 tbsp chili powder, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 bag (900g) frozen tater tots, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded)

ingredients: 500g Italian sausage (casing removed), 500g ground beef, 2 medium onions (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 200g mushrooms (sliced), 2 cans (400g each) diced tomatoes, 2 cans (400g each) tomato sauce, 2 cans (170g each) tomato paste, 2 tbsp dried basil, 1 tbsp dried oregano, 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes

ingredients: 1 prepared 9-inch pastry shell, 3 large eggs (separated), 1 package (100g) vanilla pudding mix, 1 1/2 cups whole milk, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup frozen lemonade concentrate (thawed), 1/4 tsp cream of tartar, 6 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tsp fresh lemon juice

ingredients: 1 cup fresh or desiccated coconut, 1 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp milk or coconut milk, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp onion (finely chopped), 1/4 tsp chili powder (optional), sliced chilies for garnish

ingredients: 2 wheels Brie cheese, 1 cup fresh raspberries, 1/2 cup Peach and Bourbon BBQ sauce, 1 tbsp fresh thyme leaves, fresh ground black pepper, pre-soaked cedar grilling plank, sliced baguette and crackers for serving
