instructions: Mix mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon juice, salt, and pepper together in a large mixing bowl | Shred or chop the cooked chicken | Add the chicken, celery, and green onions to the dressing | Toss well to combine | Serve chilled on sandwiches or over salad greens

ingredients: 1 cup beer, 1/4 cup Dijon mustard, 1/4 cup honey, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp dried rosemary, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1.5 kg boneless pork loin roast, 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together beer, Dijon mustard, honey, olive oil, rosemary, garlic, and onion | Place the pork roast in a heavy-duty zip-lock plastic bag and pour in the marinade â€” seal and turn to coat | Refrigerate overnight, turning occasionally | Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) | Place the roast on a rack in a roasting pan â€” reserve the marinade | Season the roast with salt and pepper | Roast for 20 minutes at 425Â°F to create a seared crust | Reduce oven temperature to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and continue roasting until a meat thermometer reads 150Â°F (65Â°C), about 1 1/2 hours | Let rest for 15 minutes | Strain the reserved marinade into a saucepan and add whipping cream â€” simmer until reduced slightly, about 15-20 minutes, and season with salt and pepper | Slice the pork and drizzle the sauce over the slices

ingredients: 60ml peach vodka, 30ml fresh lime juice, 60ml cranberry juice, 6 fresh raspberries, crushed ice
instructions: Combine peach vodka, lime juice, cranberry juice, and raspberries in a cocktail shaker with ice | Shake vigorously for 15 seconds | Strain over crushed ice in a rocks glass | Garnish with fresh raspberries and serve immediately

ingredients: 1.5 kg boneless pork loin roast, 1/2 cup fresh parsley, 1/2 medium onion, 4 cloves garlic, 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper
instructions: Place pork in a large self-sealing bag | In a blender, pulse parsley, onion, and garlic until minced | Add lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper â€” process to blend | Pour the marinade into the bag, seal, and toss to coat the pork | Refrigerate overnight | Preheat oven to 500Â°F (260Â°C) | Remove pork from the bag and discard the marinade | Place pork on a wire rack inside a roasting pan and bake for 15 minutes | Lower oven temperature to 325Â°F (160Â°C) and continue cooking until internal temperature reaches 155Â°F (68Â°C), about 1 hour | Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing

ingredients: 500g sirloin steak, 1 1/2 tsp pickling spice, salt and black pepper, 1 tbsp olive oil, 4 large portobello mushroom caps, 6 slices rye bread, 1/4 cup Russian or Thousand Island dressing, 1/2 cup sauerkraut (drained), 6 slices GruyÃ¨re cheese, cooking spray
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat | Sprinkle pickling spice, salt, and pepper on both sides of the steak | Add steak to the skillet and cook to medium-rare, about 4 minutes per side â€” transfer to a cutting board | Add mushrooms to the same skillet, cover, and cook until tender, about 3 minutes â€” transfer to a bowl | Thinly slice the steak on the diagonal | Arrange 6 bread slices on a work surface and spread with dressing | Layer each with steak, 2 mushroom caps, sauerkraut, and cheese â€” top with remaining bread | Spray 2 large nonstick skillets with cooking spray, add sandwiches, and cook covered over medium heat until bottoms are golden, about 3 minutes | Remove, spray skillets again, flip sandwiches, and cook until golden and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 whole chicken (cut into pieces), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 shallots (sliced), 2 lemons (thinly sliced), 1/2 cup dry white wine, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Sprinkle chicken pieces with salt and pepper | Melt butter in a large 12-inch heavy-bottomed skillet over medium heat | When foaming subsides, add chicken pieces skin-side down and cook until golden brown and crispy, 4-5 minutes | Turn pieces over and cook until browned on the other side, about 3 minutes | Add shallots and place lemon slices on top of the chicken | Cook for 5 minutes | Pour in the wine, cover the skillet, and cook until the chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes | Serve the chicken with the pan juices spooned over, with steamed rice on the side

ingredients: 1 cup instant coffee powder, 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 cups instant dry milk powder, 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix
instructions: Measure all ingredients into a clean, dry bowl | Use a fork to combine everything evenly | Transfer the mixture into a resealable container | To prepare: measure 3 or 4 tablespoons of the mixture into a coffee mug | Fill with hot water and stir to dissolve | Serve hot

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 2 large eggs, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 cup breadcrumbs. For sauce: 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup grape jelly, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Combine all meatball ingredients in a bowl and mix well â€” shape into 1-inch balls | Brown them in a nonstick frying pan until browned all over â€” drain on paper towels and place in a large ungreased casserole dish | Bake for 30 minutes | Meanwhile, make the sauce: combine tomato sauce, brown sugar, grape jelly, Worcestershire sauce, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a saucepan over low heat and stir until smooth | Add the meatballs to the sauce | Serve hot as an appetizer or over rice

ingredients: 1 cup sour cream, 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese (shredded), 1 cup cooked ham (finely diced), 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 1 can (200g) diced green chilies, 1/4 cup red onion (diced), 1/4 cup sweet white onion (diced), 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 large round bread loaf (hollowed out)
instructions: Cream together sour cream and cream cheese until smooth | Add shredded cheddar, diced ham, crumbled bacon, green chilies, both onions, and Worcestershire sauce â€” mix well | Cut a thin slice from the top of the bread and carefully hollow out the round loaf | Fill the hollowed bread with the dip and cover with the top slice | Wrap the filled loaf with aluminum foil and bake at 350Â°F (175Â°C) for about 1 hour | Serve hot with cocktail breads, crackers, or celery

ingredients: 1/2 cup fat-free buttermilk, 2 tbsp white vinegar, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp dried dill weed, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and whisk until well blended | Refrigerate until ready to use | Serve over salad greens

ingredients: 2 ripe mangoes (peeled and diced), 2 ripe peaches (peeled and diced), 1/4 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp prepared mustard, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/3 cup mango or peach nectar
instructions: Pour nectar into a medium-sized saucepan over medium heat | Peel and dice mango and peach into 1/4-inch cubes and add to the pot | Add brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, and cinnamon | Simmer until cooked down and the mixture thickens, approximately 20-30 minutes, stirring occasionally | Adjust seasonings to taste | Serve with jerk chicken or grilled meats

ingredients: 4 sheets phyllo pastry, 1/2 cup sultanas, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped), 1/4 cup sliced almonds, 3 cups skim milk, 1 tsp ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 200Â°C (400Â°F) | Lay phyllo sheets out flat in single layers on 2 non-stick baking trays | Bake for about 15 minutes until crisp and golden | Break the sheets into large pieces | Arrange a layer of cooked phyllo into 4 individual cereal bowls â€” top with some sultanas, walnuts, and almonds | Add more pastry and finish with the remaining fruit and nuts | Heat the milk and cinnamon in a saucepan until it just comes to a boil | Pour the hot milk over the layered fruit and phyllo and serve immediately

ingredients: 400g firm tofu (pressed and drained), 1 small head cauliflower (riced and squeezed dry), 1 large egg (beaten), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp dried Italian herbs, 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), pizza sauce and toppings of choice
instructions: Press tofu in a bowl with a heavy weight to drain as much water as possible | Rice the cauliflower in a food processor â€” cook in boiling water for 4-5 minutes, drain, and squeeze out excess water using a cheesecloth or nut milk bag | Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | In a bowl, mash the drained tofu well with your hands | Add cauliflower, beaten egg, herbs, salt, and cheese â€” mix well | Press the dough out onto a parchment-lined baking sheet to about 1/2-inch thickness | Bake for 30-40 minutes until firm and slightly brown | Remove from oven, top with pizza sauce, toppings, and cheese | Bake for another 10-20 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and browned | Slice and serve

ingredients: 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce, 3 ripe bananas (mashed), 1/2 cup buttermilk, 1/3 cup milk, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt, extra sugar for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a muffin tin | Beat eggs until foamy | Add applesauce, mashed bananas, buttermilk, and milk â€” mix until creamy | Add sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, flour, and salt â€” mix well | Pour into greased muffin tins and sprinkle a pinch of sugar on top of each muffin | Bake for 15-20 minutes until brown around the edges and they bounce back when touched | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: For cake: 1 cup quick oats, 1 1/4 cups boiling water, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup white sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/3 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder. For topping: 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/3 cup all-purpose flour, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 3 tbsp water, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped), 1/2 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a 9 x 13-inch pan | Combine oatmeal and boiling water in a small bowl â€” cover and set aside for 10 minutes | Cream butter and both sugars until fluffy â€” beat in eggs and vanilla | Add the oatmeal mixture and stir to incorporate | Add flour, baking soda, salt, and cocoa powder â€” blend well | Pour into the prepared pan and bake for 30-40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | While the cake bakes, combine all topping ingredients in a bowl | When the cake is done, spread the topping evenly over the hot cake | Broil until just bubbly, about 5-6 minutes â€” watch carefully to prevent over-browning

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 cup sugar substitute, 3 ripe bananas (mashed), 1/2 cup egg substitute, 1/4 cup margarine (softened)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) and spray a muffin tin with cooking spray | Combine sugar substitute, margarine, and egg substitute in a bowl | In a separate bowl, combine whole wheat flour, salt, and baking powder | Add dry ingredients to wet and fold in mashed bananas | Spoon into the prepared muffin tin | Bake for approximately 15-20 minutes until done | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 2 medium yellow onions (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 cup dry white wine, 1/2 cup vegetable or chicken stock, 30g dried porcini mushrooms (rehydrated, liquid reserved), 1 tbsp fresh thyme, 2 tbsp fresh Italian parsley (chopped), 1/2 tsp ground cumin, salt and pepper to taste, cooked fettuccine or pappardelle for serving
instructions: In a large skillet, sautÃ© diced onion and minced garlic in oil and butter over medium heat until very soft | Add wine, stock, mushrooms with their soaking liquid, thyme, parsley, and cumin â€” simmer until slightly thickened | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Pour over cooked fettuccine or pappardelle noodles | Garnish with fresh tomato, basil, and grated cheese

ingredients: 400g rotini pasta (cooked and drained), 2 cups cherry tomatoes (halved), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 salmon fillets (about 150g each, baked and flaked), 1 tbsp orange zest, 1/4 cup fresh basil (chopped), 2 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Toss onions and tomatoes with olive oil and spread on a parchment-lined sheet pan | Bake for 20 minutes until tomatoes begin to release juice and onions are tender | Remove vegetables and place salmon on the same sheet pan â€” drizzle with olive oil and bake for 15 minutes until done | Use a fork to separate salmon into bite-size chunks | Toss together the roasted vegetables, cooked pasta, salmon, orange zest, and basil | Serve warm or chilled

ingredients: 1 cup fresh lemon juice concentrate, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 3 cups cold water, 1 whole orange (cut into 4-6 slices, unpeeled)
instructions: Mix lemon juice concentrate, sugar, and cold water in a 1-quart container until sugar dissolves | Cut the orange into 4-6 slices â€” do not peel or squeeze | Drop the orange slices into the lemonade and stir | Serve cold over ice

ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles (cooked and drained), 3 tbsp butter, 200g asparagus spears (cut into 1-inch pieces), 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 2 cups cooked ham (diced), 2 cups whole milk (divided), 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 tsp chicken bouillon granules, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded, divided)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and spray a 13 x 9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray | Melt butter in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat â€” add asparagus and mushrooms and cook for 5-7 minutes until asparagus is crisp-tender | Transfer to a large bowl and stir in ham | In the same skillet, combine 1/2 cup milk, flour, bouillon, pepper, and Dijon mustard â€” blend well with a whisk | Add remaining 1 1/2 cups milk, blend well, and cook until bubbly and thickened | Remove from heat and stir in 1/2 cup cheese until melted | Spread 1/2 cup sauce in the bottom of the prepared dish â€” reserve 1/2 cup for topping | Add remaining sauce to the ham mixture | Layer 3 noodles, half the ham mixture, and 1/2 cup cheese â€” repeat | Top with remaining noodles, reserved sauce, and remaining cheese | Bake for 20-30 minutes until bubbly | Let stand for 15 minutes before serving

ingredients: For meat: 1 kg pork roast (cooked and shredded), 1 kg chicken (cooked and shredded), 1/2 cup corn oil, 6 tbsp chili powder, 3 tbsp garlic powder, 3 tbsp ground cumin, 1 tbsp black pepper, 2 tbsp salt. For masa: 1.8 kg masa corn flour, 3 tbsp paprika, 3 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp cumin seeds, 3 tbsp chili powder, 3 tbsp garlic powder, 4 cups corn oil, 4 quarts warm pork/chicken broth. For assembly: dried corn husks (soaked in warm water for 2 hours)
instructions: Cook and shred the pork roast: boil chunks in water for about 2 1/2 hours until tender â€” shred and discard fat | Cook and shred the chicken: boil in water for 2 hours, remove skin and bones, and shred | Combine both meats in a large pan and mix thoroughly | Warm the oil and seasonings together â€” pour over the meat and mix by hand until completely distributed â€” refrigerate | Prepare the masa: mix masa flour with paprika, salt, cumin seeds, chili powder, and garlic powder | Add corn oil, then slowly work in warm broth until the consistency is like thick peanut butter | To assemble: spread about 1/2 cup masa on a soaked corn husk, leaving the right third and top third uncovered | Add a tablespoon of meat mixture along the left edge | Roll from left to right, then fold the top over | Steam tamales upright in a large pot with water in the bottom for at least 2 hours, adding water as needed | Test one for doneness â€” the masa should be firm | Cool and serve

ingredients: 2 cups mixed dried fruit (apricots, apples, pears, prunes), 2 tbsp water if needed
instructions: Place dried fruit in a food processor and whiz until it becomes a smooth purÃ©e | Scoop onto greased wax paper and spread into a square about 1/4 inch thick using a palette knife | Slide the paper onto a baking tray and bake at 150Â°F (70Â°C) overnight, or at 300Â°F (160Â°C) for a couple of hours if in a hurry | The fruit should be soft but firm when done | Peel off the waxed paper and slice into bite-sized pieces â€” cookie cutters can be used for shapes | Store in an airtight jar

ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1/2 cup sour cream, 2 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp onion (diced), 1 clove garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Whisk mayonnaise and sour cream in a medium bowl until smooth | Stir in dill, Parmesan, lemon juice, onion, garlic, and Worcestershire sauce | Season with salt and pepper | Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour to blend flavors before serving

ingredients: 2 cups long-grain white rice, 4 cups chicken or vegetable stock, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 cup boiling onions or diced onion, 1/4 cup pine nuts, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh mint (optional), 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese, lemon wedges for serving
instructions: Coat the rice cooker bowl with cooking spray | Add rice and stock, set for the regular white rice cycle, and start | When the machine switches to keep warm, let it steam for 10 minutes | While rice steams, heat olive oil in a small skillet, add onions, and cook for 5 minutes until soft | Add pine nuts and cook until golden, about 1 minute | When steaming is done, add the onion mixture to the rice along with lemon juice, dill, and mint â€” stir to combine | Close the cover and keep warm for 10 more minutes | Transfer to a serving dish and top with crumbled feta and lemon wedges

ingredients: 500g ground turkey, 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 1 tbsp yellow mustard, 1 large egg, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 4 slices Monterey Jack cheese, 1 red bell pepper (cut into rings), 1 yellow bell pepper (cut into rings), 4 hamburger buns
instructions: Combine ground turkey, cilantro, mustard, egg, salt, and pepper in a large bowl | Shape into 4 patties | Grill over high heat for 15 minutes or until no longer pink in the center | Top with cheese during the last few minutes of grilling | Grill pepper rings for 2 minutes on each side | Place burgers on buns and top with grilled pepper rings | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 tsp instant espresso powder, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup dark brown sugar, 1 large egg, 100g bittersweet chocolate (melted and cooled), 2 tbsp milk, 1/2 cup confectioners sugar (for coating)
instructions: Stir together flour, cocoa, espresso, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl | Beat butter and brown sugar with a mixer until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes | Beat in egg until well combined â€” mix in cooled bittersweet chocolate | Reduce speed to low and gradually add flour mixture â€” beat in milk until just combined | Cover dough with plastic wrap and freeze until firm, about 45 minutes | Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and line 2 baking sheets with parchment | Shape dough into 1/2-inch balls (1 teaspoon each) | Roll balls in confectioners sugar twice, letting them sit in the sugar between coatings | Place on baking sheets 2 inches apart | Bake for 10-12 minutes until cookies have spread and coating is cracked | Cool on a wire rack

recipe_name: Lamb Chops with Thai Peanut Sauce
ingredients: For sauce: 3 cloves garlic, 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, 2 tbsp ketchup, 1 tbsp green curry paste, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 1/3 cup water. For lamb: 8 lamb loin chops
instructions: In a food processor, pulse garlic and cilantro until finely chopped | Add ketchup, curry paste, lime juice, fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar â€” pulse until a paste forms | Spread 1/4 cup of the paste over the lamb chops | In a saucepan, whisk the remaining paste with 1/3 cup water â€” warm over low heat until pourable | Light a grill or preheat a grill pan to medium-high | Grill the chops for 4 minutes per side until medium-rare (125-130Â°F / 52-54Â°C) | Transfer to a platter and spoon the warm peanut sauce over the chops | Serve with extra sauce on the side

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 cups whole milk, 1 cup tomato juice, 2 cans (200g each) salmon (drained and flaked), fresh dill for garnish
instructions: In a heavy saucepan, melt butter over medium-high heat | Add diced onion and celery and cook until tender, 3 to 5 minutes | Whisk in flour and salt, blending well | Slowly add milk, stirring constantly, and cook until thick, about 3 minutes | Add tomato juice and stir until blended | Add salmon and stir gently to combine | Heat through and serve hot garnished with fresh dill

ingredients: For vegetables: 2 courgettes (sliced), 1 aubergine (cubed), 2 red onions (cut into wedges), 2 red bell peppers (sliced), 3 cardamom pods (crushed), 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp olive oil. For cake: 500g ricotta cheese, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/2 cup Pecorino cheese (grated, divided), 2 large eggs, salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 190Â°C (375Â°F) | Mix crushed cardamom, honey, olive oil, and seasoning in a large bowl | Add peppers, aubergine, and courgette and mix to coat | Spread vegetables on a roasting tray in a single layer and bake for 1 hour | To make the cake: mix garlic, ricotta, and most of the Pecorino â€” season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper | Turn the cheese mixture into a greased 23cm round springform tin â€” smooth the top and sprinkle with remaining Pecorino | Bake for 30 minutes until firm and golden brown | Remove from the tin onto a serving plate, top with the roasted vegetables, and serve immediately

ingredients: For filling: 3 cups mashed potatoes, 6 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 1 medium onion (diced and sautÃ©ed in bacon drippings), 1 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper. For assembly: 24 wonton wrappers, 2 large eggs (beaten for egg wash), vegetable oil for frying
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp â€” drain on paper towels, reserving the drippings | SautÃ© diced onion in the bacon drippings until translucent and soft | Stir onions into the mashed potatoes with salt, onion powder, and pepper â€” cook on low for about 10 minutes, stirring | Remove from heat and gently fold in crumbled bacon | To assemble: brush the perimeter of each wonton wrapper with egg wash, place a small spoonful of filling in the center, and seal to form a triangle | Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet | Heat oil in an electric skillet or deep fryer to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Fry wontons in batches until golden brown | Drain on paper towels and let cool for at least 30 minutes before serving

recipe_name: Pasta with Peas and Pesto Chicken
ingredients: 400g dry pasta, 2 chicken breasts (cubed), 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 cup red pesto sauce, 1 cup frozen peas, 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pan of salted water to a boil and add the pasta â€” cook for 10 minutes | During the last 2 minutes, add the frozen peas | Bring back to a boil, cook for 1 minute, then drain well | Meanwhile, heat oil in a frying pan and sautÃ© the chicken pieces over medium heat for 5-6 minutes until lightly browned and cooked through | Add the pesto and cook for a further minute | Add the pesto chicken to the drained pasta and peas â€” mix well and season to taste | Sprinkle with grated cheese and serve in bowls with warm garlic bread

ingredients: 4 thin-cut pork chops, 1 large egg (beaten), 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp Goya Adobo seasoning, vegetable oil for frying
instructions: Season pork chops on both sides with Adobo seasoning | Place chops in a bowl, pour beaten egg over them, and mix well to coat each chop | In a separate bowl, mix flour, salt, and pepper | Heat about 1/4 inch of oil in a frying pan over high heat, then reduce slightly | Dredge each chop in the flour mixture and pan-fry â€” thin chops cook fast, about 2-3 minutes per side | Drain on paper towels and serve hot with macaroni and fried cabbage or collard greens

ingredients: 400g penne pasta, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp olive oil, 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (cubed), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 cup chicken broth, 1/4 cup milk, 1 tsp cornstarch, 1/2 cup pesto sauce, 2 cups broccoli florets, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated, divided), salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook penne until al dente â€” drain | Heat butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat â€” sautÃ© chicken and garlic until chicken is almost cooked through | In a small bowl, stir together chicken broth, milk, and cornstarch â€” pour into the skillet with the chicken, season with salt and pepper | Add pesto and half the Parmesan cheese | Add broccoli and cook until tender | Stir in the cooked pasta and toss to coat | Top with the remaining Parmesan and serve

ingredients: 1 kg pork shoulder (diced), 6 tomatillos (husked), 3 serrano chilies, 3 cloves garlic, 1/2 medium onion, 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, 2 medium potatoes (diced), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, salt to taste, warm tortillas for serving
instructions: Place tomatillos and serrano chilies in a small pan, cover with water, and bring to a boil â€” boil for 15 minutes | While they boil, heat oil in a separate pan and brown the diced pork until golden and crisp on all sides | Once tomatillos and chilies have boiled, place them in a blender with garlic, onion, and 1/2 cup of the boiling liquid â€” blend on low for 1 minute | Pour the chile mixture over the pork â€” do not drain the oil | Add salt to taste, cilantro, and diced potatoes | Cover and cook on medium-low for 30-45 minutes until the pork is fork-tender | Serve with warm flour or corn tortillas

ingredients: 1.5 kg turkey wings, 2 medium onions (quartered), 8 cups chicken broth (divided), 1 carrot (diced), 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Arrange turkey wings in a single layer in a large roasting pan and scatter onions over top | Roast for 1 1/4 hours until the wings are browned | Transfer wings and onions to a 5-6 quart pot | Add a little water to the roasting pan and scrape up the brown bits â€” add to the pot | Add 6 cups broth, carrot, and thyme â€” bring to a boil | Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 1 1/2 hours | Remove wings and strain the broth, pressing vegetables to extract liquid â€” discard solids | Skim fat from the broth | Whisk flour into the remaining 2 cups broth until smooth | Bring the strained broth to a gentle boil and whisk in the flour mixture â€” boil 3-4 minutes to thicken | Stir in butter and pepper | Serve immediately or freeze for up to 6 months

ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent roll dough, 1 apple (peeled and finely diced), 2 tbsp raisins, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, milk for brushing, brown sugar for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Separate the crescent rolls and arrange triangles on a greased baking sheet with bases overlapping to form a circle (points facing outward) | Mix the diced apple, raisins, sugar, lemon zest, and nutmeg â€” spoon over the base of the triangles | Fold the points over the filling and tuck under the bases | Brush with milk and sprinkle with brown sugar | Bake for 25 minutes until golden | Serve warm

ingredients: 8 ripe tomatoes (quartered), 1/2 cup olive oil (divided), 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 4 cloves garlic (minced), salt and black pepper, 1 medium yellow onion (diced), 2 cups fresh basil leaves (plus extra for garnish), 2 cups cold water, 8 slices crusty bread (for croutons)
instructions: Preheat oven to 500Â°F (260Â°C) | In a large bowl, toss tomatoes with 1/4 cup olive oil, vinegar, garlic, salt, and pepper | Spread on a non-reactive baking sheet and roast until very dark in spots, 35-40 minutes â€” cool slightly | For the croutons: brush bread slices with oil, season with salt, and toast in the oven until golden, about 6 minutes | In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine the remaining 1/4 cup oil, diced onions, and a pinch of salt â€” cook until very soft, 8-10 minutes | Add the basil and sautÃ© for about 1 minute | Add the roasted tomatoes and water â€” bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes | PurÃ©e the soup in a blender until very smooth | Reheat and serve each bowl with a crouton in the center and torn basil on top

ingredients: 2 tbsp suet or vegetable oil, 500g beef round steak (cubed), 500g beef chuck (cubed), 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 1 cup beer, 2 tbsp crushed red chili peppers, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tbsp dried oregano, 1 tbsp paprika, 1 1/2 tsp ground cumin (divided), 1 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded)
instructions: Melt suet or heat oil in a heavy 3-quart pot over medium-high heat | Remove unrendered suet and crumble the meat into the pot â€” break up lumps and cook until evenly browned | Add tomato sauce, beer, crushed red chili, garlic, onion, oregano, paprika, 1 teaspoon cumin, and salt â€” stir and bring to a boil | Lower heat and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 1 hour | Taste and adjust seasonings, adding cayenne pepper | Simmer uncovered 1 hour longer | Stir in the cheese and remaining 1/2 teaspoon cumin | Simmer 30 minutes more, stirring often to prevent burning | Serve with sour cream, shredded cheddar, and warm cornbread

ingredients: 2 tbsp canola oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 celery ribs (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced, optional), 4 cloves garlic (minced, divided), 500g ground beef, 1 can (400g) whole tomatoes (crushed by hand), 1 can (400g) kidney beans (with liquid), 2 tbsp chili powder (divided), 1 tsp dried basil, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp ground coriander, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1/2 tsp black pepper, salt to taste
instructions: Heat a large stockpot over high heat for about a minute, then add oil, onions, celery, green pepper if using, and a little garlic | Reduce heat to medium-high and sautÃ© for a couple of minutes, stirring frequently | Add the ground beef, breaking it up as you add it â€” continue to sautÃ© for a couple of minutes | Sprinkle in 1 tablespoon chili powder and cook for 3-4 minutes until the meat is browned | Lower heat to medium and add the remaining garlic, kidney beans with their liquid, and crushed tomatoes | Stir everything together and add the remaining spices (rub basil and oregano between your palms to release flavor) and remaining chili powder | Taste and add salt if needed | Lower heat and simmer for at least 1 hour, up to 3 hours, stirring occasionally

ingredients: For crust: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs, 1/3 cup unsalted butter (melted), 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tsp lemon zest. For filling: 3 large egg yolks, 1 can (400g) sweetened condensed milk, 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice, 1 tbsp lemon zest, 1 cup fresh blueberries

ingredients: 4 white fish fillets (about 150g each), 1/4 cup dry white wine, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 large egg (beaten), 1/2 cup walnuts (finely chopped), 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp chili powder, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/4 tsp white pepper

ingredients: 4 large sweet onions (sliced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1 tsp dried dill weed, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded, divided), 1 large egg, 1 can (400g) corn (drained), 1 box cornbread mix, 1/4 tsp hot pepper sauce

ingredients: 1/2 cup plain flour, 1/2 cup self-rising flour, 2 large eggs (lightly beaten), 1 cup water, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp vegetable oil, cooking spray

ingredients: 60ml vanilla vodka, 30ml triple sec, soda water or lemon-lime soda to taste, ice cubes
instructions: Pour vanilla vodka into an ice-filled glass | Add the triple sec | Top with soda to taste and stir gently | Serve immediately

recipe_name: Penne Salad with Peppers and Peas
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream, 1/4 cup skim milk, 1/4 cup fat-free mayonnaise, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp dried parsley flakes, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 400g penne pasta (cooked and cooled), 1 cup frozen peas (thawed), 2 red bell peppers (diced)

ingredients: 1 cup frozen green peas (thawed), 1/2 cup low-fat sharp cheddar cheese (cubed), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1/4 cup low-fat mayonnaise, 1/4 cup Miracle Whip light, 1 tsp prepared mustard, mixed salad greens for serving

ingredients: 12 mini sweet bell peppers (tops cut as lids, seeds left), 1 medium onion (finely diced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1/2 cup medium-grain rice, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 1 tsp dried mint, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup water, grape tomatoes for garnish, olive oil for drizzling

ingredients: 2 ears fresh corn (cooked and kernels cut off), 2 medium yellow squash (diced), 2 tbsp water, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper

ingredients: 2 ears fresh corn (cooked and kernels cut off), 2 medium yellow squash (diced), 2 tbsp water, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper

ingredients: 450g dried black beans (soaked overnight with oregano, cumin, and bay leaf), 9 cups water, 1 medium yellow onion (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 2 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tsp salt, fresh cilantro for garnish

ingredients: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup water, 3 cups cubed seedless watermelon, 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice, 1 cup carbonated water (chilled), ice cubes

ingredients: For chicken: 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1 tsp dried parsley, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp ginger paste, 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts. ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 cups whole milk (warmed), 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/4 tsp ground ginger, 1 tsp dried basil, 1/2 cup fresh Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 Roma tomatoes (diced), fresh basil for garnish

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, fresh fruit for serving

ingredients: 500g chicken tenders, 1 cup buttermilk, 2 cloves garlic (mashed with 1/2 tsp salt), 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, 1/2 cup plus 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 cup Italian breadcrumbs, black pepper to taste

ingredients: 6 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 3/4 cup light brown sugar, 8 slices thick bread, 6 large eggs, 1 1/2 cups whole milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup pecans (chopped), powdered sugar and maple syrup for serving

ingredients: 1/4 cup loose black tea, 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves, 8 cups boiling water (divided), 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice, 1/2 cup cherry juice, lemon slices for garnish
instructions: Steep the loose tea and fresh mint in 5 cups of boiling water for 20 minutes | Strain the tea mixture and allow to cool | Add the sugar to the remaining 3 cups of boiling water â€” stir until dissolved | Pour the sugar water into a pitcher and let cool | Once cooled, add the lemon juice and cherry juice, followed by the tea mixture | Chill in the refrigerator | Serve in tall glasses over ice, garnished with a lemon slice

ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (chopped), 3/4 cup heavy cream, 3 tbsp champagne or sparkling wine, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, unsweetened cocoa powder for dusting
instructions: Line a 23 x 12cm (9 x 5-inch) dish or tin with plastic wrap | Place the chopped chocolate in a large heatproof bowl | Heat the cream in a pan until gently bubbling â€” pour half over the chocolate, leave for 1 minute, then mix with an electric whisk | Add the remaining cream and continue mixing until smooth and glossy | Stir in the champagne and vanilla | Pour the truffle mixture into the prepared tin, smooth the top, and chill for at least 4 hours to set | Using a hot knife, cut into bite-sized squares | Dust with cocoa powder before serving

ingredients: 1/2 sweet onion (diced), 1 cup fresh pineapple (diced), 1/2 red bell pepper (diced), 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, pinch of salt
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients and stir until well blended | Let stand for 15 minutes to allow the flavors to meld | Serve with grilled fish or chicken

ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 1/4 cups granulated sugar, 250g dark chocolate (150g melted, 50g chopped), 3 large eggs plus 1 egg yolk, 3/4 cup plain flour, 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 1/2 tsp baking powder, pinch of salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 180Â°C (160Â°C fan) and line a 23cm square baking tin with baking paper | Beat butter and sugar for a few minutes until white and fluffy | Melt 150g chocolate in a bowl over simmering water â€” remove from heat | Chop the remaining 50g chocolate into small pieces | Lightly beat the eggs and extra yolk | Sift together flour, cocoa, baking powder, and salt | With the mixer on low, add the eggs a little at a time to the butter mixture | Remove from the mixer and fold in the melted chocolate, then the flour mixture â€” gently but firmly | Pour into the prepared tin and bake for 25-30 minutes until risen and slightly softer in the middle | A toothpick should come out slightly sticky but not with raw batter | Cool before cutting â€” they will solidify as they cool

ingredients: 1 whole chicken (about 1.5 kg), 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh rosemary (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh thyme, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 lemon (halved), 4 sprigs fresh herbs for cavity
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) | Pat the chicken dry with paper towels | Mix olive oil with minced garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper | Rub the herb mixture all over the chicken, including under the skin | Place lemon halves and extra herb sprigs inside the cavity | Place the chicken in a roasting pan and roast for 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 165Â°F (74Â°C) | Let rest for 10 minutes before carving | Serve with the pan juices

ingredients: 4 salmon fillets (about 150g each, skin-on), 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp sea salt, 1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper. For roasted peppers: 2 red bell peppers, 1 tbsp olive oil. For dressing: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp red wine vinegar, 1 tbsp capers. For serving: mixed salad leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) | Place bell peppers on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and roast for 20 minutes until scorched â€” place in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and set aside | Place a solid baking sheet in the oven to heat for 3 minutes | Mix together olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper â€” brush this spiced oil all over the salmon | Lightly oil the hot baking sheet and place the salmon skin-side down â€” bake for 10-12 minutes until cooked but still pink inside | Peel the cooled peppers, remove seeds, and cut into strips | Whisk together the dressing ingredients | Toss salad leaves with the dressing and place on serving plates | Top with the salmon and arrange roasted pepper strips and capers on top

ingredients: 1 package Oreo cookies, 1 cup whole milk, 2 cups whipped topping (thawed)
instructions: Set aside 6 cookies for later use | Twist the remaining cookies apart, dunk briefly in milk until slightly softened (do not get soggy), and arrange in a layer in a 13 x 9-inch pan | Spread a thin layer of whipped topping over the cookies | Repeat the layers until all cookies and whipped topping are used, ending with whipped topping | Crumble the 6 reserved cookies and sprinkle over the top | Refrigerate until chilled | Slice and serve

ingredients: 1/2 cup water, 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, 1/2 medium onion (roughly chopped), 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 green onions, 2 tbsp canola oil, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground allspice, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp ground black pepper, 1 tsp dried thyme, 1/4 tsp ground cayenne pepper, 4 pork chops
instructions: Place water, lemon juice, onion, brown sugar, green onions, oil, salt, allspice, cinnamon, black pepper, thyme, and cayenne in a blender â€” purÃ©e until smooth | Reserve 1/2 cup of the marinade in a small bowl, cover, and refrigerate for basting | Place the pork chops in a shallow dish and pour the remaining marinade over them â€” cover and refrigerate at least 12 hours, up to 24 hours | Heat grill to medium heat | Remove pork from the marinade and grill 4-5 inches from the heat | Turn chops frequently, basting with the reserved marinade | Cook until medium done (160Â°F / 71Â°C), about 8-11 minutes | Let rest briefly and serve

ingredients: 500g ground turkey, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp fresh ground pepper, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/4 cup chicken broth
instructions: Combine ground turkey and all dry spices in a large bowl â€” mix together thoroughly | Add chicken broth and mix well â€” let stand for 15 to 20 minutes | Form the turkey into 8 patties, approximately 3/4 inch thick | Cook in a nonstick skillet over medium heat for 7-8 minutes on each side, or grill on an oiled grate | Serve hot

ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/3 cup vegetable shortening, 1 cup warm water (approximately)
instructions: Place flour, salt, and baking powder in a bowl and mix well | Add shortening and mix thoroughly with your hands, a pastry cutter, or two knives | Pour in warm water and mix â€” finish mixing with your hands | Roll the dough into a ball and knead for 6-7 minutes | Place back in the bowl, cover, and let rest for 15-30 minutes | Divide into approximately 32 small balls | Lightly flour a surface and roll each ball into a 6-8 inch tortilla | Cook on a griddle or cast iron skillet over low heat until the top starts to bubble, then flip for a few more seconds | Serve warm

ingredients: 400g penne pasta, 1 can (400g) artichoke hearts (drained, liquid reserved), 2 cups fresh spinach, 1/2 red onion (diced), 1 can (400g) chickpeas (drained and rinsed), 2 tbsp white wine vinegar, 3 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp hot pepper sauce, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook penne for 8-10 minutes until tender but firm â€” drain and rinse under cold water | In a large bowl, toss pasta with artichoke hearts, spinach, red onion, and chickpeas | Whisk together the reserved artichoke liquid, vinegar, olive oil, salt, pepper, hot pepper sauce, and parsley | Toss the dressing with the pasta mixture until coated | Serve chilled or at room temperature

ingredients: 1 cup mustard powder, 1 cup white vinegar, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup water, 1/2 tsp salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan | Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally | Pour into a sterilized jar and refrigerate | Use as a condiment with meats or in dressings

ingredients: 4 large eggs, 2 cups whole milk, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: In a medium saucepan, whisk together eggs, milk, cornstarch, and sugar until smooth | Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon | Remove from heat and stir in vanilla | Pour into a bowl and let cool | Serve chilled over fruit or desserts

ingredients: 450g dried pinto beans (soaked overnight), 4 cups water, 2 andouille sausages (sliced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 bell pepper (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 bay leaf, 1 tsp dried oregano, 2 fresh parsley stems, 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1 tsp salt, cornbread for serving
instructions: Soak beans for at least 4 hours, best overnight â€” drain | Add 4 cups fresh water, beans, and all other ingredients to a large crock pot â€” stir well | Cook on low for 8 hours until the beans are tender | Remove the bay leaf and parsley stems | Ladle into bowls and serve with cornbread

ingredients: 500g beef (cubed), 250g pork or ham (cubed), 3 cups sauerkraut (drained), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 medium potatoes (cubed), 1 carrot (grated), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2 bay leaves, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 6 black peppercorns, 2 cups water, sour cream for serving
instructions: In a large pot, combine beef, pork, and boiling water â€” add the whole onion, potatoes, and carrot | Boil for 1.5 hours until the meat is half-cooked | Add the sauerkraut, the rest of the vegetables cut into strips, and the seasonings | Continue to boil for 1 more hour until all meat and vegetables are tender | Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp lemon extract, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1 tbsp lemon zest. For glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar, 2-3 tbsp fresh lemon juice, sliced almonds for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Beat cream cheese, butter, sugar, vanilla, and lemon extract in a mixer until creamy | Add flour, baking soda, and lemon zest â€” mix until well blended | Chill the dough for 1 hour or overnight | Roll out on a well-floured surface to about 1/8-inch thickness and cut into star shapes | Bake on greased cookie sheets for 8-10 minutes until the edges start to lightly brown â€” cool on a wire rack | Mix powdered sugar with enough lemon juice to make a drizzle â€” glaze the cookies and immediately press sliced almonds into the glaze

ingredients: 4 cups white cabbage (shredded), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 2 green onions (sliced), 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 100g Stilton cheese (crumbled)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the shredded cabbage, diced pepper, and sliced green onions â€” refrigerate for at least 1 hour | In a separate bowl, combine sour cream, mayonnaise, lemon juice, sugar, salt, and crumbled Stilton to make the dressing â€” refrigerate for 1 hour | To serve, pour the dressing over the cabbage mixture and toss well | Serve immediately

ingredients: 3 1/2 cups all-purpose flour (divided), 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 1/4 tsp fast-rising yeast, 1/2 tsp salt, 3/4 cup milk, 1/4 cup water, 3 tbsp unsalted butter, additional melted butter for brushing
instructions: Combine 3/4 cup flour, sugar, undissolved yeast, and salt in a large bowl | Heat milk, water, and butter until very warm (120-130Â°F) and add to the flour mixture | Beat for 2 minutes at medium speed with an electric mixer | Add 1/4 cup flour and beat for 2 minutes at high speed | Stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough â€” knead on a lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 8-10 minutes | Cover and let rest for 10 minutes | Divide dough into 12 equal pieces and shape into balls â€” place in a greased 8-inch round pan | Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 30 minutes | Bake at 375Â°F (190Â°C) for 20 minutes until golden | Remove from pan and brush with additional melted butter | Serve warm

ingredients: 500g butter beans (canned or pre-cooked), 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 2 carrots (diced), 1 cup frozen spinach, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 sprigs fresh thyme, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 andouille sausages (sliced), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a medium stock pot, bring all ingredients to a boil | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes until the beans are tender and the sausage has cooked through | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable shortening, 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 tbsp red food coloring, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup whole milk, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tbsp white vinegar, cream cheese frosting for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease and flour cake pans | Make a paste of cocoa powder and red food coloring â€” set aside | Cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy | Add eggs one at a time, beating well | Add vanilla and the cocoa-food coloring paste | Sift together flour and salt â€” add alternately with milk, beating well | Dissolve baking soda in vinegar and add to the batter while foaming | Pour into prepared pans and bake for about 40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool completely and frost with cream cheese icing

ingredients: 4 salmon fillets (about 150g each), 2 tbsp wasabi paste, 1/4 cup white sesame seeds, 2 tbsp black sesame seeds, 2 tbsp vegetable oil. For vinaigrette: 3 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1 tbsp grated fresh ginger, 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Make the vinaigrette: whisk together lime juice, ginger, olive oil, salt, and pepper â€” set aside | Combine white and black sesame seeds on a plate | Brush each salmon fillet with a thin layer of wasabi paste and season with salt and pepper | Roll the salmon in the sesame seeds to coat evenly on all sides | Heat oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat | Cook the salmon for about 1 minute on each of the 4 sides (including the narrow edges), lowering the heat if the sesame seeds brown too quickly | Place on plates and drizzle with the ginger lime vinaigrette | Serve immediately

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 jar (200g) marshmallow creme, 2 cups whipped topping (thawed), 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup crushed pineapple (drained, optional), fresh strawberries for garnish (optional)
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth | Add marshmallow creme and mix until completely blended | Fold in whipped topping, vanilla, and crushed pineapple if using | Frost any type of cake and top with fresh strawberry slices if desired | Makes enough for about 2 cakes depending on how heavily you frost

ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes (scrubbed), 250g bulk pork sausage, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup cooked ham (diced), 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 1/4 cup sour cream, 2 tbsp ranch or creamy salad dressing, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) â€” scrub and pierce potatoes, then bake for about 1 hour until tender (or microwave on high for 12-14 minutes) | Meanwhile, cook sausage in a skillet over medium heat until no longer pink â€” drain | When potatoes are cool enough to handle, cut in half lengthwise and scoop out the pulp, leaving a 1/4-inch shell | In a large bowl, mash the potato pulp with butter | Stir in sausage, cheese, ham, bacon, sour cream, salad dressing, salt, and pepper | Spoon the mixture back into the potato shells | Place on ungreased baking sheets and bake at 400Â°F for 30 minutes until golden brown | Serve hot

ingredients: 5 sheets phyllo dough (or prepared crust), cooking spray, 8 oz fat-free cream cheese (softened), 1 can (425g) pumpkin purÃ©e, 1/2 cup skim milk, 1 tsp pumpkin pie spice, 2 tbsp maple syrup or honey, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Layer phyllo sheets in a pie dish sprayed with cooking spray, pressing in lightly â€” trim excess with scissors | Combine cream cheese, pumpkin, milk, pumpkin pie spice, maple syrup, and vanilla in a blender â€” blend until smooth | Pour into the prepared crust | Brush the crust edges with skim milk and wrap with aluminum foil | Bake for 30 minutes, removing foil for the last 15 minutes to brown the edges | Cool and refrigerate before serving

ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut flour, 2 tbsp granulated sugar or sweetener, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 4 large eggs, 1/4 cup coconut milk, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp lemon zest, butter for serving
instructions: Whisk together half the coconut flour with all the other dry ingredients | Add the eggs, coconut milk, vanilla, and lemon zest â€” whisk thoroughly | Slowly add the remaining coconut flour until the batter reaches the right consistency | Heat a pan to medium heat and lightly grease | Pour small portions of batter (coconut flour pancakes work best when made small) | Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden | Serve topped with butter

ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cooked and sliced), 1 can (400ml) coconut milk, 2 cups water, 1 tsp lemon zest, 4 kaffir lime leaves, 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2 dried chili peppers, 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (loosely chopped), 1 tbsp vegetable oil
instructions: SautÃ© chicken breasts in oil over medium-high heat until the center is no longer pink â€” slice into thin strips | Warm coconut milk in a medium saucepan with water | Add lemon zest, kaffir lime leaves, dried chili peppers, ginger, and brown sugar | Loosely chop cilantro and add to the saucepan | Add the sliced chicken and let simmer for 10-15 minutes to allow flavors to meld | Serve hot in bowls

ingredients: 1/4 cup flavored vinegar (red or white wine vinegar), 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 clove garlic (minced, optional)
instructions: Combine vinegar, mustard, salt, pepper, and garlic in a small bowl | Slowly whisk in the olive oil until emulsified | Taste and adjust the ratio of oil to vinegar as desired | Store in a sealed jar in the refrigerator

ingredients: 3 cups broccoli florets (cut into 1/2-inch pieces), 2 tbsp water, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 Roma tomatoes (cut into wedges), 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese (shredded)
instructions: Wash and cut broccoli florets into 1/2-inch pieces | Place broccoli and water in a shallow microwave-safe dish â€” cover and microwave on high for 5-7 minutes until tender, stirring once | Drain | Stir in oregano, pepper, lemon juice, and tomato wedges | Sprinkle cheese on top | Cover and microwave briefly to melt the cheese | Let stand for 2 minutes before serving

ingredients: For dry mix: 2 cups plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp caster sugar. To make pancakes: 150g dry mix, 1 large egg, 3/4 cup whole milk, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted)
instructions: Make the dry mix: combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and sugar in a bowl â€” store in an airtight container | To make pancakes: mix 150g of the dry mix with egg, milk, and melted butter until smooth | Heat a flat griddle or non-stick frying pan without oil | Spoon 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons of batter per pancake onto the hot griddle | When bubbles appear on the surface, flip and cook until golden brown on both sides â€” about 1 minute per side | Serve warm

ingredients: 4 catfish fillets (cut into 1-inch strips), 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1/2 tsp hot pepper sauce, 2 cups shredded cabbage, 1/2 cup cornmeal, 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 8 corn or flour tortillas (warmed), lime wedges for serving
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine lime juice, mayonnaise, and hot pepper sauce â€” add cabbage and toss to make the slaw | Rinse fish strips and pat dry â€” season with Cajun seasoning | Combine cornmeal and flour in a bowl â€” add fish and toss to coat | Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook catfish in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and flaky | Warm tortillas and layer with fish and slaw | Serve with lime wedges and extra hot sauce

ingredients: 800g plum tomatoes (cored, purÃ©ed, and strained), 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 cup dry red wine, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/4 cup fresh basil (torn)
instructions: Prepare the tomatoes: core, roughly chop, and purÃ©e in a food processor â€” strain to remove seeds and skins | Heat olive oil in a large pot and cook the diced onion over medium heat, stirring, until soft | Add garlic and cook until soft without browning | Add the tomato purÃ©e, wine, sugar, salt, and pepper â€” reduce heat to low and simmer until thickened, about 15 minutes | Stir in fresh basil just before serving | Serve over pasta

ingredients: 4 slices bacon (diced), 1 cup couscous, 2 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 3 tbsp olive oil, 3 cups iceberg lettuce (chopped), 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, cook bacon until crisp â€” transfer to paper towels to drain | Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of the bacon fat | Return saucepan to medium-high heat, add couscous, and toast, stirring often, until lightly browned, 2-4 minutes | Spread toasted couscous on a baking sheet to cool for 25 minutes | Make the dressing: whisk together vinegar, lemon juice, and mustard â€” slowly whisk in olive oil | In a large bowl, combine lettuce and tomatoes | Add the cooled couscous, reserved bacon, and dressing â€” toss well | Season with salt and pepper and serve

ingredients: For aspic: 1 tbsp unflavored gelatin, 1/4 cup cold water, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup strong black coffee (hot), 2 tbsp Kahlua. For mousse: 1 tbsp unflavored gelatin, 2 tbsp cold water, 3 large egg yolks, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup hot milk, 200g bittersweet chocolate (melted), 1 cup heavy cream (whipped), chocolate curls for garnish
instructions: Line a buttered 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with parchment paper | Make the aspic: sprinkle gelatin over cold water and let stand for 1 minute â€” add sugar, hot coffee, and Kahlua, stirring until dissolved | Pour into the prepared pan and refrigerate until set, about 20 minutes | Make the mousse: sprinkle gelatin over cold water and let stand for 1 minute â€” whisk in egg yolks and sugar | Stir in hot milk and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon | Stir in melted chocolate and let cool | Whip cream until stiff and fold into the cooled chocolate mixture | Spread the mousse evenly over the set coffee aspic | Cover and chill for 3 hours | Invert onto a serving platter, remove paper, and garnish with chocolate curls

ingredients: For aspic: 1 tbsp unflavored gelatin, 1/4 cup cold water, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup strong black coffee (hot), 2 tbsp Kahlua. For mousse: 1 tbsp unflavored gelatin, 2 tbsp cold water, 3 large egg yolks, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup hot milk, 200g bittersweet chocolate (melted), 1 cup heavy cream (whipped), chocolate curls for garnish
instructions: Line a buttered 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with parchment paper | Make the aspic: sprinkle gelatin over cold water and let stand for 1 minute — add sugar, hot coffee, and Kahlua, stirring until dissolved | Pour into the prepared pan and refrigerate until set, about 20 minutes | Make the mousse: sprinkle gelatin over cold water and let stand for 1 minute — whisk in egg yolks and sugar | Stir in hot milk and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon | Stir in melted chocolate and let cool | Whip cream until stiff and fold into the cooled chocolate mixture | Spread the mousse evenly over the set coffee aspic | Cover and chill for 3 hours | Invert onto a serving platter, remove paper, and garnish with chocolate curls

ingredients: 1/4 cup raisins, 1/4 cup almonds, 200g white mushrooms, 1/2 cup edamame, 1/4 cup green lentils (cooked), 1/4 cup brown lentils (cooked), 1 cup Israeli couscous (cooked, divided), 1 tsp curry powder, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp dried porcini mushrooms (rehydrated), 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 2 tbsp canola oil, 1/2 cup ketchup, 2 tbsp pomegranate molasses, burger buns and mesclun greens for serving
instructions: In a food processor, combine raisins and almonds â€” process until finely chopped | Add mushrooms and process until coarsely chopped | Add edamame, lentils, and half the couscous â€” process until coarsely chopped | Stir curry powder into lemon juice and add to the processor along with porcini â€” process to a coarse paste | Remove to a bowl, fold in the remaining couscous, and season with salt | Form into 6 patties about 1-inch thick | Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet and cook patties over moderate heat, turning once, until browned, about 6 minutes | Combine ketchup with pomegranate molasses | Serve patties on buns with pomegranate ketchup and mesclun greens

ingredients: 500g dried black-eyed peas, 1 ham hock (scored), 2 tbsp bacon grease, 6 cups water, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Add water to a large pot and start to bring to a boil | Add the ham hock and boil for about 20 minutes to season the water | Add bacon grease and stir until melted | Add the black-eyed peas | Boil at a rapid boil for the first 20 minutes, then reduce to a low boil, cover, and continue cooking until the peas are tender | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Serve hot

ingredients: 250g pork tenderloin (thinly sliced), 3 tbsp hoisin sauce, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp fresh ginger (grated), 200g pasta or noodles (cooked), 1 tbsp vegetable oil, 2 cups fresh spinach, 1/2 cup water chestnuts (sliced), 1 carrot (julienned), 3 green onions (sliced)
instructions: Cook pasta until just tender â€” drain and set aside | Whisk together hoisin sauce, garlic, red pepper flakes, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and ginger â€” pour half over the pork strips and toss to coat â€” let stand for 15 minutes | Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a wok over medium-high heat â€” add pork and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, then remove | Heat 1 tablespoon oil in the wok â€” add spinach, water chestnuts, carrot, and green onion and stir-fry until the spinach is wilted, about 3 minutes | Add the cooked pasta, pork, and remaining hoisin sauce mixture â€” cook for about 2 minutes until heated through | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1.5 kg boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1/2 cup Italian dressing, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) cream of chicken soup, 1/2 cup chicken broth, 8 oz Neufchatel cheese (cubed), cooking spray
instructions: Place chicken in a slow cooker and coat with Italian dressing â€” cook on low for 4-6 hours | In a medium saucepan, sautÃ© onion and garlic in cooking spray for 1-2 minutes | Add cream of chicken soup, chicken broth, and Neufchatel cheese â€” stir until smooth and consistent | Add the pan mixture to the slow cooker and cook for 1 more hour | Serve the chicken with the sauce over rice or pasta

ingredients: 400g spaghettini, 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes (chopped), 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, salt and black pepper, 200g fresh asparagus (cut and blanched), 200g fresh crabmeat, 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese, 1/4 cup fresh basil leaves (torn)
instructions: SautÃ© garlic in olive oil over medium heat for 2 minutes | Add fresh diced tomatoes, sun-dried tomatoes, and red pepper flakes | Cover and simmer for about 5 minutes â€” season with salt and pepper | Cook asparagus in boiling water for 2 minutes, then transfer to the skillet with the sauce | Cook spaghettini in salted boiling water until al dente â€” drain | Bring the sauce to a simmer, mix in crabmeat and mascarpone, and blend well | Add the pasta and basil â€” toss just to heat through and serve immediately

ingredients: 30ml crÃ¨me de cacao, 30ml hazelnut liqueur (such as Frangelico), 30ml heavy cream, ice cubes
instructions: Pour the crÃ¨me de cacao and hazelnut liqueur into an ice-filled highball glass | Add the cream and stir gently | Serve immediately

ingredients: 200g smoked salmon, 1 can (200g) tuna (drained), 1/2 fennel bulb, 2 tbsp fresh chives, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 2 cups whole milk, 1/2 cup low-fat cottage cheese, 400g pasta (cooked)
instructions: Blend salmon, tuna, fennel, and chives in a food processor | Melt butter in a pot over low heat â€” stir in flour, salt, and pepper | Add milk bit by bit, stirring well after each addition until all the milk is added | Bring to a boil, stirring constantly, and boil for 2 minutes | Add cottage cheese and stir | Blend the sauce with the seafood mixture in a food processor until smooth | Return to the pot and heat through over low heat | Serve over cooked pasta

ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles (cooked), 200g mushrooms (sliced), 1 can (400g) whole tomatoes, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried rosemary, 1/2 tsp salt, 500g minced beef (browned), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 cups whole milk, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 180Â°C (350Â°F) | Make the meat sauce: brown the minced beef, add tomatoes with their liquid, onion, garlic, oregano, rosemary, and salt â€” simmer for 40 minutes until liquid has almost evaporated | Make the cheese sauce: melt butter, stir in flour, and gradually add milk â€” cook until thickened, then add cheddar cheese and stir until melted | Layer in an ovenproof dish: noodles, half the meat sauce, half the cheese sauce â€” repeat | Sprinkle the top with breadcrumbs and Parmesan | Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling

ingredients: 500g large shrimp (peeled and deveined), 1 tsp salt, 4 cloves garlic (sliced), 3 tbsp olive oil, 100g cooked ham (diced), 1/4 tsp hot red pepper flakes, 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1/4 cup dry sherry, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), crusty bread for serving
instructions: Rinse shrimp and pat dry â€” sprinkle both sides with salt and let stand between paper towels for 10 minutes | In a large heavy skillet, cook sliced garlic in olive oil over moderate heat, stirring, until golden â€” remove with a slotted spoon and set aside | Add ham and red pepper flakes and cook for 3-5 minutes until the ham deepens in color | Add bell pepper and cook until softened | Add shrimp and sautÃ© over moderately high heat, turning, for 3 minutes | Add the sherry and reserved garlic â€” simmer until the shrimp are just cooked through | Transfer to a heated serving dish, sprinkle with parsley, and serve with crusty bread

ingredients: 1 medium head green cabbage (cored and finely shredded), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 tbsp light soy sauce, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/2 tsp caraway seeds, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper
instructions: Cut the central core from the cabbage and shred the leaves finely | Heat oil in a wok until quite hot | Stir-fry the cabbage for about 2 minutes | Toss in the soy sauce, lemon juice, caraway seeds, and pepper â€” stir well | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 medium baking potatoes (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 500g lean ground beef, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup beer, 1/2 cup beef consommÃ©, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with green pepper and onion, 1/4 cup green olives (sliced), 1 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 can refrigerated breadstick dough, 1 tbsp garlic butter spread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Heat a large Dutch oven coated with cooking spray over medium heat â€” add potato and onion, cover, and cook for 7 minutes | Add beef, oregano, chili powder, cumin, salt, pepper, and garlic â€” cook uncovered for 7 minutes until browned | Sprinkle flour over the pan and cook for 1 minute | Gradually add beer, consommÃ©, and tomatoes â€” bring to a boil | Remove from heat and stir in olives and vinegar | Spoon into an 11 x 7-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray | Unroll breadstick dough and roll together into a 12 x 10-inch rectangle â€” place over the beef mixture | Cut 5 slits in the top and brush with garlic butter spread | Bake for 25 minutes until golden brown and bubbly | Let stand 10 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1 whole chicken (about 1.5 kg), water to cover
instructions: Fill a very large pot (at least 8 quarts) with enough water to completely cover the chicken | Bring the water to a boil without the chicken | Carefully add the chicken to the boiling water | As soon as the boiling stops, remove the chicken | Return the water to a boil, then carefully return the chicken to the pot and cover tightly | Turn off the heat but leave the pot on the burner | Leave untouched for exactly 1 hour | Remove the chicken from the water and let cool just enough to handle, then debone | Use the meat as desired

ingredients: 1 cup unsalted margarine (softened), 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 4 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp rum extract, 2 cups all-purpose flour (sifted)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325Â°F (160Â°C) and grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan | Cream margarine thoroughly, then add sugar gradually | Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each | Add vanilla and rum extracts | Add sifted flour a little at a time, blending well | Pour batter into the prepared pan | Bake for about 1 hour until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean | Cool in the pan for 10 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack

ingredients: 4 catfish fillets (about 150g each), 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 2 tbsp buttermilk, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp dried dill, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumbs, 1/2 tsp seasoned salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) and line a baking sheet with foil sprayed with nonstick cooking spray | Mix breadcrumbs with seasoned salt, black pepper, and cayenne in a bowl | In another bowl, combine mayonnaise, buttermilk, lemon zest, lemon juice, dill, and garlic | Brush fillets on both sides with the mayonnaise mixture | Coat evenly with the breadcrumb mixture | Place on the prepared baking sheet | Bake for 20-22 minutes until the fish flakes easily with a fork | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 prepared 9-inch pie crust (baked and cooled), 2/3 cup granulated sugar, 3 tbsp cornstarch, 3 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 1/2 cups water, 1 can (354ml) evaporated milk, 2 large egg yolks (beaten), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 ripe bananas (sliced), whipped cream sweetened with confectioners sugar for topping
instructions: Prepare and bake the pie crust â€” set aside to cool | Mix sugar, cornstarch, cocoa, and salt in a 2-quart saucepan | Stir in water and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until bubbly | Pour in evaporated milk and stir to blend | Spoon a little of the hot mixture into the beaten egg yolks, then return to the saucepan | Cook until bubbly and thickened, stirring constantly | Stir in butter and vanilla â€” let stand for 20 minutes | Pour half the cocoa mixture into the pie crust | Slice bananas directly onto the custard | Pour the remaining custard over the bananas | Cool completely and chill | Before serving, top with sweetened whipped cream

ingredients: 4 turkey cutlets (about 150g each), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 tsp dried tarragon (divided), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 shallots (minced), 1/3 cup dry white wine, 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Season turkey cutlets with salt, pepper, and 1 teaspoon tarragon | Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat | Add turkey and cook, turning once, until golden, 4-5 minutes â€” remove to a plate, leaving the drippings | Add shallots to the pan and cook until softened, about 1 minute | Add wine, raise heat to high, and cook, scraping up browned bits, until reduced by one-third, about 2 minutes | Add cream and the remaining 1 teaspoon tarragon â€” cook until the sauce slightly thickens, about 2 minutes | Return turkey and any juices to the sauce â€” cook until heated through, about 1 minute | Serve immediately

ingredients: 500g turkey breast (diced), 500g chicken breast (diced), 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp sweet paprika, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp mustard powder, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, pinch of cayenne, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1 yellow bell pepper (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 cups chicken stock, 2 tbsp dry milk powder, 8 oz fat-free cream cheese (cubed), 4 cups cooked long-grain rice
instructions: Mix together salt, onion powder, paprika, garlic powder, mustard, white pepper, nutmeg, and cayenne | Sprinkle diced turkey and chicken with 2 teaspoons of the seasoning mix | Heat oil in a heavy 5-quart pot over high heat â€” add the seasoned meat and cook until browned on all sides, 3-5 minutes | Add onions, peppers, mushrooms, and the remaining seasoning â€” cook for 4 minutes | Blend 1 cup stock, dry milk powder, and flour in a blender until smooth â€” add to the pot with the remaining stock | Bring to a gentle boil, then lower heat and simmer for 4-6 minutes | Remove 1 cup of liquid and blend with the cream cheese â€” stir back into the pot | Serve immediately over hot rice

ingredients: 4 cups fresh spinach (washed), 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese, 1/2 cup fresh blueberries, 1/4 cup walnuts or pecans (chopped), 3 tbsp balsamic vinaigrette or poppy seed dressing
instructions: Place cleaned spinach in a large bowl | Sprinkle with feta crumbles â€” keep bits on the smaller side | Add blueberries and nuts | Toss with salad dressing and chill | Serve cool, allowing guests to add more dressing as desired

ingredients: 2 cups fresh strawberries (halved), 2 cups fresh rhubarb (chopped), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 tbsp cornstarch, 1 cup old-fashioned rolled oats, 1/2 cup Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese (grated), 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1 tsp vanilla extract, vanilla ice cream for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Toss strawberries and rhubarb with sugar and cornstarch in a 9 x 9-inch glass baking dish | In a bowl, mix oats, Parmesan, and brown sugar | Stir vanilla into the melted butter and pour over the oat mixture â€” stir until wet and clumpy | Scatter the oat mixture over the fruit | Bake for about 20 minutes until the fruit is bubbling and the top is crisped | Serve warm with vanilla ice cream

ingredients: 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream, 1 tbsp orange zest, 1/2 cup white chocolate chips, 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips, 1/2 tsp orange extract, powdered sugar and cocoa powder for coating
instructions: In a saucepan, bring the heavy cream and orange zest to a gentle boil â€” immediately pour over both types of chocolate chips in a medium bowl | Let stand for about 1 minute, then whisk until smooth | Add the orange extract and stir well | Cover and chill for 30 minutes until the mixture begins to thicken slightly | Beat for 30 seconds until the color lightens â€” do not overbeat | Drop rounded teaspoons onto wax paper-lined baking sheets | Refrigerate for 30 minutes until firm enough to roll into small balls | Roll in a mixture of equal parts powdered sugar and cocoa powder | Keep refrigerated

ingredients: 250g seitan (cubed), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp vegan Worcestershire sauce, 2 tbsp dry sherry, 2 cups broccoli florets, 2 tangerines or mandarin oranges (segmented), 2 green onions (sliced), steamed rice for serving
instructions: Combine seitan, bell pepper, garlic, ginger, red pepper flakes, soy sauce, rice vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, and sherry in a slow cooker | Cover and cook on low for 6 hours | During the last 30 minutes, add broccoli | Before serving, mix in tangerine segments and green onions | Serve over hot rice

ingredients: 2 cups green cabbage (finely chopped), 1 carrot (finely chopped), 1 apple (finely chopped), 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 2 tbsp skim milk, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice
instructions: Finely chop the cabbage, carrot, and apple (a food processor works well) | In a separate bowl, mix together sugar, pepper, salt, mayonnaise, milk, vinegar, and lemon juice | Pour the dressing over the cabbage mixture and toss well | Chill and serve

ingredients: For basic batter: 1 cup sourdough starter, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 cup water. For waffles: 2 large eggs (separated), 1/4 cup milk, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1 cup all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp baking powder
instructions: The night before: combine sourdough starter, 1 cup flour, 2 tablespoons sugar, and water in a large container â€” cover loosely and let sit at room temperature for 6-12 hours | The next morning: beat egg whites until stiff peaks form | In a medium bowl, beat egg yolks, milk, and melted butter â€” stir in 1 cup of the basic batter | In a separate bowl, sift together flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and baking soda | Stir into the egg yolk mixture and let rest for 10 minutes | Gently fold in the beaten egg whites | Ladle batter onto a preheated waffle iron and cook according to the manufacturer's instructions | Serve immediately

ingredients: 3 tbsp vegan margarine, 1 jar (200g) marshmallow creme or vegan marshmallow fluff, 4 cups crispy rice cereal
instructions: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat | Add marshmallow creme and cook over low heat for about 5 minutes, stirring constantly | Remove from heat and add crispy rice cereal â€” stir until well coated | Using a greased spatula, press the mixture evenly into a greased 9-inch square pan | Let cool completely, then cut into squares

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy cream, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 vanilla bean (split and scraped), 50g dark chocolate (melted, optional)
instructions: Combine cream, milk, and sugar in a medium saucepan over medium heat â€” bring to a simmer, then remove from heat | Scrape the vanilla seeds into the milk mixture, add the bean, and let sit for 30 minutes | Strain into a clean bowl, discarding the bean | Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight | Transfer to an ice cream maker and freeze according to the manufacturer's directions | If adding chocolate, melt it in the microwave in 20-second intervals until smooth â€” drizzle into the gelato during the last 2 minutes of churning | Scoop into bowls and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar, 3 large eggs, 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple (undrained), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup cornmeal, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup shredded coconut, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 prepared pie shell
