instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | In a large saucepan, combine sugar, eggs, pineapple with juice, flour, cornmeal, salt, coconut, butter, and vanilla | Cook over medium heat until the filling is thick, stirring constantly | Pour into the prepared pie shell | Bake for about 20 minutes until firm | Cool on a wire rack before serving

ingredients: 2 cups long-grain white rice, 3 cups cold water
instructions: Pour the rice into a mesh strainer and rinse under cold running water, stirring with your hand until the water runs clear | Combine the rinsed rice and cold water in a medium saucepan | Bring to a boil over medium-high heat and boil for 2 minutes | Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook for 18 minutes | Remove from heat and let rest covered for 5 minutes | Fluff with a fork and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 kg chicken wings, 1 cup orange juice, 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp ketchup, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp ground ginger, 2 green onions (chopped)
instructions: Place chicken wings in a shallow dish or zip-top bag | Whisk together orange juice, honey, soy sauce, ketchup, garlic, and ginger | Add 1 cup of the mixture to the wings â€” reserve the remaining mixture | Cover and chill for 1 hour | Remove wings from the marinade, discarding the used marinade | Grill wings covered over medium-high heat for 17-20 minutes, turning occasionally | Meanwhile, bring the reserved orange juice mixture to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 25 minutes until reduced by half | Toss the warm wings with 1/4 cup of the reduced sauce | Transfer to a platter, sprinkle with green onions, and serve with the remaining sauce

ingredients: 4 ripe bananas (peeled and mashed), 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple with juice, 3 cups granulated sugar, 1 package (57g) powdered pectin
instructions: Peel and mash the bananas, then add the pineapple with juice | Add sugar to the fruit mixture and pour into a large enameled pot | Stir over low heat until the sugar dissolves | Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring continuously â€” boil for 1 minute | Remove from heat, stir in pectin, and stir for 5 minutes | Skim and ladle into hot sterilized canning jars | Process in a water bath for 10 minutes if desired | Store in a cool dark place

ingredients: 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 100g shiitake mushrooms (sliced), 1 carrot (julienned), 2 shallots (sliced), 2 tbsp sake, 2 tbsp Japanese soy sauce, 2 1/2 cups water, 200g asparagus spears (cut into pieces), 1 cup snow peas, 1 tbsp arrowroot powder mixed with 2 tbsp water, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat â€” add shiitakes, carrots, and shallots and cook, stirring frequently, 8-10 minutes until mushrooms have released their juices | Add sake and soy sauce â€” increase heat and simmer rapidly for about 3 minutes until syrupy | Stir in water and bring to a boil â€” reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes | Add asparagus and simmer 3-5 minutes until tender | Stir in snow peas and the arrowroot mixture â€” cook, stirring constantly, 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens | Remove from heat and stir in rice vinegar | Ladle over rice in shallow bowls

ingredients: 500g lean rump steak (very thinly sliced), 1 medium onion (sliced), 2 carrots (julienned), 2 celery stalks (sliced), 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 1 green bell pepper (sliced), 1 cup broccoli florets, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 1 cup beef stock, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 3 tbsp black bean sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp fish sauce
instructions: Slice beef very thinly diagonally | Prepare all vegetables as stated | Blend cornstarch into the beef stock until smooth â€” set aside | Heat oil in a wok over high heat | Brown the beef in batches â€” set aside | Clean out the wok and add all the vegetables at once â€” stir-fry until just tender but not overcooked | Add black bean sauce, sugar, fish sauce, and the beef stock mixture â€” stir quickly to make a sauce | Return the beef and vegetables to the wok and stir-fry for 1 minute more for crunchy vegetables, or simmer on low for 5 minutes for softer | Serve over rice

ingredients: 1 bag (900g) frozen hash brown potatoes, 6 large eggs, 1/2 cup whole milk, 6 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish | Cook bacon until crisp â€” crumble and set aside | Layer half the hash browns in the bottom of the dish and sprinkle with salt, pepper, onion powder, and garlic powder â€” add the remaining potatoes and season again | Top with crumbled bacon and cheese | Whisk together eggs and milk until incorporated â€” pour evenly over the layers | Bake uncovered for about 1 1/2 hours until the liquid is absorbed and the top is golden | Let cool for 5 minutes before cutting into squares | Serve hot

ingredients: 1.5 kg pork roast, 1 tsp garlic salt, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp paprika, 1 medium onion (sliced), 1/2 cup water
instructions: Preheat oven to 325Â°F (160Â°C) | Combine garlic salt, ginger, pepper, and paprika â€” rub over the entire roast | Place the roast fat-side up on a greased rack in a roasting pan | Top with sliced onion and pour water into the pan | Bake uncovered for 2 to 2 1/2 hours until a meat thermometer reads 160-170Â°F (71-77Â°C) | Let stand for 10-15 minutes before slicing | Serve with pan juices

ingredients: For cake: 2 cups cake flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 4 large eggs, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp dark rum, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup Coca-Cola (fresh and bubbly), 1/4 cup milk. For sauce: 1/2 cup Coca-Cola, 1/2 cup white sugar, 2 tbsp light corn syrup, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 325Â°F (160Â°C) and generously grease and flour a Bundt pan | Sift together flour, baking soda, and salt â€” set aside | Beat eggs with an electric mixer, gradually add softened butter and brown sugar, and beat until creamy | Beat in rum, vanilla, Coca-Cola, and milk | Gradually add the flour mixture, beating constantly until smooth | Pour into the prepared pan and bake for 45-60 minutes until a tester comes out clean | Make the sauce: bring Coca-Cola, white sugar, and corn syrup to a boil in a saucepan â€” cook until thickened | Remove from heat and stir in butter and rum | Serve the cake warm with plenty of sauce spooned over each serving

ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown rice, 1/3 cup maple syrup, 1 1/2 cups whole milk, 1 large egg (beaten), 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, cinnamon for serving
instructions: Mix together maple syrup, milk, egg, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a medium pot | Add the cooked rice and cook for 10 minutes over low to medium heat, stirring frequently, until thick and creamy | Serve warm with a sprinkle of cinnamon

ingredients: 1 can (425g) pumpkin purÃ©e, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 can (354ml) evaporated milk, 2 large eggs, 3/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 2 tbsp dark molasses, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 unbaked 9-inch pie shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) | Combine pumpkin, salt, evaporated milk, eggs, brown sugar, cloves, molasses, cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg in a large mixing bowl â€” mix until thoroughly combined | Pour into the unbaked pie shell | Bake for 45-55 minutes until a knife inserted comes out clean | Cool and serve

ingredients: 4 medium potatoes (cooked and mashed), 3 large eggs (beaten), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp lemon zest, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (cut into small pieces), 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 tsp almond extract, 1/4 tsp grated nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and lightly butter a casserole dish | To the mashed potatoes, add beaten eggs, sugar, salt, vanilla, almond extract, and lemon zest â€” mix well | Spoon into the prepared dish | Dot the top with butter pieces and sprinkle generously with grated nutmeg | Bake for 30 minutes until lightly browned | Serve warm

ingredients: 1 fennel bulb (cut into wedges), 1 acorn squash (peeled and cubed), 2 parsnips (peeled and sliced), 4 cloves garlic (smashed), 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp fresh sage (chopped), 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup vegetable or chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | Arrange vegetables and garlic in a shallow baking pan | Add oil, sage, salt, and pepper â€” toss to coat | Roast for about 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until almost tender | Add broth and bake 10 more minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine vinegar, 1/2 cup cider vinegar, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 3 habanero peppers (seeds removed for milder heat), 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves
instructions: In a nonreactive saucepan, cook vinegars and sugar over medium-high heat until the sugar is completely melted and the mixture is reduced by at least half and is thick | Finely chop the habaneros and carefully transfer the hot mixture to a blender | Add the habaneros and mint â€” blend until smooth | Let cool to room temperature | Serve with chicken, goat, lamb, or mutton

ingredients: 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 cup vegetable shortening, 2 tbsp cold unsalted butter (cubed), milk or melted butter for brushing
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) and position the rack in the upper third | Stir lemon juice and whipping cream together and let stand for a few minutes | Stack 2 baking sheets together and line the top sheet with parchment paper | In a food processor, combine flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and baking soda â€” blend briefly | Add shortening and butter and pulse to make a coarse grainy mixture | Turn out into a large bowl, drizzle the soured cream over, and stir lightly with a fork | Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead 8-10 times | Pat to 1-inch thickness and cut into 2-inch disks | Brush tops with milk or melted butter and bake for 12-15 minutes until golden

ingredients: 4 slices bacon (diced), 1 medium head green cabbage (shredded), 2 medium onions (sliced), 2 chicken breasts (seasoned and browned), 2 cans (400g each) great northern beans, 2 medium potatoes (diced), 4 cups chicken broth, 2 chicken bouillon cubes, 1 cup water, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Render fat from the bacon in a large pot â€” remove bacon and chop into bite-size pieces, set aside | Shred the cabbage and slice onions â€” sautÃ© in the bacon fat until lightly browned | Mix the bacon pieces back in and set aside | Season chicken with salt and pepper and fry in the bacon fat until well browned | Add chicken broth, bouillon cubes, potatoes, and water â€” boil until the chicken is tender | Remove the chicken, shred into chunky pieces, and return to the pot | Add the cabbage mixture and beans | Boil until reduced to a thick gravy-like consistency, at least 1 to 1 1/2 hours â€” the longer it cooks, the better | Serve hot

ingredients: For puffs: 1/2 cup water, 1/4 cup unsalted butter, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 large eggs. For filling: 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 tbsp milk, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp curry powder, pinch of pepper, 1 cup cooked chicken (diced), 1/4 cup sliced almonds, 2 green onions (sliced)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Bring water and butter to a boil â€” add flour and salt and stir vigorously over low heat until the mixture forms a ball | Remove from heat and beat in eggs one at a time until smooth | Drop level tablespoons of batter onto an ungreased baking sheet | Bake for 25 minutes â€” cool completely | Combine cream cheese, milk, salt, curry powder, and pepper â€” mix until well blended | Add chicken, almonds, and onion â€” mix lightly | Cut tops from the puffs and fill with the chicken mixture | Replace tops and place on a cookie sheet | Bake at 375Â°F (190Â°C) for 5 minutes until warm | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1.5 kg pork ribs (membrane removed), salt and black pepper. For rub: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 2 tbsp brown sugar. For sauce: 1 cup barbecue sauce, 1/2 cup ketchup, 2 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 tsp salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 300Â°F (150Â°C) and line a baking sheet with foil â€” spray with cooking spray | Peel the membrane off the ribs and season both sides with salt and pepper | Mix paprika, garlic powder, and brown sugar â€” rub evenly over both sides of the ribs | Place on the baking sheet and cover tightly with foil | Bake for 2 hours | Make the BBQ sauce: combine all sauce ingredients in a saucepan, bring to a boil, then simmer for 5 minutes | Remove ribs from the oven, uncover, and turn the broiler to low | Coat the ribs with BBQ sauce and broil for 10 minutes | Let rest for a few minutes before serving

ingredients: 3 medium zucchini (grated and squeezed dry), 1 medium onion (grated and drained), 2 cloves garlic, 1/4 cup walnuts, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 tbsp dried parsley, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, olive oil for baking
instructions: Grate the zucchini, toss with salt, and let drain in a colander | Grate the onion and let the juice drain away | Process garlic and walnuts until finely chopped | Press as much liquid from the zucchini and onion as possible | Combine with garlic, walnuts, parsley, and cheese in a bowl | Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and lightly oil a baking sheet | Shape into small patties and coat with breadcrumbs | Arrange on the baking sheet and bake for about 35 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden | Serve warm

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups spelt flour, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 large egg, 1 cup rice milk or milk, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, butter or oil for cooking, maple syrup for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt | In a small bowl, mix together the egg, milk, and oil with a fork | Add the egg mixture all at once to the flour mixture â€” stir until just moistened (still lumpy) | Heat a skillet over medium heat and grease lightly | Pour desired amount of batter and cook until bubbles cover the surface and the bottom is golden | Flip and cook the other side until done | Serve warm with maple syrup

ingredients: For crust: 200g coconut cookies (crushed), 1/2 cup shredded coconut, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted). For filling: 1 cup whole milk, 1/3 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 1/2 cup cream of coconut, 1 tbsp lime zest, 1 large egg yolk, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1/2 tsp coconut extract, 1/2 cup heavy cream (whipped). For topping: 1/2 cup heavy cream (whipped), lime slices
instructions: Make the crust: crush cookies in a food processor, add coconut and butter, and pulse until moistened | Press into a 9-inch tart pan and bake at 350Â°F (175Â°C) for about 15 minutes until golden â€” cool | Whisk milk, sugar, and cornstarch in a heavy saucepan | Whisk in cream of coconut and lime zest â€” bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened, about 2 minutes | Remove from heat | Whisk the egg yolk in a bowl, whisk in the hot milk mixture, then return to the pan and simmer for 2 minutes | Stir in lime juice and coconut extract | Cover the surface with plastic wrap and refrigerate until cold, about 2 hours | Whisk the filling to loosen, then fold in the whipped cream | Scrape into the crust and smooth the top â€” refrigerate for 1 hour | Whip cream for topping and pipe rosettes around the edge â€” garnish with lime slice quarters

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1 cup instant brown rice (uncooked), 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp chili powder, salt to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300Â°F (150Â°C) | In a skillet, cook and crumble the ground beef â€” drain well | Add diced onion and stir in tomatoes (with their juice), uncooked instant rice, salt, pepper, and chili powder â€” heat through | Pour into an ungreased 2-quart casserole dish | Bake for 30-40 minutes | If using regular brown rice, partially cook it before adding to ensure it cooks through

ingredients: 400g elbow macaroni (cooked, drained, and cooled), 3/4 cup mayonnaise, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp sweet pickle relish, 1/4 cup sweet onion (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 cup frozen baby peas (thawed), 2 hard-boiled eggs (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook the macaroni according to package directions â€” drain well, rinse, and cool | Mix the mayonnaise, salt, relish, and onion in a small bowl â€” set aside | Combine the macaroni, celery, bell pepper, and peas in a large bowl | Add the mayonnaise mixture and toss to coat | Gently fold in the chopped eggs | Season with additional salt and pepper to taste | Chill well, about 2 hours, then taste and adjust seasoning before serving

ingredients: 1 turkey carcass (with some meat remaining), 2 litres water, 1 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 celery ribs (diced), 1 carrot (diced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tsp dried marjoram, 1 bay leaf, 200g cooked egg noodles
instructions: Combine the turkey carcass and water in a crock pot | Add salt, pepper, onion, celery, carrot, parsley, marjoram, and bay leaf | Cover and cook on low for 5-6 hours | Remove the carcass and bay leaf â€” take the meat off the bones and return the meat to the broth â€” discard the bones | Add cooked noodles to the crock pot | Cover and cook on high for 20-30 minutes | Discard the bay leaf and serve hot

ingredients: 1 large egg white, 8 tbsp granulated sugar (divided), 1 cup cornflakes (crushed), 1/2 cup shredded coconut, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, pinch of salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a cookie sheet | In a medium bowl, beat the egg white, gradually adding 2 tablespoons of sugar until stiff | Stir in the remaining 6 tablespoons sugar, cornflakes, coconut, vanilla, and salt | Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto the prepared cookie sheet | Bake for 10 minutes until lightly browned | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: For cake: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 1/4 cups granulated sugar, 1 cup pumpkin purÃ©e, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped), 1/2 cup raisins. For icing: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup evaporated milk, 2 tbsp maple syrup, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a Bundt pan | Cream butter and sugar until fluffy | Add pumpkin, eggs, and vanilla â€” beat until smooth | Combine dry ingredients in a medium bowl and add to the creamed mixture one cup at a time, stirring until blended | Stir in nuts and raisins | Spoon into the prepared pan | Bake for 55-65 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then invert onto a serving plate and cool completely | Make the icing: melt butter in a heavy saucepan, stir in sugar, evaporated milk, and maple syrup â€” bring to a boil, stirring constantly, and boil for 6 minutes | Remove from heat, stir in vanilla, and cool for 10 minutes | Beat for 8-10 minutes until thick and creamy and spread over the cake

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 tbsp habanero hot sauce, 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 1 can (400g) artichoke hearts (drained and chopped), 1 can (200g) diced green chilies, 1/4 cup sliced black olives, crackers or tortilla chips for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 325Â°F (160Â°C) | Mix cream cheese, Parmesan, hot sauce, and mayonnaise in a stand mixer until well combined | Add artichoke hearts, chilies, and olives â€” mix just until integrated | Pour into a 2-quart baking dish and top with olives | Bake for 45 minutes | Serve warm with crackers, bread, or tortilla chips

ingredients: 1/2 cup light corn syrup, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp cream of tartar, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Beat corn syrup, sugar, and cream of tartar together over hot water for 7 minutes | Add vanilla and beat until cool and fluffy | Use as a substitute for store-bought marshmallow fluff

ingredients: 60ml vodka, 30ml fresh lemon juice, 15ml simple syrup, 15ml cranberry juice, ice cubes, lemon twist for garnish
instructions: In a mixing glass or shaker, add vodka, lemon juice, simple syrup, cranberry juice, and ice | Shake well and strain into a martini glass | Garnish with a lemon twist and serve

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tsp Italian seasoning, pinch of cayenne pepper, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1 cup whole milk or cream, 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (plus extra for serving), 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 1/2 cup sour cream, 400g cooked pasta
instructions: Heat butter over medium heat in a medium saucepan | Add onion, Italian seasoning, and cayenne â€” sautÃ© until softened, about 3-4 minutes | Add garlic and cook for 2 minutes | Stir in mushroom soup, milk, chicken, and 1/4 cup Parmesan â€” bring to a simmer over medium heat | Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally | Season with black pepper | Cook the pasta according to package directions | Just before serving, mix the sour cream into the sauce until heated through (do not boil) | Serve over cooked pasta with extra Parmesan on top

ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise, 2 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 1 tsp lemon zest, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Add dill, lemon zest, and lemon juice to the mayonnaise â€” mix well | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Serve with eggs, vegetables, new potatoes, or fish

ingredients: 1.5 kg rack of pork, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp kosher salt, 2 tbsp Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp liquid honey, 1 tbsp dried rosemary (crushed), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 cup beef broth, 1 cup chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Make many shallow 1-inch slits over the surface of the fat | Mix garlic with salt and spread over the roast, pressing into the slits | Place in a shallow baking dish and roast uncovered for 2 hours | Mix oil with Dijon mustard and crushed rosemary | After the initial 2 hours, cover the roast with the Dijon mixture and baste every 15 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 155Â°F (68Â°C) | If the roast browns too quickly, cover loosely with foil | Let rest for at least 10 minutes | Skim fat from the pan juices, add broths, and scrape up any brown bits â€” boil gently for 5 minutes | Slice the pork and serve with the pan juices

ingredients: 30ml vodka, 15ml amaretto, ice cubes
instructions: Place vodka, amaretto, and ice in a shaker cup | Shake well and strain into a shooter glass | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 medium head green cabbage (chopped), 3 tbsp olive oil, 6 slices bacon (cut into thirds), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Place chopped cabbage in an oblong baking dish (it will wilt a lot while cooking) | Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper | Lay bacon pieces over the cabbage to completely cover the dish | Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour | Remove foil and bake 30 minutes more to crisp the bacon | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/4 cup unsalted butter, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2 tbsp dry white wine, salt and black pepper, 2 tbsp heavy cream, 24 canned snails (drained), 2 tbsp breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat â€” sweat garlic for 1 minute, then add parsley, wine, salt, and pepper â€” bring to a simmer | Remove from heat and stir in cream until blended | Add the snails and turn in the sauce until coated | Divide snails and sauce among 4 small ovenproof dishes or ramekins â€” top with breadcrumbs | Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden and bubbling | Serve immediately with crusty bread

ingredients: 4 slices deli ham, 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1 can (400g) cream of chicken soup, 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream, 6 slices low-fat Swiss cheese (divided)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Fry the ham in a non-stick pan until a little crispy â€” line the bottom of a baking dish with the ham | Place the chicken breasts over the ham | Mix the soup, sour cream, and half the cheese â€” spread over the chicken | Cover with the remaining Swiss cheese | Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes | Uncover and bake until the cheese is brown and the chicken juices run clear, about 15-20 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 cups whole milk, 1/2 cup water, 4 large eggs, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted), 6 cups bread cubes. For sauce: 2 large eggs, 2 tbsp whiskey, lemon juice, or amaretto, 1/2 cup confectioners sugar, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Combine sugar, milk, and water in a bowl â€” mix well | Add eggs, salt, vanilla, coconut, and melted butter â€” mix well | Stir in the bread cubes and let stand until the liquid is absorbed | Spoon into a 9 x 12-inch baking dish | Bake for 35-40 minutes until the pudding rises and springs back when touched | Make the sauce: whisk eggs and your chosen flavoring in a food processor until well blended | Add confectioners sugar and melted butter â€” process until smooth | Serve the pudding warm with the sauce

ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked white rice, 1/3 cup granulated sugar, 2 cups whole milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup mixed fruit (peaches, berries, or canned fruit), 2 large egg whites, 1/4 cup extra granulated sugar
instructions: Combine rice, sugar, and milk in a saucepan â€” stir constantly over heat until boiling | Reduce heat to lowest setting, cover, and cook for about 1 hour until the rice is tender and the mixture is thick and creamy, stirring occasionally | Stir in vanilla | Spread the rice mixture over the base of an ovenproof dish (7-cup capacity) | Top evenly with fruit | Beat egg whites with an electric mixer until soft peaks form â€” gradually add extra sugar and beat until thick and glossy | Spoon the meringue over the fruit to cover completely | Bake at 180Â°C (350Â°F) for 20-30 minutes until the meringue is evenly browned | Serve warm with thin cream if desired

ingredients: 1 cup plain breadcrumbs, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp dried parsley flakes, 1/2 tsp ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp dried basil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, tossing to blend thoroughly | Store in an airtight container | Use in any recipe calling for Italian breadcrumbs

ingredients: 2 large cucumbers (peeled and thinly sliced), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 cup sweet onion (diced), 1/2 cup plain yogurt, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1/4 tsp fresh ground pepper
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the cucumbers and place in a large bowl | Add salt and toss to cover all slices â€” let stand for about 1 hour | Drain off all water in a colander | In a small bowl, combine yogurt, lemon juice, dill, and pepper â€” stir until well mixed | Add olive oil and stir vigorously until blended | Place the drained cucumber slices in a salad bowl, pour the dressing over, and toss gently | Refrigerate for about 1 hour to allow the flavors to meld, then serve

ingredients: 1 kg chuck steak (trimmed), 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1 medium onion (sliced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp sugar, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with green chilies, 1 cup hot water, 1 beef bouillon cube, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Trim large areas of fat from the steak and remove any bones | Mix flour with salt and pepper on a plate | Heat oil in a frying pan â€” dredge steak in flour and place in the hot pan | Brown on both sides and place in the bottom of a crock pot | In the same pan, cook onion and garlic with sugar until browned and caramelized â€” place on top of the steak | Dissolve the bouillon cube in hot water and pour over the steak | Pour the can of tomatoes over the top | Cover and cook on low for 6 hours | Serve over white or brown rice

ingredients: 12 fresh oysters (shucked, shells reserved), 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp wasabi paste, pinch of chili flakes, sea salt for serving
instructions: Combine mirin, vinegar, lemon juice, wasabi, and chili in a small jug â€” stir well | Remove oysters from shells, drain on absorbent paper, and wash and dry the shells | Return oysters to the shells and arrange on a bed of sea salt on a serving platter | Spoon the dressing over each oyster | Serve cold immediately

ingredients: 400g firm tofu (pressed and cubed), 3 tbsp olive oil (divided), 2 tbsp cornstarch, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh basil (chopped), 200g mushrooms (sliced), 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 cups fresh spinach, 1 tbsp water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Press the tofu for 30-60 minutes, then pat dry and cut into 1-inch cubes | Toss tofu in 2 tablespoons oil, then roll in cornstarch | Place in a single layer on a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes until crispy and browned | While the tofu bakes, lightly sautÃ© the spinach in a little olive oil for 2-3 minutes, then cover and cook with 1 tablespoon water for 3 minutes | SautÃ© mushrooms in remaining 1 tablespoon oil for 5 minutes â€” add garlic and basil and cook briefly until the garlic is golden | Remove from heat, stir in lemon juice, and cover to keep warm | Serve the baked tofu over the braised spinach with the mushroom-garlic mixture on top

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup brown sugar (packed), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/2 cups shredded coconut, 2-3 tbsp heavy cream
instructions: Cream together the butter and vanilla | Add brown sugar gradually while continuing to beat | Stir in the shredded coconut | Add only enough cream to achieve the desired spreading consistency | For best results, make the night before: after step 2, microwave for 1 minute, beat for a minute, and let stand at room temperature overnight â€” add cream the next day before using

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 large eggs, 100g dark chocolate (melted), 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a 9 x 9 x 1 3/4-inch baking pan | Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy | Add vanilla and eggs â€” beat well | Stir in the melted chocolate | Sift together flour and salt and add to the creamed mixture | Fold in the walnuts | Spread evenly in the prepared pan | Bake for 25 minutes | Cool and cut into squares or bars

ingredients: For meatballs: 500g ground beef, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 cup bulgur (fine), 1/2 onion (grated), 1/4 tsp red pepper, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 large egg. For soup: 1 large egg, 1 cup plain yogurt, 1 tbsp dried mint, 2 cans (400g each) chicken broth, 2 cups water, 1 tbsp unsalted butter
instructions: Make the meatballs: mix together ground beef, salt, bulgur, onion, red pepper, black pepper, and egg â€” use a food processor if needed | With wet hands, roll into small balls about the size of a quarter | For the soup: whisk the egg into the yogurt and mix well with the dried mint | Heat the broth and water in a pot â€” add the yogurt mixture, stirring constantly so the soup does not curdle | Add butter and stir until melted | Once the broth is nearly boiling, add the meatballs and cook for 10 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: For filling: 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tbsp strawberry jam, 1/2 cup heavy cream (whipped), red food coloring (optional). For cookies: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/3 cup all-purpose flour, 2 large egg whites, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, pinch of salt, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted). For garnish: fresh strawberries (diced), extra sugar
instructions: Make the filling: combine cream cheese, sugar, and jam â€” fold in whipped cream and food coloring if desired â€” chill | Make the cookies: whisk sugar, flour, egg whites, vanilla, and salt until smooth â€” whisk in melted butter | Line baking sheets with parchment | Working 4 cookies at a time, drop batter by 1 1/2 teaspoonfuls 4 inches apart | Bake at 400Â°F (200Â°C) for 5-8 minutes until edges are lightly browned | Immediately remove one cookie at a time and form into a tube around a greased wooden clothespin â€” hold for about 20 seconds to set | Repeat with remaining batter, returning cookies to the oven for 1 minute to soften if needed | Just before serving, pipe or spoon filling into the cookie shells and dip ends into diced strawberries and sugar | Serve immediately

ingredients: 200g cremini mushrooms (sliced), 2 tbsp water, 2 cups fresh spinach, 4 large flour tortillas, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), salsa and lime wedges for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | In a large skillet, cook mushrooms with water over medium heat, covered, until tender, about 9 minutes | Add spinach, cover, and cook just until wilted, about 4 minutes â€” drain well | Divide the mushroom-spinach mixture among the wraps, spooning down the center of each | Sprinkle with cheese and add salsa if desired | Wrap up snugly and place on a baking sheet | Bake for about 5 minutes until heated through | Serve with a squeeze of lime

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 2 celery ribs (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 4 cups chicken broth, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs (cut into pieces), 1 cup frozen cut okra, 300g large shrimp (peeled and deveined), 1 tsp hot sauce, steamed rice for serving
instructions: In a large pot over medium-high heat, melt butter | Add onion, bell pepper, celery, and garlic â€” cook until softened, 5-6 minutes | Stir in flour and cook, stirring, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes | Stir in broth, tomatoes with their juices, salt, and pepper â€” bring to a boil | Add chicken, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook for 10 minutes | Add okra and cook for 5 minutes | Add shrimp and cook until the chicken, okra, and shrimp are just cooked through, about 5 minutes | Stir in hot sauce | Serve over steamed rice

ingredients: 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 can (400g) tomato paste, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp dried basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 140Â°F (60Â°C) with the door slightly open | SautÃ© onions and garlic in olive oil until soft and golden | Add tomato paste, salt, sugar, parsley, pepper, and basil â€” cook slowly for 10 minutes | Spray a non-stick cookie sheet with cooking spray and spread the tomato mixture in a thin layer | Dry in the oven for about 6 hours | Roll the leather and store in a plastic bag â€” may be frozen | To reconstitute: add 3 times the volume of water to the leather, cook and stir over low heat until warm and smooth

ingredients: 4 large potatoes (peeled and cubed), 1/4 cup low-fat milk, 1 tbsp unsalted butter, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Bring cubed potatoes to a boil in salted water and cook until tender | Drain and return to the pot | Add milk and butter and mash with beaters until smooth and creamy | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Serve hot

ingredients: 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 cloves garlic (smashed), 2 cans (400g each) whole tomatoes, 1 cup fresh parsley (chopped, divided), 1/2 tsp dried red pepper flakes, 400g penne pasta (cooked), 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook oil and garlic in a heavy large skillet over medium-high heat until the garlic begins to sizzle | Stir in tomatoes with their liquid, 3/4 cup parsley, and the red pepper flakes â€” break up the tomatoes with the back of a spoon | Season with salt and pepper | Reduce heat to medium-low, partially cover, and cook until the tomatoes are thick and pulpy, stirring occasionally, about 1 hour and 15 minutes | Discard the garlic | Mix in the remaining 1/4 cup parsley | Pour the sauce over the cooked penne and toss well | Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve

ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, 1 cup frozen raspberries, 1/2 can frozen limeade concentrate, 2 cups cold water, 2 cups ice cubes, lime wedges for garnish
instructions: Rub the mint leaves around the inside of a large pitcher, then drop them in | Pour in the raspberries, limeade concentrate, and cold water â€” mix well | Add ice and stir | Serve in glasses with a lime wedge on the rim

ingredients: 1 cup rolled oats, 1/4 cup unsalted butter, 1/2 cup boiling water, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup ground pepitas (pumpkin seeds), 50g dark chocolate (melted), 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 180Â°C (350Â°F) and spray mini muffin trays with oil | Mix oats and butter with your fingers until well combined | Add boiling water and mix â€” stir in ground pepitas and set aside to cool | In a separate bowl, combine sugar, cinnamon, eggs, and vanilla | Add to the cooled oat mixture and combine well | Sift together flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt â€” fold in with the melted chocolate | Spoon batter into prepared trays, being careful not to overfill | Bake for 10 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 4 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 medium head green cabbage (chopped), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 400g egg noodles (cooked and drained), sour cream for serving
instructions: Melt butter in a large pan or pot large enough to hold the chopped cabbage | SautÃ© the cabbage and onion in the butter until glossy and tender | Add salt and pepper | Cover and let simmer over low heat for about 15 minutes | Add the cooked drained egg noodles and mix well | Serve hot with a generous dollop of sour cream

ingredients: For chocolate layer: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 100g dark chocolate (chopped), 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 3/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt. For cream layer: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 2 tbsp Irish cream liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and line a 13 x 9-inch baking pan with aluminum foil â€” lightly coat with cooking spray | Melt butter and chocolate in a saucepan over low heat, stirring often â€” let cool | Beat sugar and eggs until light and fluffy, about 4 minutes â€” add flour and salt gradually and fold in the melted chocolate | In another bowl, beat cream cheese and sugar until creamy â€” add egg and liqueur and beat | Pour half the chocolate batter into the pan, spread all the cream layer over it, then pour the remaining chocolate batter over and smooth | Swirl with a knife for a marbled effect if desired | Bake for 40 minutes | Cool completely before cutting into squares

ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (cold, cubed), 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp cream of tartar, 1 large egg, 2-3 tbsp hot water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Cut the butter into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse meal | Add brown sugar, baking soda, and cream of tartar â€” mix well | Add the egg and just enough hot water to make a pastry-consistency dough | Roll out on a floured surface until very thin (about 3mm to 6mm thick) | Cut into small squares | Bake on unoiled baking sheets until golden brown, about 15 minutes | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 500g ground beef (browned and drained), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1 celery stalk (diced), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp dry mustard, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 cup ketchup, hamburger buns for serving
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker or in a saucepan on the stove (brown the beef first) | Cook on low for 2-4 hours in a slow cooker or simmer on the stove for 30 minutes | Serve on hamburger buns

ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable shortening, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 tbsp milk, 1 1/2 cups cake flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 300Â°F (150Â°C) and grease a baking sheet | Cream together sugar and shortening | Beat in egg, vanilla extract, and milk | Sift together flour, salt, and baking powder â€” add alternately with the wet mixture to the creamed mixture | Drop by teaspoonfuls onto the prepared baking sheet | Bake for 20 minutes until lightly golden | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: For cake: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup margarine (softened), 3/4 cup skim milk, 1 tbsp fresh lemon zest, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 large egg whites. For meringue: 2 large egg whites, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, fresh strawberries for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and spray a 9 x 9-inch pan with cooking spray | Beat flour, 1 cup sugar, margarine, milk, baking powder, lemon zest, vanilla, salt, and 2 egg whites with an electric mixer on low for 30 seconds | Beat on high for 2 minutes | Pour into the pan and bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown â€” cool slightly | Increase oven temperature to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Beat the remaining 2 egg whites until frothy, then slowly beat in 1/2 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, until stiff and glossy | Spread meringue over the cake and bake for 8-10 minutes until lightly browned | Cool completely and top with sliced strawberries before serving

ingredients: 1 kg fresh mussels (rinsed and debearded), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 celery stalks (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 carrot (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 cup chicken broth, 1/2 cup dry white wine, 1/2 cup heavy cream, crusty bread for serving
instructions: Rinse the mussels and discard any that are open | Chop celery, onions, carrots, and garlic | In a medium pot, sautÃ© the onions, garlic, celery, and carrots in butter for about 2 minutes | Add the mussels and sautÃ© for 1 minute | Add the broth and white wine â€” boil until the mussels open | Add the cream, reduce heat to medium, and stir until combined | Serve immediately with crusty bread

ingredients: 450g dried navy beans (soaked overnight), 200g smoked ham (cubed), 1 medium onion (diced), 1/4 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp maple syrup, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp ground mustard, 3 cups water, 2 tbsp ketchup, 1 tbsp prepared mustard
instructions: Cover beans with water and soak overnight â€” drain and discard water | Cover with fresh water, boil for 10 minutes, then drain and discard water | Add beans to a slow cooker with 1 cup fresh water | Add cubed ham and diced onion | Combine brown sugar, maple syrup, salt, ground mustard, and water â€” add to the slow cooker and mix well | Cover and cook on low for 10-12 hours | Stir in ketchup and prepared mustard before serving | Serve hot

ingredients: For marinade: 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1/2 cup bourbon, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp ground ginger, 3 cloves garlic (minced). For beef: 1 kg beef tenderloin, 2 tbsp fresh coarse ground black pepper, 1 tbsp white pepper, 2 tbsp canola oil, 1/4 cup water
instructions: At least 4 hours before cooking, combine all marinade ingredients | Place the tenderloin in a plastic bag or shallow dish and pour the marinade over | Refrigerate, turning occasionally | Prepare a smoker to 200-220Â°F (93-104Â°C) | Remove the tenderloin and drain the marinade, reserving it | Coat the tenderloin thoroughly with black pepper, then white pepper â€” let sit for 30 minutes | Reserve half the marinade in the refrigerator; boil the other half with oil and water for a mop sauce | Sear the meat quickly on all sides in a heavy skillet over high heat | Transfer to the smoker and cook for 1 1/2-2 hours, mopping with the mop mixture every 20 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 140-145Â°F (60-63Â°C) | Bring the reserved marinade to a boil and reduce by one-fourth | Slice the tenderloin and serve with the reduced sauce

ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1/2 cup sour cream, 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp black pepper, paprika and chopped scallions for garnish
instructions: Combine mayonnaise, sour cream, cream cheese, lemon juice, garlic powder, and pepper â€” mix well | Transfer to a serving bowl, cover, and refrigerate | Before serving, stir the dip and garnish with paprika and chopped scallions or tomatoes | Serve with fresh cut vegetables

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 500g beef stew meat (cubed), 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 2 cups water, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), rice, noodles, or dumplings for serving
instructions: In a Dutch oven, heat oil over medium heat | Toss the meat in flour to coat | When the oil is hot, add the meat, onions, and peppers â€” brown everything well | Add garlic powder, black pepper, red pepper flakes, water, diced tomatoes, and salt | Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours until the meat is very tender | Stir in parsley | Serve over rice, noodles, or topped with dumplings

ingredients: 2 tbsp canola oil, 2 tbsp distilled white vinegar, 1 tsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 tsp ketchup, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1/4 tsp garlic salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground pepper, 4 cups fresh spinach, 1 carrot (julienned), 1 red bell pepper (thinly sliced), 2 tbsp sliced almonds
instructions: Combine the first 8 ingredients in a small bowl and blend well | Toss spinach, carrot, bell pepper, and almonds in the dressing | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 slices beef liver (soaked in cold water and patted dry), 1/2 tsp ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp salt, 3 tbsp olive oil (divided), 2 large yellow onions (sliced), 4 tbsp unsalted butter, 4 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 cup beef broth, 1/2 cup water
instructions: Season the liver slices with salt and pepper | Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over high heat â€” add liver and cook for 3 minutes per side â€” remove and keep warm | Add remaining oil and sliced onions â€” season with salt and pepper and cook until browned | For the gravy: melt butter in a separate pan, add flour, and stir for 1 minute â€” gradually add broth and water, stirring constantly | Bring to a boil and simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally | Serve the liver topped with onions and gravy

ingredients: 2 large egg yolks, 3/4 cup olive oil, 3 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
instructions: In a large stainless steel bowl, whisk the egg yolks until they turn light yellow | Slowly add the olive oil, whisking continuously until emulsified | Add the red wine vinegar and all remaining ingredients â€” whisk until well combined | Store in the refrigerator for up to 1 week

ingredients: For syrup: 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 1 tbsp fresh rosemary, 1/2 tsp black peppercorns. For chard: 1 bunch Swiss chard (stems sliced, leaves cut into strips), 1/2 red onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper, 2 tbsp water. For lamb: 8 lamb rib chops, 1/2 tsp garlic salt, 1 tsp fresh rosemary, pinch of black pepper
instructions: Make the balsamic syrup: simmer balsamic vinegar, rosemary, and peppercorns in a small nonreactive saucepan until reduced to about 1/4 cup â€” strain and set aside | Cook onion and garlic in olive oil in a large skillet until softened, about 4 minutes | Add chard stems, salt, and pepper â€” cook until tender, about 6 minutes | Stir in chard leaves and water â€” cook until tender, about 8 minutes | While chard cooks, season lamb chops with garlic salt, rosemary, and pepper | Broil on a lightly oiled broiler pan 4-5 inches from the heat, turning once, for 6-7 minutes total for medium-rare | Serve chops and chard drizzled with the balsamic syrup

ingredients: 1 cup instant coffee granules, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg

ingredients: 12 jumbo pasta shells (cooked), 400g firm tofu (crumbled), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp dried basil, 3 cups spaghetti sauce, 1/4 cup fat-free Parmesan cheese

ingredients: 1 fresh pineapple (peeled and cut into bite-sized chunks), 2 cups granulated sugar, 1 cup water, 1/4 cup light corn syrup

ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup vegetable shortening, 3 ripe bananas (mashed), 2 large eggs, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a loaf pan | Cream together the sugar and shortening | Add the mashed bananas and eggs â€” mix well | Sift together the flour, salt, and baking powder â€” add to the banana mixture without overmixing | Pour into the prepared loaf pan | Bake for about 35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool before slicing

ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower (cut into florets), 1 tbsp salt (for blanching water), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp salt
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add 1 tablespoon salt | Add the cauliflower florets and boil for about 1 minute until tender but still firm â€” drain and set aside | Heat a large wok over high heat â€” add the oil and swirl to coat | Add the garlic and stir-fry until it starts to turn golden, 15-20 seconds | Add the cauliflower and stir-fry for 30 seconds to 1 minute, pressing it against the side of the wok to sear | Add 1/2 teaspoon salt, stir-fry briefly, and serve

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1 cup longhorn cheese (shredded), 8 flour tortillas, 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1 can (354ml) evaporated milk, 200g processed cheese (cubed), 1 can (200g) diced green chilies, 1/4 cup pimientos
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Brown the ground beef with salt and garlic powder â€” drain | Add the longhorn cheese and onion â€” mix well | Spoon the beef mixture onto the tortillas and roll tightly â€” place seam-side down in a buttered 8 x 10-inch baking dish | Heat the soup, evaporated milk, and processed cheese in a saucepan until the cheese melts, stirring constantly | Add the green chilies and pimientos â€” mix well | Pour the cheese sauce over the enchiladas | Cover and bake for 30 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 250g dried chickpeas (soaked overnight), 4 cups water, 3 cloves garlic, 2 bay leaves, 1 thick slab bacon, 1 ham bone, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 slices bread (fried until golden), 100g Spanish ham (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tsp paprika, 2 cups Swiss chard (chopped), 2 small red potatoes (cubed), salt to taste, 2 hard-boiled eggs (yolks mashed, whites chopped), 2 tbsp almonds (ground)
instructions: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain | In a large pot, combine the chickpeas, 4 cups water, garlic, bay leaves, bacon, and ham bone â€” bring to a boil, cover, and simmer for about 1 1/2 hours | In a skillet, heat the oil and fry the bread until golden on both sides â€” reserve | Add the ham and onion to the skillet and sautÃ© until the onion has wilted | Stir in the paprika and remove from heat â€” add to the chickpeas | Add the Swiss chard, potatoes, and salt â€” continue cooking for 30 minutes until tender | Remove the ham bone | In a mortar or food processor, combine the fried bread, almonds, 2 tablespoons chickpeas from the pot, and the mashed egg yolks â€” mash into a paste | Stir the paste into the stew, cover, and let sit for 10 minutes | Serve in bowls garnished with the chopped egg whites

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 large eggplant (sliced), 1 cup ricotta cheese, 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 2 cups tomato sauce, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, 1/4 cup Romano cheese (grated)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Cook the eggplant slices in olive oil in a heavy-bottomed skillet until tender â€” drain | Mix the tomato sauce with the garlic and oregano | Add the chives to the ricotta | Mix the breadcrumbs with the Romano cheese | In a greased 12 x 8-inch baking dish, layer half the eggplant, half the ricotta, half the tomato sauce, and half the crumb mixture | Repeat the layers | Bake for 30 minutes until bubbly | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 can (400g) cream of chicken soup, 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 2/3 cup milk, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 cups frozen mixed vegetables, 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 1 can refrigerated biscuits (quartered)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | In a 2-quart saucepan, stir together the soups, milk, thyme, and pepper | Stir in the vegetables and chicken | Heat over medium-high until the mixture just begins to boil â€” reduce heat and cook for 3-4 minutes | Pour into an ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking dish | Cut the biscuits into quarters and arrange around the edges of the dish on top of the hot mixture | Bake for 18-22 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and baked through | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 cup cold milk (divided), 1 tbsp instant coffee granules, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 package whipped topping mix, 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix, 1 prepared graham cracker crust
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, beat 1 cup milk, the whipped topping mix, coffee granules, vanilla, and cinnamon on medium speed until combined | Beat on high for 4-6 minutes until thick | Add the remaining milk and the pudding mix â€” beat on medium for about 2 minutes until thick | Spread into the crust | Refrigerate for at least 3 hours until firm | Garnish as desired and store in the refrigerator

ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, 500g ground turkey, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 cups tomato sauce, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp dried oregano, 9 uncooked lasagna noodles (broken to fit), 2 cups low-fat cottage cheese, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, 2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese (shredded)
instructions: Brown the ground turkey in olive oil with the onion and garlic | Add the tomato sauce, tomato paste, and oregano â€” mix thoroughly | Spoon a layer of meat sauce onto the bottom of a slow cooker | Add a double layer of uncooked lasagna noodles (broken to fit) and top with the cheeses | Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used | Cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/2 cup frozen strawberries, 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream, 1/2 cup vanilla yogurt, 1/2 cup diet ginger ale, maraschino cherries for garnish
instructions: Pour the whipping cream into a blender and blend until creamy | Add the yogurt and blend again for about 30 seconds | Add the frozen strawberries and blend for 1 minute | Slowly pour in the ginger ale and blend briefly | Pour into glasses and garnish with a maraschino cherry | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 tsp unflavored gelatin, 1 tsp instant coffee powder, 2 tbsp water, 2 tbsp icing sugar, 1 cup heavy whipping cream, 3 tbsp Baileys Irish Cream
instructions: Combine the gelatin, coffee, and water in a small bowl â€” microwave on high for about 20 seconds until the gelatin is dissolved â€” let cool without setting | Whip the cream and sifted icing sugar until soft peaks form | Fold in the gelatin mixture and Baileys | Pour into 4 individual dishes | Refrigerate until set and serve chilled

ingredients: 4 large egg yolks, 2 tbsp cornflour, 2 cups whole milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 3 tbsp caster sugar
instructions: In a bowl, beat the egg yolks and cornflour with a whisk until well combined | Heat the milk and vanilla in a heavy-based saucepan over medium heat | Add the yolk mixture and sugar | Stir constantly in a figure-8 motion over medium-low heat for about 10 minutes until thick and coating the back of a spoon â€” do not let it boil | Rest for 10 minutes and serve warm

ingredients: 4 pork steaks (deboned, pounded to 1/8-inch thickness), 1 tbsp celery seeds, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1/4 cup lard or vegetable oil for frying, paprika gravy for serving
instructions: Debone the pork steaks and pound them out to 1/8-inch thickness | Rub both sides of each steak with the celery seeds | Place the flour in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper | Dredge the pork in the seasoned flour | Heat the lard or oil in a large skillet over medium heat | Pan-fry the pork steaks until golden brown on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side | Drain on paper towels | Serve with paprika gravy

ingredients: 1.5 kg pork spareribs, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp five-spice powder, 2 tbsp palm sugar or brown sugar, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp rice wine
instructions: Combine all marinade ingredients in a bowl | Add the spareribs and coat well â€” marinate overnight in the refrigerator | Preheat oven to 180Â°C (350Â°F) | Bake the spareribs for 20 minutes | Finish on a barbecue or under the broiler over medium heat until golden brown, about 10 minutes | Slice and serve

ingredients: 2 cups semolina flour, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 3/4 cup warm water (approximately), pinch of salt
instructions: Place both flours in a large mixing bowl and stir to combine | Make a well in the centre and add the water a little at a time, mixing with your hands until a dough forms | Knead on a floured surface for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic | Cover and let rest for 10 minutes at room temperature before rolling and cutting | Cook in salted boiling water until al dente, 2-3 minutes for fresh pasta

ingredients: 200g fresh spinach (washed, trimmed, and coarsely chopped), 1 tbsp peanut oil, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1/4 cup water chestnuts (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste, 24 wonton wrappers, water for sealing, broth, steaming, or oil for cooking
instructions: Wash the spinach thoroughly, trim any tough stems, and pat dry â€” coarsely chop | Heat a wok over medium-high heat until smoking hot | Add the peanut oil with the garlic and onion â€” stir-fry for 30 seconds | Add the spinach and water chestnuts â€” cook for an additional 3 minutes until the water from the spinach evaporates | Transfer to a bowl and season with salt and pepper â€” let cool for 5 minutes | To form each wonton: moisten the edges of a wrapper with water, place a scant teaspoon of filling in the centre, fold into a triangle, then bring the long corners together and pinch to seal | Cover completed wontons with plastic wrap | Cook by simmering in broth for soup, steaming and serving with soy dipping sauce, or deep-frying until golden | Uncooked wontons can be frozen in a single layer, then transferred to a resealable bag

ingredients: 1 box plain crackers (such as saltines), 1/3 cup canola oil, 2 tbsp clarified butter (melted), 1 tbsp dried parsley, 1 tsp seasoning salt, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp cayenne powder
instructions: Heat the crackers in the microwave on half power until they are quite warm | Heat the oil and clarified butter together until hot | Drizzle the hot oil mixture over the crackers in thirds, stirring between each addition | Sprinkle on the parsley, seasoning salt, garlic powder, and cayenne â€” mix well until evenly coated | Let cool and store in an airtight container | Serve as a snack

ingredients: 400g penne pasta, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 red onion (diced), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 300g ground pork, 1/4 cup dry red wine, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1/2 cup tomato sauce, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp dried rosemary, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2 medium zucchini (diced), 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, 1/2 cup shredded cheese, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions â€” drain | Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat â€” add the onion and sautÃ© for 3 minutes | Add the red pepper and cook for 3 minutes | Add the garlic and sautÃ© for 1 minute | Add the pork and cook until no longer pink | Add the red wine and cook until the liquid has almost evaporated | Add the diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, oregano, basil, rosemary, and brown sugar â€” stir to combine | Reduce heat to medium-low and cook for 10-15 minutes | Add the drained pasta and diced zucchini to the skillet â€” season with black pepper and red pepper flakes | Increase heat to medium, cover, and cook until the zucchini is tender, about 5-8 minutes | Stir in the cheese until melted | Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve immediately

ingredients: 1.5 kg beef brisket, 2 tbsp seasoning mix. For sauce: 1 cup ketchup, 1/4 cup soy sauce, 2 shallots (minced), 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp white vinegar, hickory chips for smoking
instructions: Rinse the brisket and pat dry â€” sprinkle both sides with seasoning | Place in a plastic bag and marinate in the refrigerator overnight | Start a charcoal fire in a smoker â€” pre-soak hickory chips in water | Place the brisket fat-side up in a disposable aluminium pan on the grill | Cover the smoker and add soaked hickory chips directly onto the coals â€” replenish periodically | Baste the meat occasionally with the fat from the cooking | Cook for 6-8 hours until the meat pulls apart easily | Make the sauce: combine all sauce ingredients in a heavy-bottomed pan and bring to a boil â€” reduce heat and simmer until thick, about 10 minutes | Slice the brisket thinly across the grain and serve with the barbecue sauce | For oven cooking: slow-roast at 275Â°F (135Â°C) for 60 minutes per pound

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour, 1/2 cup sugar substitute, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce, 1/2 cup pumpkin purÃ©e, 1/4 cup fat-free egg substitute, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | In a mixing bowl, combine all dry ingredients (flour, sugar substitute, brown sugar, baking soda, and salt) â€” mix well | In a separate bowl, mix together all wet ingredients (applesauce, pumpkin, egg substitute, and vanilla) | Add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients and stir until completely blended | Fold in the chocolate chips | Spray a large baking pan with nonstick spray and spoon the batter into 8 evenly spaced circles | Bake for about 10 minutes until the cookies appear done and feel firm | Cool slightly and enjoy while still warm

ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk, 1 package instant French vanilla pudding mix, 1 can fruit cocktail (drained), 1 can mandarin oranges (drained), 1 cup coloured miniature marshmallows, 1 cup whipped topping (thawed)
instructions: In a mixing bowl, beat the buttermilk and pudding mix on medium speed for 1 minute â€” let stand for 5 minutes | Fold in the drained fruit cocktail, oranges, marshmallows, and whipped topping | Refrigerate until ready to serve

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup powdered sugar, 1 tsp fresh lemon juice, 12 large fresh strawberries (hulled and hollowed), 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Beat together the cream cheese, powdered sugar, and lemon juice until smooth and creamy â€” set aside | Using a paring knife, hollow out the top of each strawberry to a depth of about 3/4 inch | Gently fill each strawberry with the cream cheese mixture using a pastry bag, filling just slightly above the tops | Dip each filled top into the graham cracker crumbs | Place on a baking sheet and refrigerate for several hours or overnight to chill completely | Serve cold

ingredients: 400g malfadine or mafalda pasta, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 150g lardons or smoked bacon (cubed), 1 can (400g) Italian tomatoes, 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes (chopped), salt and black pepper, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 cup Parmesan or Romano cheese (grated)
instructions: In a frying pan, sautÃ© the onion in olive oil until softened but not browned | Add the lardons or bacon cubes and brown them | Add the canned tomatoes and chopped sun-dried tomatoes | Season with salt and pepper and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally | Cook the malfadine until al dente â€” drain, reserving 2 tablespoons of the pasta water | Add the drained pasta and the reserved pasta water to the sauce â€” let the pasta absorb the flavour for 1 minute | Add the butter and cheese, remove from heat, and mix everything well | Transfer to a serving dish and serve immediately

ingredients: 300g lump crabmeat (checked for shells), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 shallots (minced), 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp dry vermouth, 8 oz cream cheese (cubed), 1/2 cup GruyÃ¨re cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/2 cup half-and-half, 1/2 tsp Tabasco sauce, 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), crackers or toast rounds for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Carefully check the crabmeat for any remaining bits of shell | Melt the butter in a 2-quart heavy-bottomed pan â€” add the shallots, cayenne, and black pepper and sautÃ© over medium heat for 5 minutes | Add the garlic and sautÃ© until fragrant, about 30 seconds | Pour in the vermouth and lemon juice â€” increase heat to medium-high, scraping the bottom of the pan to deglaze, and cook uncovered for 5 minutes | Lower heat to medium-low â€” stir in the cream cheese chunks until melted and well combined | Add the GruyÃ¨re and Parmesan and stir until melted | Stir in the crabmeat, half-and-half, and Tabasco â€” mix well | Transfer to a baking dish and bake for 30 minutes | Garnish with chives and serve with crackers or toast rounds

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 2 tbsp milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1 cup rolled oats, 1/2 cup chocolate chips, 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 175Â°C (350Â°F) | Cream together the butter and both sugars | Add the egg, milk, and vanilla â€” mix well | Sift together the flour and baking soda and add to the creamed mixture â€” mix until combined | Stir in the oats, chocolate chips, and raisins | Roll the dough into balls and place on an ungreased baking sheet | Bake for 10-15 minutes until golden | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 1 can (400g) salmon (drained, liquid reserved), milk (enough to make 2 1/4 cups with salmon liquid), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp celery (diced), 1 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 4 English muffins (split and toasted), 4 hard-boiled eggs (halved), fresh parsley for garnish, lettuce and tomato slices for serving
instructions: Drain the liquid from the salmon and add enough milk to make 2 1/4 cups â€” set aside | Flake the salmon and mash any soft bones â€” set aside | Melt the butter in a heavy saucepan â€” blend in the flour, salt, and pepper | Remove from heat and stir in the milk mixture | Return to low heat and cook, stirring, until thickened | Add the salmon and Dijon mustard â€” keep warm | Toast the muffin halves and spread with a little mustard | Top with celery and chives | Arrange 2 egg halves on each muffin and top with the salmon sauce | Sprinkle with parsley and serve with lettuce and tomato slices

ingredients: 3 tbsp walnut oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp fresh thyme leaves, 1 tsp sugar, 3 ears fresh corn (kernels cut from the cob), 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1/4 red onion (diced), 1 can (400g) chickpeas (drained), mixed salad greens, crumbled veggie bacon and goat cheese for garnish
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the walnut oil, vinegar, thyme, and sugar â€” set aside | Using a serrated knife, carefully cut the corn kernels from the cobs | Add the corn, tomatoes, onion, and chickpeas to the bowl with the dressing â€” toss well | Divide the greens among 4 serving plates and top with the corn mixture | Garnish with crumbled veggie bacon, goat cheese, and chive blossoms if desired | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 cans (200g each) minced clams (drained), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp reduced-sodium Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp Tabasco sauce, 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese (grated), 8 slices white bread (crusts removed, rolled flat), 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) | Mix together the clams, onion, mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, Tabasco, and Parmesan until well combined | Cut the crusts off the bread and roll each slice with a rolling pin until very thin | Spread about 1 tablespoon of the clam mixture on each slice of bread and roll up like a jelly roll | Brush with melted butter and arrange about 1 inch apart on a greased cookie sheet | Bake for approximately 12 minutes until lightly browned | Serve hot

ingredients: 60ml spiced rum, 60ml cream of coconut, 120ml pineapple juice, 1/2 cup ice cubes, pineapple wedge and shredded coconut for garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients with ice in a blender and blend until smooth | Pour into a glass | Garnish with a pineapple wedge and shredded coconut

ingredients: 4 green tomatoes (cut into 1/4-inch-thick slices), 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp garlic salt, 1/4 tsp cracked black pepper, pinch of cayenne pepper, 1/2 cup buttermilk, vegetable oil for frying, hot pepper sauce for serving
instructions: Cut the tomatoes into 1/4-inch-thick slices | Combine the flour, cornmeal, salt, garlic salt, black pepper, and cayenne in a shallow bowl â€” mix well | Pour the buttermilk into a second shallow bowl | Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium heat | Dip each tomato slice into the buttermilk, coating both sides, then dredge in the flour mixture, shaking off the excess | Fry the tomato slices in the hot oil for 3-5 minutes per side until golden brown | Transfer to paper towels to drain | Serve immediately with hot pepper sauce

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 1/4 cups whole milk, 1/2 cup fresh blueberries, maple syrup for serving

ingredients: 500g bay scallops or sea scallops (halved horizontally if using sea scallops), 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, salt and black pepper, 4 tbsp unsalted butter (divided), 2 shallots (minced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh flat-leaf parsley (chopped), 1/4 cup dry white wine, 1 lemon (juiced)
instructions: Season the scallops with salt and pepper and toss with the flour â€” shake off the excess | Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a very large sautÃ© pan over high heat until sizzling | Add the scallops in a single layer and lower the heat to medium â€” allow them to brown lightly on one side without moving, then turn and brown the other side, about 3-4 minutes total | Melt the remaining butter in the pan, add the shallots, garlic, and parsley, and sautÃ© for 2 more minutes, tossing with the scallops | Add the wine and cook for 1 minute â€” taste for seasoning | Serve hot with a squeeze of lemon juice

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut into strips or nuggets), 1 package Shake 'n Bake coating mix, dipping sauce of choice for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) | Cut the chicken breasts into strips or nuggets as preferred | Pour the Shake 'n Bake into the provided bag, add the chicken pieces, and shake to coat evenly | Arrange on a baking sheet in a single layer | Bake for 15 minutes until golden and cooked through | Serve with your favourite dipping sauce

ingredients: 4 cups bread cubes (toasted), 2 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 tbsp water, 2 tbsp fat-free mayonnaise, 1 tsp sugar, 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 4 cups leaf lettuce (torn), 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 2 green onions (sliced), 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Place the bread cubes in a single layer on a baking sheet and lightly coat with cooking spray | Bake for 10 minutes until golden, stirring once | Combine the vinegar, water, mayonnaise, sugar, olive oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl â€” whisk until smooth | Add the toasted bread cubes, lettuce, and tomatoes â€” toss gently to coat | Sprinkle with green onions and crumbled bacon | Serve immediately

ingredients: 500g fresh green beans (trimmed), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 tsp dried marjoram, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/4 tsp dried chervil, 1/4 tsp dried savory, 1/4 tsp dried thyme, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 3 tbsp sunflower seeds (toasted), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Melt the butter in a small saucepan and add the marjoram, basil, chervil, savory, and thyme | In a large frying pan, add just enough water to cover the bottom and bring to a boil | Add the parsley, chives, garlic, and green beans â€” cook until the beans are just crisp-tender | Pour off the excess water, add the herb butter and sunflower seeds | Stir to coat and season with salt and pepper | Toss over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until well mixed | Serve hot

recipe_name: Brussels Sprouts and Potatoes in Cream Broth
ingredients: 200g Brussels sprouts (halved), 2 scallions (sliced), 100g cremini mushrooms (halved), 4 small red potatoes (quartered), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 cup chicken broth, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/2 tsp fresh thyme leaves, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 2 tbsp Parmesan or Romano cheese (grated)
instructions: Prepare the vegetables: halve the Brussels sprouts, quarter the potatoes, halve the mushrooms, and slice the scallions | Melt the butter in a large pan and sautÃ© the garlic briefly | Add the potatoes and Brussels sprouts and brown for 3-4 minutes | Add the broth and simmer on medium-low until the sprouts and potatoes are about halfway done, 7-8 minutes | Add the mushrooms and cook another 5 minutes until all the vegetables are tender and most of the broth has reduced | Stir in the cream, nutmeg, thyme, parsley, salt, and pepper â€” cook 3-4 minutes until slightly thickened | Top with grated Parmesan or Romano cheese and serve

ingredients: For biscuits: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tbsp baking powder, 1 cup half-and-half (plus extra as needed). instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Make the biscuits: combine the flour, sugar, and baking powder â€” cut in the butter or stir in the half-and-half until a soft dough forms â€” knead 3-4 times | Pat out to about 1-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface and cut into rounds | Bake for 15 minutes until golden brown | Make the filling: combine the blueberries, lemon juice, cornstarch, sugar, and water in a saucepan â€” cook over medium-high heat until boiling and thickened, then reduce heat and cook for 5 minutes | Hollow out the centres of the baked biscuits and fill with the blueberry mixture | Drizzle with the glaze just before serving

ingredients: 12 jumbo pasta shells (parboiled), 1 cup low-fat ricotta cheese, 1/2 cup fat-free cottage cheese, 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese (shredded, divided), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 tsp dried basil, 1 tsp dried parsley, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup egg substitute, 2 cups spaghetti sauce

ingredients: 4 slices bacon (diced and browned), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1/4 cup green bell pepper (diced), 1/4 cup mushrooms (sliced), 1/2 cup pepperoni (sliced and quartered), 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 4 hamburger buns (split)
instructions: Cook the diced bacon until crisp â€” drain the fat | Add the onion, green pepper, and mushrooms to the bacon and cook until the onions begin to soften, stirring often | Add the spaghetti sauce, pepperoni, oregano, and garlic powder â€” heat through | Remove from heat and let cool slightly | Stir in the cheeses | Spread the mixture on the open-faced buns and broil until bubbly and the cheese is melted | Serve immediately

ingredients: 200g orzo pasta, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 200g white button mushrooms (sliced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp fresh coarse ground black pepper, 1 cup cooked chicken strips, 1/2 cup chicken broth

ingredients: 500g bulk pork sausage, 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 1/2 red bell pepper (diced), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 10 large eggs, 1/2 cup half-and-half, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded)

ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs (chopped), 1/4 cup watercress (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 3 tbsp mayonnaise (plus extra for spreading), 1/4 tsp Tabasco sauce, salt and black pepper, 8 slices white bread (crusts removed), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (divided), 1 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup hot water
