ingredients: 1 whole roasting chicken (about 2 kg), 2 cups herb-seasoned stuffing cubes, 1 cup water, 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 box frozen chopped spinach (thawed and squeezed dry), 100g prosciutto (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp dried sage, 1 tsp dried rosemary, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, salt and black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and place a roasting rack in a large roasting pan | Rinse the chicken and pat dry | Toss the stuffing cubes with 1 cup water in a large bowl | Melt the butter in a large skillet â€” add the onion, spinach, prosciutto, garlic, sage, and rosemary â€” sautÃ© until tender, about 5 minutes | Add the spinach mixture to the stuffing and stir in the heavy cream and lemon juice â€” mix well | Loosely spoon the stuffing into the chicken cavity (about 3/4 full) | Fold the skin over the openings and secure with skewers â€” tuck the wings under | Place on the roasting rack | Roast for about 1 hour 45 minutes until an instant-read thermometer inserted in the thigh registers 180Â°F (82Â°C) and the chicken is golden | Let rest for 10 minutes before carving

ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes (peeled and diced), 1 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 large egg, 4 oz GruyÃ¨re cheese (shredded, divided), 1/2 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 1 tbsp unsalted butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and butter a 2-quart casserole | Combine the potatoes, salt, pepper, onion, egg, and half the GruyÃ¨re in a large bowl | Heat the milk and cream to boiling in a saucepan â€” combine with the potato mixture | Transfer to the prepared casserole | Sprinkle with the remaining GruyÃ¨re and dot with butter | Bake for 1 hour until the potatoes are tender | If the top isn't browned, broil briefly until lightly golden | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 3/4 cup vegetable shortening, 1/2 cup whole milk
instructions: Stir together the flour, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl | Cut the shortening into the flour mixture with a pastry blender until crumbly | Add the milk, stirring with a fork until the dry ingredients are moistened and the mixture forms a soft ball | Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead 6-8 times | Use as directed in your pie or pastry recipe

ingredients: 300g rhubarb (chopped), 1/2 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp orange juice, 1 cup self-rising flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 100g white chocolate (chopped), 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted), custard or ice cream for serving

ingredients: 4 whole trout (cleaned), 1 cup diced bread, 1/2 bell pepper (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1 celery stalk (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp paprika, heavy-duty foil and cooking spray
instructions: Mix the diced bread, parsley, salt, pepper, and paprika in a bowl | In a separate bowl, combine the onion, bell pepper, celery, and garlic | Combine everything together and stir in the melted butter | Fill each trout cavity with the stuffing mixture | Sprinkle the trout with additional paprika | Spray pieces of heavy-duty foil with cooking spray and wrap each fish tightly | Bury the foil packets in hot coals of a campfire or place on a hot grill for about 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily with a fork | Serve immediately

ingredients: 200g spaghetti (cooked and drained), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 2 tbsp margarine, 1 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), 4 large eggs, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp seasoned salt, 1/4 tsp white pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) and butter a 9 x 13-inch baking dish | SautÃ© the onion and both peppers in margarine over medium heat for 5 minutes without browning | In a large bowl, combine the onion-pepper mixture with the cooked spaghetti and toss â€” add the mozzarella and toss | In a separate bowl, beat the eggs, milk, Parmesan, basil, oregano, seasoned salt, and pepper | Add to the spaghetti mixture and stir to combine | Pour into the prepared baking dish and cover with foil | Bake for 15-20 minutes until the eggs are set â€” if not set, bake 2-3 minutes longer | Slice and serve

ingredients: 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp brown sugar, 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 500g pork tenderloin (cubed), 2 tbsp olive oil, 200g kielbasa (sliced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, fruit salsa for serving
instructions: Combine the chili powder, brown sugar, salt, and pepper â€” toss with the pork cubes to coat | Heat the olive oil in a skillet and sautÃ© the pork for 5 minutes over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally | Stir in the kielbasa and garlic â€” sautÃ© for an additional 5 minutes until the kielbasa begins to brown | Deglaze with the lime juice and boil until syrupy, about 1-2 minutes | Serve with fruit salsa

ingredients: 1/2 cup pecans (chopped), 1 box chocolate cake mix, 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix, 1/2 cup dark rum, 1/2 cup water, 1/2 cup vegetable oil, 4 large eggs. For glaze: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup unsalted butter, 2 tbsp dark rum, 2 tbsp water

ingredients: 200g asparagus spears (trimmed and steamed crisp-tender), 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 4 small pita breads, 2 plum tomatoes (sliced), 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)
instructions: Preheat oven to 450Â°F (230Â°C) | Steam the asparagus covered for 2 minutes until crisp-tender â€” rinse with cold water and drain | Combine the olive oil and garlic â€” brush over the pita breads | Arrange the tomato slices and asparagus on the pitas | Sprinkle with basil, red pepper flakes, and salt | Top evenly with the Parmesan cheese | Bake for 7-8 minutes until the edges are golden | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4-5 fresh pears (peeled, cored, and sliced), 1 unbaked 9-inch pie shell, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted), 2 large eggs, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1 tbsp Cointreau liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Arrange the pear slices in an attractive pattern in the pie shell | Beat the sugar, flour, melted butter, eggs, lemon juice, vanilla, ginger, and Cointreau with a mixer until smooth and well blended | Pour the mixture over the pears | Bake for 40-45 minutes until light brown and the top springs back when pressed | Cool on a wire rack before serving

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 4 cups green cabbage (shredded), 1 apple (peeled and diced), 2 tbsp honey or brown sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 slices bread (cubed and soaked in boiling water, squeezed dry), 2 tbsp potato starch, 3 large eggs (separated), 1/4 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and spray a 2-quart casserole with cooking spray | Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat â€” add the cabbage and cook, stirring often, over low-medium heat for about 20 minutes | Add the apple and cook for 5 minutes more | Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sweetener and the salt â€” raise the heat slightly and cook for 10 minutes until soft and slightly browned â€” cool | Soak the bread cubes in boiling water until soft, then squeeze dry | Mash the bread with the potato starch, then beat in the egg yolks | Stir in the cooled cabbage, the remaining sweetener, and the raisins | Beat the egg whites until stiff and fold them into the mixture | Spoon into the prepared casserole and bake for 40 minutes until set | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 medium potatoes (cubed and cooked), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tbsp canola oil, 3 grape tomatoes, 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 2 tbsp margarine, 2 tsp curry powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1/2 cup frozen baby peas, 1 can (400g) chickpeas (drained), 1/2 tsp salt, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Cook the cubed potatoes in salted water until tender but firm â€” drain and set aside | SautÃ© the onion in 1 tablespoon oil until clear â€” transfer to a food processor with the grape tomatoes and ginger â€” blend until smooth | Melt the margarine in a large saucepan and add the curry powder and cumin â€” sautÃ© for 4-5 minutes over medium heat, stirring often | Add the tomato mixture and cook for 5-6 minutes, stirring often | Add the chickpeas, potatoes, and frozen peas â€” cook for 5-10 minutes more until heated through | Serve hot over steamed rice

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp fresh sage (chopped), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 500g Brussels sprouts (halved), 3 parsnips (peeled and cut into chunks), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | Melt the butter in a saucepan and stir in the sage and garlic | Place the Brussels sprouts and parsnips in an ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan | Pour the butter mixture over the vegetables and stir to coat | Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes | Remove the foil and bake about 15 minutes longer until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned | Serve hot

ingredients: For dough: 1/4 cup warm water, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 4 1/4 cups all-purpose flour (divided), 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup milk, 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened). instructions: Make the dough: stir together the warm water, yeast, and a pinch of sugar â€” let stand until foamy, 5-10 minutes | Combine 5 cups flour, salt, and the remaining sugar in the bowl of an electric mixer with a dough hook | Whisk together the milk and eggs and add to the dry ingredients along with the yeast â€” beat at low speed until combined | Beat at medium speed until a very soft dough forms, about 2 minutes | Add the butter and beat until smooth, soft, and elastic, about 4 minutes | Place in a warm greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise until doubled, 45 minutes to 1 hour | Make the filling: bring the water and 1 cup sugar to a boil â€” add the cranberries and simmer until they begin to burst, about 2 minutes â€” drain and cool | Roll the dough into a 16-inch square on a floured surface | Spread with softened butter and sprinkle with the brown sugar, cinnamon, and cranberries | Roll up tightly, cut into 12 slices, and arrange in buttered cake pans | Cover and let rise for 1 hour | Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and bake for 30-35 minutes until puffed and golden | Cool for 10 minutes, then drizzle with the glaze made from confectioners sugar and milk | Serve warm

ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower (cut into florets and steamed), 1 cup cherry tomatoes (halved), 1/2 red onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 carrot (sliced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp garam masala, 1/4 cup plain fat-free yogurt, black pepper and salt to taste
instructions: Steam the cauliflower until fork-tender | Warm the olive oil in a pan and fry the onion, garlic, and carrot until soft | Add the cherry tomatoes and cook until softened | Add the cauliflower and toss to combine | Stir in the garam masala and yogurt â€” season with salt and pepper | Serve hot

ingredients: 400g rotini pasta (cooked), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 medium zucchini (diced), 1/2 cup vegetable broth, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1 can (400g) cannellini beans (drained and rinsed), salt and black pepper, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1/4 cup fresh basil (torn), Parmesan cheese for serving
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, sautÃ© the garlic and red pepper flakes in olive oil for 1 minute | Add the zucchini, turn the heat to high, and stir-fry for 1 minute | Add the broth and lemon zest â€” reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 5 minutes | Stir in the cannellini beans and heat through, about 1 minute | Remove from heat â€” season with salt and pepper and stir in the lemon juice | Add the tomatoes, cooked rotini, and basil â€” toss thoroughly | Transfer to bowls and top with grated Parmesan

ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (sliced), 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 cup frozen corn kernels, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 2 scallions (sliced), 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 8 flour tortillas, 2 cups Monterey Jack cheese (shredded), cooking spray

ingredients: 3 cups self-rising flour, 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 can (355ml) beer (room temperature)

ingredients: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 portobello mushrooms (diced), 100g shiitake mushrooms (diced), 2 cups vegetable broth, 2 tbsp tamari or soy sauce, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried sage, 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water, fresh ground black pepper

ingredients: For filling: 3 dried bean curd sheets (soaked and steamed), 4 dried shiitake mushrooms (soaked, stems removed, diced), 2 tbsp mushroom soaking liquid, 200g firm tofu (mashed), 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tbsp cornstarch, pinch of MSG (optional), 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1 sheet nori seaweed (shredded). ingredients: 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 sweet peppers (sliced), 2 medium onions (sliced), 2 tbsp fresh coriander leaves (chopped), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 4 medium potatoes (peeled and cut into large chunks), 1 1/2 cups water, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp lemon zest

ingredients: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 shallots (minced), 1/2 cup vodka, 1 cup chicken stock, 1 can (400g) crushed tomatoes, 1/2 tsp coarse salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 400g penne pasta, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 1/4 cup fresh basil (torn)

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1 tbsp ground flax seeds mixed with 3 tbsp water, 3 tbsp yogurt or kefir, 100g dark chocolate (melted), 1/2 cup frozen raspberries (thawed), 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup whole wheat flour, 1 tsp baking powder
instructions: Mix the ground flax seeds and water â€” let stand for 2-3 minutes, then blend with the raspberries and yogurt | Melt the chocolate in a double boiler or microwave | Cream the butter and both sugars together | Add the flax-raspberry mixture a bit at a time, beating well after each addition, then beat in the melted chocolate | Combine the flours and baking powder â€” gradually add to the creamed mixture | Drop by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets | Bake at 375Â°F (190Â°C) for 10-12 minutes until the edges begin to brown | Cool on wire racks

ingredients: 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup oatmeal, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp salt, 3/4 cup whole milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice added to 1/4 cup heavy cream (let sit 2 minutes), 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup dried apricots (chopped), 1/4 cup walnuts (chopped), butter for griddle, maple syrup for serving

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups warm water, 1 tbsp instant yeast, 2 tbsp honey, 1/2 cup evaporated milk, 1 tsp salt, 2 cups whole wheat flour, 1 1/2 cups white flour, 2 tbsp vegetable oil
instructions: Grease 2 empty 28-oz cans well and remove the labels | Combine the warm water, honey, oil, and evaporated milk | Stir together the flours, salt, and instant yeast â€” add the dry ingredients 1 cup at a time to the liquid, beating well after each addition | Divide the dough evenly between the two greased cans | Cover each can with greased plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the dough rises above the lip of the can | Remove the plastic wrap and bake at 350Â°F (175Â°C) for 50-60 minutes until the loaf sounds hollow when tapped | Cool in the cans for 10 minutes â€” loosen the crust with a sharp knife, slide out the loaves, and cool on a rack

recipe_name: Baked Eggs with Ham and Cheese

recipe_name: Asparagus Tart with Dill Polenta Crust

ingredients: 4-5 McIntosh apples (peeled, cored, and sliced), 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tbsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1 large egg, pinch of salt

ingredients: 2 red onions (cut into wedges), 2 medium zucchini (cubed), 2 bell peppers (chunked), 4 cloves garlic (smashed, divided), 1 small butternut squash (peeled and cubed), 2 tbsp olive oil, 4 ripe tomatoes (quartered), 2 sprigs fresh thyme, salt and black pepper. instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Place all the vegetables (except 3 garlic cloves and the cheese) in a large deep roasting tin with the oil and thyme â€” toss to coat | Roast for about 40 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften and turn golden, stirring occasionally | Pulse the reserved garlic, cheese, and bread in a food processor until they form rough breadcrumbs | Season the vegetables and sprinkle the crumbs over the top | Return to the oven for a further 15 minutes until the crumbs are golden and crispy

ingredients: 1 head broccoli (florets cut small, stems peeled and sliced), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp curry powder, 1 medium onion (diced), 4 cups chicken broth, 2 medium potatoes (diced), 2 carrots (sliced), 2 cups whole milk, 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese (shredded)
instructions: Trim the florets from the broccoli and cut into small pieces â€” discard tough stem ends, peel the remaining stems, and slice thinly | Melt the butter in a 6-8 quart pot and sautÃ© the curry powder and onion for 5 minutes | Add the broth, potatoes, broccoli stems, and carrots â€” cover and simmer until the potatoes mash easily, about 30 minutes | PurÃ©e about half the soup in a blender until smooth â€” return to the pot | Bring to a boil and add the broccoli florets and milk | Simmer uncovered until the florets are tender | Stir in the cheese a little at a time until melted | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 carrot (diced), 500g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 4 cups chicken broth, 1 bay leaf, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water, 2 tbsp dry sherry, 1/4 cup heavy cream
instructions: Melt the butter with the oil in a medium saucepan | SautÃ© the onion, garlic, and carrot for 5 minutes until softened | Stir in the mushrooms and sautÃ© for a few minutes | Add the chicken broth, bay leaf, thyme, salt, and pepper â€” bring to a boil | Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes | Discard the bay leaf and stir in the cornstarch mixture | Using a hand blender, partially purÃ©e the soup, leaving some chunks | Just before serving, reheat until very hot â€” stir in the sherry and cream and simmer for 2 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 500g fresh eel (cleaned and cut into slices), 3 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 tbsp fresh ginger (minced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 red chili (minced), 1 tbsp fermented bean curd (nam yuey), 1 celery stalk (sliced), 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 1/4 cup chicken stock, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1/4 tsp white pepper
instructions: Clean, rinse, and cut the eel into slices | Heat the oil in a wok and fry the eel until dry and crispy â€” remove and drain, reserving 3 tablespoons of the oil | Reheat the reserved oil and stir-fry the ginger, garlic, chili, and fermented bean curd for about 2 minutes to flavour the oil | Add the eel, celery, soy sauce, and sugar â€” continue to stir-fry | When the ingredients are well mixed, add the stock and boil until there is very little liquid left | Add the vinegar and mix well â€” remove from heat | Sprinkle with white pepper and serve immediately

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 500g stewing beef (cubed), 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp ground cloves, 1/2 tsp ground black pepper, 1 bay leaf, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 4 cups beef stock, 1 can (400g) chickpeas (drained), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 2 tbsp fresh coriander (chopped), black olives and coriander leaves for garnish
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan or stockpot â€” add the onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes until softened | Add the meat in batches and cook over high heat until browned on all sides | Add the cumin, cloves, pepper, and bay leaf â€” cook until fragrant | Add the tomato paste and cook for about 2 minutes, stirring constantly | Add the stock, stir well, and bring to a boil | Add the chickpeas, tomatoes, and chopped coriander â€” stir, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours until the meat is tender, stirring occasionally | Serve garnished with coriander leaves and black olives

ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin steaks (about 150g each), 3 tbsp unsalted butter (divided), 2 shallots (minced), 1 cup red wine, 1 bay leaf, 1 sprig fresh thyme, 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 1 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup beef broth, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Pan-broil the steaks in 1 tablespoon butter until a little underdone â€” keep warm | In the same pan, sautÃ© the shallots | Add the wine, bay leaf, and thyme â€” simmer until reduced to about 1/4 cup | Remove the bay leaf and strain the sauce through a sieve, pressing the shallots through â€” reserve | SautÃ© the mushrooms in the remaining 2 tablespoons butter | Stir in the flour until smooth, then add the broth â€” cook and stir until boiling and thickened | Add the reserved wine mixture and season with salt and pepper | Serve the sauce over the steaks

ingredients: 500g squash (peeled and cubed), 2 medium potatoes (peeled and cubed), 2 carrots (peeled and sliced), 1 leek (cleaned and sliced, some reserved for garnish), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp salt, 1 litre water
instructions: Bring 1 litre of water to a boil in a saucepan | Add the cubed squash, potatoes, carrots, and sliced leek | Add the olive oil and salt | Cover and cook for 25 minutes on medium heat | Remove from heat and blend with a hand blender until smooth and creamy | Serve in bowls garnished with fine strips of leek

ingredients: 2 unbaked 9-inch pie shells, 250g breakfast sausage (browned and crumbled), 1 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 4 large eggs, 1 cup whole milk, biscuits and fresh fruit for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Divide the browned sausage between the two pie shells | Combine the cheeses and divide between the pie shells | Whisk together the milk and eggs â€” pour half over each pie | Bake for approximately 30 minutes until the top is browned and the eggs are set | Serve warm with biscuits and fresh fruit

ingredients: 1 medium onion (diced), 2 green onions (sliced), 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 5 cups bread cubes, 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 6 large eggs, 2 cups whole milk, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, dash of hot sauce
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet and sautÃ© the onions and mushrooms until tender | Add the bell peppers and cook for 10 minutes until the liquid evaporates | Place 2 1/2 cups bread cubes in a greased 11 x 7-inch baking dish | Top with half the mushroom mixture and half the cheeses â€” repeat the layers | Whisk together the eggs, milk, mustard, salt, pepper, and hot sauce â€” pour over the strata | Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight | Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes while preheating the oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Bake for 45 minutes until set | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent rolls, 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup light sour cream, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 cup broccoli florets (chopped), 1/2 cup cauliflower florets (chopped), 1/4 cup black olives (sliced), 1/4 cup carrots (grated)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) | Unroll the crescent rolls and press the seams together on a cookie sheet â€” bake for 8-10 minutes until light brown | Soften the cream cheese in the microwave, then mix with the sour cream and garlic powder | Spread onto the cooled crust | Chop or grate the vegetables and scatter over the top | Cut into bite-size pieces and serve

ingredients: 4 black tea bags, 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup prepared lemonade, 1 cup apricot nectar, 1/2 tsp almond extract, 5 cups cold water, ice and fresh mint sprigs for serving
instructions: Place the tea bags and mint in a glass pitcher and pour in 2 cups cold water | Bring a kettle with 3 cups water to a rolling boil â€” pour over the tea bags and cover the pitcher | Steep for 10-15 minutes, then remove the tea bags and mint leaves | Add the sugar and stir until dissolved | Stir in the lemonade, apricot nectar, almond extract, and 3 more cups cold water | Serve over ice garnished with a fresh mint sprig

ingredients: 2 ready-made pizza bases, 1 cup Bolognese meat sauce, 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 1/2 cup mushrooms (sliced), 2 cups mozzarella cheese (shredded)
instructions: Preheat oven to 200Â°C (400Â°F) | Place one pizza base on a tray â€” spread with the meat sauce to within 1.25cm of the edge, then top with the bell pepper, mushrooms, and half the cheese | Place the second pizza base on top, pressing down slightly, and sprinkle with the remaining cheese | Bake for 20-30 minutes until the cheese is golden and the base is cooked through | Serve with a crisp tossed salad

ingredients: 6 slices bacon (cooked and diced), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 red bell pepper (diced), 2 Roma tomatoes (diced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 3 green onions (sliced), 12 large eggs, 1 cup half-and-half, 2 cups diced breakfast potatoes, 1 1/2 cups shredded hash brown potatoes, 1 cup cheddar cheese (cubed), 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp mustard powder, 1/2 tsp paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish | Cook the bacon and dice once cooled | Whisk the eggs with the half-and-half â€” stir in the salt, pepper, mustard powder, and paprika | Add both kinds of potatoes, the cheese cubes, and shredded cheese â€” mix well | Reserve a small amount of the veggies and bacon for garnish â€” add the remainder to the egg mixture | Pour into the prepared dish and top with the reserved bacon, veggies, and cheese | Bake for 50 minutes until the egg mixture is set in the centre, covering with foil halfway through | Cool slightly before serving

ingredients: 1 cup wheat berries (soaked overnight and cooked until tender), 2 Granny Smith apples (diced), 2 tbsp fresh mint (chopped), 2 green onions (sliced), 1/4 cup dried cranberries, 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp fresh orange juice, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/2 tsp ground coriander, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 cup crumbled feta (optional)
instructions: Cover the wheat berries with water and soak overnight | Drain and place in a large saucepan with 8 cups of fresh water â€” bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer uncovered for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until tender | Drain and refrigerate until completely cooled | Combine the wheat berries with the apples, mint, shallot, and cranberries | Whisk together the oil, orange juice, vinegar, coriander, and cinnamon â€” pour over the salad and stir to combine | Top with feta if using | Serve chilled or at room temperature

ingredients: 4 large pita breads (cut into triangles), 1 tsp yellow mustard seeds, 1 tsp caraway seeds, 1 tbsp sesame seeds, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 3 tbsp olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Toss the mustard seeds, caraway seeds, sesame seeds, pepper, and salt together in a small bowl | Arrange the pita triangles smooth-side down on a large baking sheet | Brush with olive oil and sprinkle with the seed mixture | Bake for about 10 minutes until crisp and golden | Cool completely | Best consumed on the day of baking

ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed), 3/4 cup buttermilk, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 ripe mangoes (peeled and diced). For topping: 1/3 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, whipped cream for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan | Combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, nutmeg, and salt â€” cut in the butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs | Combine the buttermilk, eggs, and vanilla â€” add to the flour mixture all at once and stir just until moistened | Fold in the diced mangoes | Spread in the prepared pan | Combine the sugar and cinnamon for the topping and sprinkle evenly over the batter | Bake for 40-45 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool slightly and serve with whipped cream

ingredients: 500g jumbo shrimp (butterflied), 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 2 large eggs (beaten), 3 tbsp canola oil, 3 cloves garlic (smashed), 1/4 cup dry white wine, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/4 tsp fine sea salt, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp cold unsalted butter, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), lemon wedges for serving
instructions: Place the flour and beaten eggs in two separate shallow bowls | Heat the oil in a 12-inch sautÃ© pan over medium-high heat | Dredge each shrimp in flour, shaking off the excess, then dip in the egg wash | Place the shrimp butterflied-side down in the hot oil and cook undisturbed for 3 minutes until pale golden | Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more | Drain off all but about 1 teaspoon of the oil | Add the white wine, lemon juice, and salt â€” bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute | Transfer the shrimp to heated plates | Increase heat to high, whisk in the mustard, and simmer the sauce until reduced by two-thirds, about 2 minutes | Remove from heat and swirl in the cold butter until the sauce comes together | Discard the garlic, spoon the sauce over the shrimp, and sprinkle parsley around the edges | Serve with lemon wedges

recipe_name: Hot Stuffed Banana Peppers with Turkey
ingredients: 8 banana peppers (tops cut off, halved, and seeded), 250g ground turkey, 1/2 medium onion (diced and sautÃ©ed), 2 cloves garlic (minced and sautÃ©ed), 1 tbsp fresh sage (chopped), 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp olive oil, marinara sauce for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | Cut the tops off the peppers, remove the seeds, and slice them in half lengthwise â€” rub each with olive oil (wear gloves when handling) | Combine the turkey, sage, breadcrumbs, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl | SautÃ© the onion until softened, about 4-5 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute â€” add to the turkey mixture and mix well | Stuff each pepper half with the mixture and place in a baking dish | Cover and bake for 45 minutes | Serve with marinara sauce

ingredients: For cake: 4 large eggs, 1 cup cashews (chopped), 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple (undrained). For frosting: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 1/2 cups confectioners sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a 13 x 9-inch pan | Combine the eggs, cashews, sugar, flour, baking soda, and pineapple in a large bowl â€” mix well | Pour into the prepared pan | Bake for 40-45 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean â€” cool completely | Make the frosting: beat the butter and cream cheese together until smooth â€” gradually beat in the confectioners sugar and vanilla | Frost the cooled cake | Keep refrigerated

ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 cup apple juice, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Season the pork chops with salt and pepper | Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat | Brown the chops on both sides | Pour the apple juice over the top and simmer gently until the juice has evaporated and the sauce becomes thick, sticky, and browned â€” stir constantly at the end | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 cups chicken broth, 1 tbsp sriracha sauce, 1 celery stalk (diced), 1 carrot (diced), 1 stalk lemongrass (chopped), 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 200g medium shrimp (peeled), 1 cup cooked rice, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 2 tbsp fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Put the chicken broth, sriracha, celery, and carrot in a medium saucepan and bring to a simmer | Add the lemongrass, fish sauce, and sugar â€” simmer for another 5 minutes | Stir in the shrimp and rice â€” simmer just until the shrimp are pink and opaque, about 2-3 minutes | Remove from heat and stir in the lime juice and cilantro | Ladle into bowls and serve immediately

ingredients: 1/2 cup dried split peas (rinsed), 2 cups vegetable broth, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 cup frozen peas, 200g orzo pasta (cooked and cooled), 2 green onions (sliced), 2 tbsp fresh mint (chopped), 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp lemon zest, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, butter lettuce leaves for serving, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Sort through the split peas and rinse | Bring the broth to a boil, add the split peas and thyme â€” reduce heat, cover, and simmer until tender, about 25 minutes â€” drain | Transfer to a large bowl and gently mix in the frozen peas â€” let cool | Cook the orzo until just tender, drain, rinse with cold water, and drain well | Add the orzo to the peas along with the onions and mint â€” mix gently | Whisk together the oil, lemon zest, and lemon juice â€” pour over the salad and mix gently | Serve on lettuce-lined plates garnished with mint and thyme sprigs

recipe_name: Cauliflower and Sweet Potato Curry Soup
ingredients: 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tbsp curry powder, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1 small head cauliflower (cut into florets), 2 medium sweet potatoes (peeled and cubed), 4 cups vegetable stock, 1 tbsp honey, low-fat sour cream and fresh cilantro for garnish
instructions: Spray a large saucepan with cooking spray and heat the oil | SautÃ© the garlic and onion until softened, about 5 minutes | Add the curry powder, cinnamon, salt, pepper, cauliflower, stock, sweet potatoes, and honey â€” bring to a boil | Cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 25 minutes until the potatoes are tender | Transfer to a blender or food processor and purÃ©e until creamy and smooth | Return to the saucepan and thin with more stock if desired | Ladle into bowls and garnish with a dollop of sour cream and cilantro

ingredients: 4 slices bacon (fried crisp and crumbled), 3 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp Tabasco sauce, 2 avocados (diced), 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1 shallot (minced), salad greens for serving
instructions: Fry the bacon until crisp â€” drain and set aside | Whisk together the oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, and Tabasco in a medium bowl | Add the avocados, tomatoes, shallots, and crumbled bacon â€” toss gently | Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours | To serve, place salad greens on plates and use a slotted spoon to add the salad on top

ingredients: 4 thick slices bread (toasted on both sides), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese (grated), 1/4 cup ale or beer, 1 tsp English mustard, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Toast the bread on both sides and set aside | Melt the butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat | Add the cheese and ale, stirring constantly | Add the mustard, salt, and pepper | Spread the mixture on the toast and place under the broiler until browned and bubbling | Serve immediately

ingredients: 6 chicken sausages, 1 carrot (diced and boiled), 1 potato (diced and boiled), 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp mango chutney, 1 tbsp curry powder, 1/2 cup mango nectar, 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp nectar, 1 ripe mango (sliced), salt to taste, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Cook the sausages in a large frying pan over medium heat â€” remove and set aside | Boil the carrot and potato until just soft â€” drain and set aside | Wipe out the pan and sautÃ© the onion and garlic in oil until the onion is translucent | Stir in the nectar, curry powder, and chutney | Mix the cornstarch with the 2 tablespoons of nectar until smooth â€” stir into the curry mixture and bring to a boil, stirring, until thickened | Lower the temperature to a simmer | Slice the sausages and add to the curry along with the potato and carrot â€” stir to combine and add salt to taste | Heat through, then stir in the sliced mango just before serving | Serve with rice

ingredients: 2 cups fresh or frozen cranberries (coarsely chopped), 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup eggnog, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted), 2 large eggs, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract. For streusel: 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp cold unsalted butter, 1/4 cup pecans (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) and grease a muffin tin | Mix the cranberries with 2 tablespoons sugar and set aside | Combine the dry ingredients in a bowl | In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggnog, melted butter, eggs, and vanilla â€” add to the dry ingredients without overmixing | Fold in the sugared cranberries and drop into the prepared muffin cups | Make the streusel: combine the flour and sugar, cut in the butter until crumbly, then mix in the pecans | Sprinkle over the tops of the muffins | Bake for 15-20 minutes just until the tops are set â€” do not overbake

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup all-purpose flour, 2 large eggs, 2 tbsp lemon zest, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp sea salt. For glaze: 1/2 cup icing sugar, 1 tbsp lemon zest, 2-3 tbsp fresh lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease an 8 x 8-inch baking dish | Beat the flour, sugar, salt, and softened butter until combined | In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, lemon zest, and lemon juice â€” pour into the flour mixture and beat for 2 minutes until smooth and creamy | Pour into the prepared dish and bake for 23-25 minutes until the edges turn golden | Cool completely before glazing | Make the glaze: whisk together the icing sugar, lemon zest, and juice until smooth â€” spread over the cooled brownies | Let the glaze set, then cut into bars

ingredients: 60ml white rum, 15ml maraschino liqueur, 45ml fresh lime juice, 45ml fresh grapefruit juice, crushed ice
instructions: Squeeze the lime juice into a cocktail shaker | Add the rum, maraschino liqueur, grapefruit juice, and crushed ice | Shake briefly and strain into a frosted cocktail glass | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 large eggplant (cubed), 1 medium onion (sliced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 cup dry white wine, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 2 tbsp tapenade, 1 tsp dried basil, 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, salt and black pepper, 3 tbsp olive oil, 200g angel hair pasta, Parmesan or crumbled feta for serving
instructions: Slice the eggplant into 1-inch slices, salt, and set aside to drain | Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the pasta | Pat the eggplant dry and cook in olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it starts to brown | Add the sliced onion and cook for 1 minute | Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds | Pour in the wine and reduce by half | Add the tapenade, tomatoes, basil, and red pepper â€” season with salt and pepper | Cook the angel hair pasta while the sauce simmers | Serve the sauce over the pasta topped with Parmesan or crumbled feta

ingredients: For crust: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed), 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 3-4 tbsp cold water. For filling: 2 apples (sliced), 1 pear (sliced), 2 nectarines (sliced), 2 plums (sliced), 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground ginger, 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 tbsp dry breadcrumbs. For topping: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup hazelnuts (chopped), 1/4 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed)
instructions: Preheat oven to 200Â°C (400Â°F) | Make the crust: cut the flour and butter together until crumbly, add the sugar and water, and quickly mix into a dough â€” wrap in cling film and refrigerate for 30 minutes | Roll out the dough and line a 24cm pie dish | Make the topping: cut together all the topping ingredients until crumbly | Prepare the filling: toss the sliced fruit with lemon juice, then mix with the cinnamon, ginger, and sugar | Sprinkle some of the breadcrumbs over the dough and layer the fruit and spice mixture in the dish | Sprinkle the topping evenly over the fruit | Bake for 30 minutes until the fruit is tender and the topping is golden | Serve warm with whipped cream or vanilla sauce

ingredients: 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium yellow onion (diced), 2 tbsp curry powder, 1/2 cup plain yogurt, 1/4 cup heavy cream, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped), steamed basmati rice for serving
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan and cook the onion over medium-low heat for 7 minutes | Sprinkle with the curry powder, stir, and cook for 1 minute | Add the yogurt and cream â€” cook for 3 minutes | Stir in the chicken, tomatoes, salt, and cilantro â€” cook until heated through | Serve over hot basmati rice

ingredients: 1/2 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp molasses, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 large eggs, 1 1/2 cups rolled oats, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup chocolate chips, 1/2 cup nuts (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and grease a 15 x 10 or 13 x 9-inch pan | Beat the brown sugar and shortening until light and fluffy | Add the molasses, vanilla, and eggs â€” blend well | Stir in the oats, flour, baking soda, and salt â€” blend well | Stir in the nuts and chocolate chips | Spread in the prepared pan | Bake for 20-25 minutes until light golden brown and the centre is set | Cool slightly and cut into bars

ingredients: 4 cups romaine lettuce (chopped), 2 cooked chicken breasts (sliced), 1/2 cup crumbled Gorgonzola cheese, 1/4 cup dried cranberries, 1/4 cup walnuts (chopped), 1/4 cup raspberry vinaigrette
instructions: Chop the lettuce and place in a large bowl | Add the Gorgonzola, cranberries, walnuts, and raspberry vinaigrette â€” toss until coated | Chill for about 20 minutes before serving

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1/4 cup blue cheese (crumbled), 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/2 cup Bisquick baking mix, 1/2 cup milk, 2 large eggs, 1/4 cup French-fried onions
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) and spray 12 muffin cups with cooking spray | Cook the beef and onion over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes until browned â€” drain and cool for 5 minutes, then stir in the blue cheese and Worcestershire | Stir together the baking mix, milk, and eggs until blended | Spoon 1 scant tablespoon of batter into each muffin cup, top with about 1/4 cup burger mixture, then cover with 1 tablespoon batter | Bake for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | After 10 minutes of baking, sprinkle French-fried onions on top of each muffin â€” close the oven and finish baking | Cool for 5 minutes before removing from the pan

ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, 2 cups water, 1/4 tsp salt, 3/4 cup milk, 2 tbsp dry milk powder, 2 tbsp honey, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground allspice, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 tbsp orange zest, 1/4 cup raisins, orange slices for garnish
instructions: Combine the rice, water, and salt in a saucepan â€” bring to a boil, stir, cover, and reduce to a simmer | Simmer for 35-40 minutes until the rice is cooked | Add enough milk to cover the rice | Stir in the dry milk powder, honey, cinnamon, allspice, nutmeg, orange zest, and raisins | Cook over medium heat until heated through | Serve garnished with orange slices

ingredients: 500g large prawns (shelled and deveined, shells reserved), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 4 cups hot water, 1 tsp salt, 2 stalks lemongrass (bruised), 1 tsp lemon zest, 2 kaffir lime leaves, 2 whole red chilies, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp fresh lemon juice, fresh coriander leaves and spring onions for garnish
instructions: Shell and devein the prawns, reserving the heads and shells â€” wash well and drain | Heat the oil in a saucepan and fry the prawn heads and shells until they turn pink | Add the hot water, salt, lemongrass, lemon zest, lime leaves, and whole chilies â€” bring to a boil, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes | Add the fish sauce and lemon juice to taste â€” the soup should have a pronounced sour flavour | Serve in a large tureen or individual bowls, sprinkled with sliced chili, coriander leaves, and spring onions

ingredients: 8 cups crusty bread cubes, 6 tbsp olive oil (divided), 1 cup Parmesan cheese (grated, divided), 1/4 cup unsalted butter, 2 red onions (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 2 red bell peppers (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh rosemary (chopped), 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 cup pine nuts, 3/4 cup fresh basil (chopped, divided), 2 large eggs (beaten), 1-2 cups low-sodium chicken broth, salt and black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) and spray 2 baking sheets with nonstick spray | Toss half the bread cubes with 3 tablespoons oil and 1/2 cup Parmesan and spread on one sheet â€” repeat with the remaining bread | Bake until golden, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes â€” cool and transfer to a large bowl | Melt the butter with the remaining 2 tablespoons oil in a large pot â€” sautÃ© the onions, celery, and bell peppers until beginning to brown, about 15 minutes | Add the garlic, rosemary, and oregano â€” stir for 1 minute | Add the pine nuts and stir for 2 minutes â€” transfer to the bowl with the bread | Stir in 1/2 cup basil and the remaining 1/2 cup Parmesan â€” season generously with salt and pepper â€” mix in the beaten eggs | Add enough broth to moisten as desired | Transfer to a buttered baking dish, cover with buttered foil, and bake at 350Â°F (175Â°C) for 40 minutes â€” uncover and bake for 20 minutes more until the top is crisp and golden | Sprinkle with the remaining basil and serve

ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tbsp gram flour, 2 tbsp plain yogurt, 1/2 cup water (approximately), pinch of baking soda, ghee or oil for deep frying. For syrup: 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup water, few saffron threads
instructions: Make the batter: combine the flour, gram flour, yogurt, and water in a mixing bowl â€” whisk until smooth with no lumps, achieving a ribbon consistency (when dropped from a spoon, the batter should fall like a ribbon) â€” mix for 5-7 minutes | Add a pinch of baking soda | Pour the batter into a squeeze bottle or piping bag fitted with a small round tip | Make the syrup: heat the sugar and water until dissolved, add saffron, and keep warm | Heat the ghee or oil in a frying pan over low-medium heat | Squeeze the batter into the hot oil in concentric circles to form the jalebis | Fry until lightly golden on both sides | Drain excess oil and immediately drop into the warm syrup â€” toss to coat well, then drain excess syrup | Serve hot or warm

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 carrots (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 200g white mushrooms (sliced), 1 can (400g) crushed tomatoes, 3/4 cup dried lentils, 1/2 cup pearl barley, 6 cups water, 2 vegetable bouillon cubes, 2 cups fresh spinach, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat â€” sautÃ© the garlic, Italian seasoning, carrots, celery, onion, and mushrooms for a few minutes until they start to soften | Add the water, bouillon, lentils, tomatoes, spinach, and barley | Increase heat to high until the water boils | Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 1-2 hours until the lentils are cooked through | PurÃ©e the soup in batches or use a hand blender for a smoother consistency | Serve hot

recipe_name: Grilled Steak with Rosemary Mustard Butter
ingredients: 2 sirloin or ribeye steaks (about 200g each), 4 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 1 tbsp fresh rosemary (chopped), 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, jacket potatoes and salad for serving
instructions: Make the compound butter: beat the softened butter until light and fluffy | Mix in the rosemary, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, and black pepper | Spoon the butter onto a piece of parchment paper and roll into a log shape â€” twist the ends to seal | Refrigerate for at least 1 hour until firm (keeps for several days or can be frozen) | Grill the steaks to your liking and let rest for 2-3 minutes | Slice the butter into thick rounds and place one on top of each grilled steak | Serve with jacket potatoes and a fresh garden salad

ingredients: 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 1/2 cup warm milk, 2 tbsp vegetable shortening, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, vegetable oil for deep frying
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the warm milk and let stand for 10 minutes until foamy | Stir in the shortening | Gradually add the flour, sugar, and salt â€” mix until smooth | Cover with a damp cloth or plastic wrap and let rise until doubled, about 2 hours | Roll the dough out on a floured board into a rectangle 1/4-inch thick | Heat the oil in a deep fryer or large skillet to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | Cut the dough with a biscuit cutter and drop a few at a time into the hot oil | Fry until puffed and golden on both sides | Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels | Can be reheated in a 200Â°F oven for 5-10 minutes

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 2 cups water, zest of 2 lemons, 2 tbsp fresh thyme leaves, 3/4 cup fresh lemon juice (about 4-6 lemons), 1 large egg white (beaten, optional)
instructions: Bring the sugar, water, and lemon zest to a boil in a heavy saucepan â€” boil briskly for 5 minutes without stirring until the sugar dissolves | Reduce heat to a simmer, stir well, and simmer for 5 minutes longer | Remove from heat, add the thyme leaves, cover, and steep for 1 hour | Strain through a fine-mesh sieve, discarding the zest and thyme â€” stir in the lemon juice | Cover and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled | Transfer to an ice cream maker and freeze according to the manufacturer's instructions | For a lighter texture, add the beaten egg white after the first hour of freezing | Scoop into glasses and serve immediately

ingredients: For base: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (cold, cubed), 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 cup caster sugar, 2 large egg yolks, 2-3 tbsp milk, apricot or raspberry jam for spreading. For meringue: 2 large egg whites, 2 tbsp caster sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400Â°F (200Â°C) and grease a shallow baking dish | Sift the flour and baking powder together and rub in the cold butter until crumbly | Add the cinnamon and sugar, then the egg yolks and enough milk to bind to a fairly stiff batter | Turn into the prepared dish and bake for about 20 minutes | Cool and spread with jam | Make the meringue: beat the egg whites until stiff, fold in the sugar, and beat again until shiny | Pile on top of the base and return to a cooler oven (325Â°F / 160Â°C) to set until the peaks are tipped with gold | Serve warm or at room temperature

ingredients: 4 catfish fillets (about 150g each), 2 large eggs, 2 tbsp milk, 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp dried parsley, cooking spray, lemon wedges for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 425Â°F (220Â°C) | Whisk together the eggs and milk in a bowl | Combine the cornmeal, Parmesan, flour, salt, basil, and parsley on a piece of wax paper | Spray a glass baking dish with cooking spray | Rinse the catfish and pat very dry with paper towels | Dip each fillet in the egg mixture, then dredge lightly in the breading | Place in the prepared dish and refrigerate for 10 minutes | Bake for 10-12 minutes per side until golden and the fish flakes easily | Serve with lemon wedges

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 tbsp mayonnaise or salad dressing, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple (drained), 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped), 1 banana (sliced), 1 cup heavy cream (whipped), 1 can (400g) jellied cranberry sauce (cut into chunks)
instructions: Beat the cream cheese, salad dressing, lemon juice, and salt until smooth | Stir in the pineapple, walnuts, and banana | Whip the cream and fold into the mixture | Lightly fold in the cranberry chunks | Line a 9 x 5-inch pan with wax paper, including the sides | Turn the mixture into the pan and freeze until firm | Slice and serve frozen

ingredients: 200g cooked ham (cut into cubes), 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/4 tsp onion powder, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, pinch of ground cloves, 1 tbsp prepared yellow mustard, 2 tbsp ketchup, 2 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp sweet pickle relish, crackers or bread for serving
instructions: Place the ham cubes in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped or purÃ©ed â€” transfer to a bowl | Process the cream cheese, onion powder, garlic powder, cloves, mustard, and ketchup until well mixed | Add the ham back to the processor and mix until well combined | Transfer to a bowl and stir in the mayonnaise and sweet relish | Taste and adjust the seasoning | Chill for at least 1 hour for the flavours to blend | Serve with crackers or bread

ingredients: 4 crispy tostada shells, 1 cup refried beans, 1 cup lettuce (shredded), 1/2 cup diced tomato, 1/2 cup crumbled queso fresco, salsa for serving
instructions: Warm the tostada shells according to package directions | Spread the refried beans on each shell | Top with shredded lettuce, diced tomato, and crumbled queso fresco | Serve warm with salsa on the side

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg (beaten), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup self-rising flour, 24 macadamia nuts (for topping)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat until golden brown â€” cool but do not let it set | Beat in the sugar, then the beaten egg and vanilla | Work in the flour until a dough forms | Roll the dough into walnut-sized balls and place on a baking tray, allowing plenty of room to spread | Press a macadamia nut on top of each biscuit | Bake for 10-15 minutes until golden | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 200g extra sharp cheddar cheese (grated), 2 roasted red peppers (drained and finely chopped), 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp prepared horseradish, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, crackers or bread for serving
instructions: Rinse, drain, pat dry, and finely chop the roasted red peppers | Stir all ingredients together in a bowl until well combined | Serve immediately or refrigerate until needed | Serve with crackers or bread

ingredients: 4 cups frozen diced potatoes (thawed), 2 cups cooked ham (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1 can (400g) cream of celery soup, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1 cup shredded cheese, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Combine the two soups (undiluted) with the sour cream in a large mixing bowl â€” mix well | Stir in the ham, onion, and potatoes until combined | Transfer to a greased casserole dish | Bake for 25 minutes | Sprinkle the cheese over the top and bake 5 more minutes until melted | Let cool for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 3 cups fresh strawberries (hulled and purÃ©ed), 2 large eggs, 1 1/4 cups granulated sugar, 2 cups half-and-half, 1/4 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Wash, hull, and purÃ©e the strawberries | In a large bowl, beat the eggs until thick and lemon-coloured | Beat in the sugar, half-and-half, vanilla, and heavy cream | Stir in the strawberry purÃ©e | Chill the mixture in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour | Freeze in an ice cream maker according to the manufacturer's directions (about 30 minutes) | Transfer to a freezer-safe container and freeze until firm

ingredients: 1 cup prepared mincemeat, 1 cup water, 1 package (85g) cherry gelatin, 3 cups water (for gelatin), 1/2 cup English walnuts (chopped)
instructions: Break the mincemeat into small pieces and cover with 1 cup of water in a saucepan | Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute â€” cool | Prepare the gelatin using 3 cups water according to package directions | When the gelatin is slightly thickened, stir in the mincemeat mixture and the chopped walnuts | Pour into a mould or serving dish | Refrigerate until set

ingredients: 200g sausage meat (cooked and crumbled), 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup black olives (sliced), 3 tbsp ranch salad dressing, 1/4 cup red bell pepper (diced), 12 wonton wrappers, cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) and lightly oil a mini muffin tin | Combine the cooked sausage with the cheeses, ranch dressing, olives, and red pepper | Press a wonton wrapper into each muffin cup, leaving the corners sticking up | Brush the wrappers lightly with oil and bake for 5 minutes until golden | Remove the wrappers from the tin and place on a baking sheet | Fill each with the sausage-cheese mixture | Bake for 5 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and brown | Serve hot

ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (chopped), 1/2 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp sugar substitute, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp raisins, 1 tsp orange zest, unsweetened cocoa powder for dredging
instructions: Place the chocolate in a large bowl | Bring the cream, sugar substitute, butter, raisins, and orange zest to a boil in a medium pan | Slowly pour over the chocolate and stir until smooth | Refrigerate for 2-3 hours until firm | Shape the mixture into small balls | Dredge each truffle in cocoa powder | Store in the refrigerator

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef (browned), 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1 sweet onion (diced), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 yellow bell pepper (diced), 4 cups lettuce (shredded), 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese (grated), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) tomato soup, 1/2 cup half-and-half cream, salt and black pepper, toasted bread slices for serving
instructions: Brown the ground beef and place in a serving bowl | Dice the tomatoes, onion, peppers, and lettuce â€” place in separate serving bowls â€” grate the cheese into another bowl | Heat the tomato soup with the half-and-half, minced garlic, salt, and pepper â€” simmer on low for 20 minutes, stirring often | Toast two slices of bread per person | To serve: place the toast on each plate, let each person add toppings with cheese last, and ladle the hot sauce over the top | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 oz dried red chilies (soaked in warm water for 45 minutes, drained, stems and seeds removed), 4 cloves garlic, 2 tbsp water, 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil (plus extra for storage), 1/2 tsp caraway seeds, 1/2 tsp ground coriander, 1/2 tsp salt

ingredients: 400g fettuccine pasta, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened, divided), 1 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)

ingredients: 2 round sesame seed pita breads (halved), 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 2 tbsp apricot jam, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon

ingredients: 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 1 cup cooked white rice, 1 cup green beans (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 cup water chestnuts (sliced), 1/4 cup pimientos (diced), 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/4 tsp ground cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/2 tsp salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Melt the butter in a heavy skillet and sautÃ© the onion and garlic until soft, about 15-20 minutes | In a large bowl, combine all the remaining ingredients with the sautÃ©ed onion and garlic | Pour into a greased 3-quart casserole dish | Bake for 20-25 minutes until bubbly | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 cups cooked ham (diced), 1 cup sauerkraut (drained and chopped), 1 cup Swiss cheese (cubed), 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp caraway seeds, 1/2 tsp dried dill weed, 1/3 cup mayonnaise, 1 tbsp prepared mustard, bread or crackers for serving
instructions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients together in a mixing bowl | Chill for at least 30 minutes or serve right away | Serve on bread or with crackers

ingredients: 1.5 kg beef brisket, 3 cups red wine (divided), 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 3 tsp garlic (minced, divided), 1 tsp white pepper, 1 tsp paprika, 1 bay leaf, 3 tbsp vegetable oil (divided), 2 medium onions (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 1 packet onion soup mix, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1 cup beer, 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1/2 cup ketchup, 1 cup beef broth
instructions: Place the brisket in a sealed plastic bag with 2 cups of wine, Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp garlic, white pepper, paprika, and the bay leaf â€” marinate overnight | Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large Dutch oven and sautÃ© the onions and carrots until softened â€” remove and set aside | Drain the marinade and reserve â€” pat the onion soup mix, flour, and salt onto the meat | Heat the remaining oil and brown the meat on all sides | Add the remaining wine, beer, mushroom soup, ketchup, broth, remaining garlic, reserved marinade, and cooked vegetables â€” the meat should be covered by the liquid | Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 1 hour | Preheat oven to 325Â°F (160Â°C) | Place the covered pot in the oven for 3-4 hours until very tender | Cool slightly, remove the meat, and slice â€” return to the gravy and refrigerate overnight | Skim the fat and reheat in the oven at 325Â°F until piping hot | Serve with mashed potatoes or noodle pudding

recipe_name: Plum Tomatoes and Artichokes with Penne
ingredients: 1 can (400g) artichoke hearts (drained, oil reserved), 3 tbsp artichoke oil marinade, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 6 plum tomatoes (diced), 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, black pepper, 2 tbsp fresh flat-leaf parsley (chopped), 400g penne pasta (cooked)

ingredients: 3 apples (peeled and sliced), 2 cups fresh blackberries, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 tsp all-purpose flour. For topping: 1 cup granulated sugar, 3/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed)

ingredients: 30ml cherry brandy, 30ml advocaat liqueur, 30ml heavy cream, 120ml lemonade, ice cubes

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cooked and shredded), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with green chilies, 1 can (200g) diced green chilies, 1 can (400g) enchilada sauce (divided), 1 can (400g) black beans (rinsed), 1 cup shredded cheese (divided), 8 corn tortillas, 1/4 cup black olives (sliced), 2 green onions (sliced), sour cream for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 375Â°F (190Â°C) | Cook and shred the chicken â€” place in a skillet with the tomatoes, green chilies, and half the enchilada sauce â€” cover and simmer for 30 minutes to 1 hour | Mix the rinsed beans and a handful of cheese into the meat mixture | Pour a little enchilada sauce into the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish | Layer tortillas, meat mixture, more sauce â€” repeat, ending with tortillas, sauce, and a good layer of cheese | Top with sliced olives and green onions | Bake for about 30 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly | Cool for 5 minutes and serve with sour cream

ingredients: 500g kielbasa (sliced), 1 medium yellow onion (diced), 1/2 cup cocktail sauce, 2 cans (400g each) baked beans, salt and black pepper to taste

ingredients: For pastry: 3 large eggs (separated), 1/4 tsp cream of tartar, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 cup ricotta cheese, 2 tbsp sugar substitute. For filling: 2 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 tbsp sugar substitute, 1/4 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 large egg yolk
instructions: Preheat oven to 300Â°F (150Â°C) | Separate the eggs, saving 1/2 yolk for the filling | Whip the egg whites with cream of tartar until very stiff | In a separate bowl, mix the yolks, cinnamon, ricotta, and sugar substitute until smooth | Fold the yolk mixture into the beaten whites until well combined | Portion into 6 mounds on a buttered or oiled baking sheet â€” make an indentation in the top of each | Make the filling: soften the cream cheese and stir in the remaining ingredients until smooth | Spoon the filling into the indentations | Bake for 30-40 minutes until golden | Cool and store covered in the refrigerator

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 1/2 cup honey, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp ground cardamom, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 4 cups all-purpose flour

ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1/2 cup sour cream, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2 green onions with tops (sliced), 1 tbsp tarragon vinegar, 1 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1/4 tsp garlic salt, 1/4 tsp ground pepper, milk for thinning if needed

ingredients: 2 cups walnuts (toasted and chopped), 1/4 cup honey, 1/4 cup dried pears (chopped), 1/2 tsp herbes de Provence, 1/2 tsp ground coriander, 1 tsp orange zest, 1 tbsp fresh orange juice, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/4 tsp coarse salt, sliced baguette and goat cheese for serving
instructions: Preheat the broiler | Coarsely chop 1 cup of the walnuts and finely chop the remaining cup | Combine all nuts with the honey, pears, herbes de Provence, coriander, orange zest, juices, and salt â€” beat vigorously until combined | Place the baguette slices on a baking sheet and top each with a piece of goat cheese | Broil just until the cheese is melted, watching closely | Top each slice with a spoonful of the honey walnut spread and serve immediately

ingredients: 400g cavatappi pasta, 1 cup heavy whipping cream, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 medium onion (diced), 100g mushrooms (sliced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 100g capicolla ham (diced), 2 tbsp fresh basil (torn), salt and black pepper, 1/2 cup fresh pea pods, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)

ingredients: 2 cups fresh pineapple chunks, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 8 fresh mint leaves, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 cup club soda, sugar for rimming glasses, ice cubes, mint sprigs for garnish
instructions: Place the pineapple, lime juice, mint, and sugar in a blender â€” blend on high for 30 seconds to 1 minute until frothy | Pour into a tall pitcher and add the club soda â€” stir once or twice to combine | Rim the glasses with sugar and fill with ice | Pour the agua fresca into the glasses and garnish each with a mint sprig | Serve immediately

ingredients: 3 large egg whites, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup graham cracker crumbs, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup pecans (chopped), 1/2 tsp baking powder, whipped cream for serving

ingredients: 2 cans (400g each) chickpeas (drained), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 red onion (diced and sautÃ©ed), 1/4 cup fresh parsley (chopped), 2 green onions (sliced), juice of 1 lemon, 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese, 3 tbsp olive oil, salt and black pepper to taste

ingredients: 2 sirloin steaks (about 200g each), 1 clove garlic (halved). For sauce: 1/4 cup dry white wine, 2 tbsp tarragon vinegar, 1 tbsp fresh tarragon (chopped), 1 shallot (minced), 1/4 tsp ground pepper, 2 large egg yolks, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted and sizzling hot)
instructions: Rub both sides of the steaks with the cut garlic clove | Grill the steaks to your preference â€” let rest for 5 minutes | Slice thinly and arrange on plates | Make the sauce: bring the wine, vinegar, tarragon, shallot, and pepper to a boil â€” boil rapidly until reduced to 2 tablespoons â€” remove from heat | In a food processor, combine the egg yolks, salt, and the reduced vinegar mixture â€” process for 2 seconds | With the processor running, slowly drizzle in the sizzling hot butter in a thin steady stream until the sauce is thick and blended | Serve warm over the sliced steak

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 1 medium onion (diced), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup uncooked long-grain rice, 1 can (400g) condensed tomato soup, 1/2 cup water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350Â°F (175Â°C) | Mix the ground beef, onion, salt, pepper, and uncooked rice together | Form into 1 1/2-inch balls and arrange in a baking dish | Mix the soup and water together and pour over the meatballs | Cover and bake for 1 hour until the rice is tender | Serve hot

ingredients: For meatballs: 500g ground beef, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 cup onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 large egg, 1/4 cup breadcrumbs. For sauce: 1 can (400g) cranberry sauce, 1/2 cup ketchup, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice
instructions: Combine all meatball ingredients and form into 25 small balls | Combine all sauce ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil for a few minutes | Add the meatballs and reduce heat | Cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the meatballs are cooked through | Serve hot

ingredients: For crust: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup powdered sugar, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted). ingredients: 2 cups sorghum syrup, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 tbsp white vinegar, 1/2 tsp baking soda, corn starch for cutting

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter, 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 cup whole milk, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 100g dark chocolate (melted)

ingredients: 2 large Romano Pepper, 800g Lamb Mince, 3  tablespoons Red Pepper Paste, 1 tablespoon Pul Biber, 3  tablespoons Sunflower Oil
instructions: step 1 | Finely chop the peppers in a food processor, then tip them in a sieve and press into the sieve so that the peppers release all of their juices. Tip into a bowl along with the mince, red pepper paste, pul biber, 1½ tsp flaky sea salt, and 2 tbsp of the oil. Mix together, kneading well for at least 2-3 mins. If you need to, wet your hands with cold water to prevent the mixture from sticking. The mixture should be sticky when ready. Cover and chill for at least 2 hrs, or up to 12 hrs. | step 2 | When ready to cook, heat the grill to high or an oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 6. Divide the mixture into 12 equal portions, around 85g each. If you’d like to skewer them, divide into 8 equal portions and roll into balls. Using wet hands, thread the balls onto the end of the skewers, massaging the mixture down the skewers in between the palms of your hands, until evenly distributed. Ensure that the mixture is fully wrapped tightly around the skewers without any exposed metal. Alternatively, lay them on a large baking tray lined with parchment paper if cooking in the oven, or foil if cooking under the grill. Shape into 20cm-long köfte. Wet your fingers with a little cold water and make indents all along the köfte for the traditional shape. | step 3 | Gently brush each köfte with the remaining 1 tbsp oil and cook under the grill, on the top shelf for 10-12 mins, turning regularly, or cook in the oven for 16-18 mins, until crispy on the outside and juicy in the middle

ingredients: 1 tablespoon Olive Oil, 1 lb Ground Pork, 1 clove peeled crushed Garlic, 1 tablespoon Ginger, 1 medium Carrots, 3 chopped Scallions, 3 Cups Cabbage, 1 tablespoon Soy Sauce, 1 tablespoon Rice Vinegar, 12 Egg Roll Wrappers, For brushing Oil, To serve Duck Sauce, To serve Plum Sauce, To serve Soy Sauce
instructions: Alternative Pan Fry Method: If you don’t have access to an air fryer, you can make these egg rolls using a traditional pan fry method. Add enough oil to a medium skillet with high walls so the oil is about 1/2 inch up the side of the skillet. Heat oil on medium high heat until it reaches 350°F. Add egg rolls and fry for 3 to 4 minutes, flip, and fry for another 3 to 4 minutes until golden brown. Remove and let them drain and cool on a few paper towels. | Cook the filling: | In a large skillet over medium heat, add the olive oil along with the ground pork or chicken. Break apart the meat with a spatula or wooden spoon as it cooks. Cook until the meat is cooked through, 6 to 8 minutes. | Add garlic, ginger, carrot, scallions, and cabbage. Continue to cook until cabbage wilts down and is soft, another 3 to 4 minutes, stirring regularly. Season the filling with soy sauce and rice wine vinegar, and take off the heat to cool. (This filling can be made in advance.) | Assemble the egg rolls: | Place a single egg roll wrapper on a dry surface with one point of the square facing you (like a diamond). Place about 1/4 cup of the egg roll filling mixture in the middle of the wrapper. | Dip your fingers in water and run around the edges of the wrapper. Then fold the edges of the wrapper over the center and start rolling the egg roll away from you to form a tight cylinder. Place on a plate and repeat until you are out of filling. You should get at least a dozen egg rolls. | Air fry the egg rolls: | Place the egg rolls in the basket of your air fryer. Spray or brush them lightly with oil. Add as many as you can without stacking the egg rolls, making sure they don’t touch. Air needs to circulate around them. Brush the egg rolls lightly with oil. | Place the basket in the air fryer and turn the air fryer to 350°F. Cook for 6 to 7 minutes, then flip the egg rolls, spray or brush with oil a second time on the bottom side, and cook for another 4 to 5 minutes. | Finished egg rolls should be golden brown and crispy! Serve immediately.

ingredients: 900g Potatoes, 3  tablespoons Olive Oil, 1 chopped Onion, 1 clove peeled crushed Garlic, 1 tblsp Paprika, 1 tblsp Tomato Puree, 225g Tinned Tomatos, To serve Basil Leaves
instructions: step 1 | Soak the potatoes in just-boiled water for 30 mins, then drain and leave to air-dry for 5 mins. Heat the air fryer to 200C. Tip the potatoes into a bowl and drizzle over 1 tbsp of the oil and add 1/2 tsp each of salt and freshly ground black pepper. Mix to coat the potatoes all over, then tip into the air fryer basket and cook for 20-30 mins until crisp and golden. | step 2 | Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a small pan over a medium-low heat and fry the onion for 8-10 mins until softened but not golden. Stir in the garlic and cook for a minute before adding the paprika and cooking for 30 seconds more. Stir in the tomato purée, cook for 1 min, then tip in the chopped tomatoes. Cook for 5-10 mins over a medium heat until thickened slightly. | step 3 | Once the potatoes are cooked, tip out onto a platter and pour over the tomato sauce. Sprinkle with the basil leaves, then serve.

ingredients: 150g White bread, 200g Almonds, 50 ml Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 1 Garlic Clove, 1 ½ tbsp Red Wine Vinegar
instructions: step 1 | Tip the bread into a bowl and pour over 350ml water. Leave to soak for 10 mins. | step 2 | Blend the ingredients together with 350ml water and 1 tsp salt. | step 3 | Let the soup cool in the fridge for 1 hr or so, then serve with a drizzle of oil and some black pepper.

ingredients: 300g All purpose flour, 200g Cornstarch, 200g Butter, 100g Sugar, 2 Egg Yolks, 1 teaspoon Lemon Zest, Dulce de leche, Sprinkling Desiccated Coconut
instructions: Make the Dough: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks and lemon zest. Gradually mix in flour and cornstarch to form a dough. Chill for 1 hour. | Bake the Cookies: Roll out the dough, cut into circles, and bake at 180°C (350°F) for 12-15 minutes. Let cool. | Assemble: Spread dulce de leche on one cookie, then sandwich with another. Roll the edges in coconut flakes. | Pro Tips: | Chill the dough before rolling it out to make it easier to handle and to prevent the cookies from spreading too much while baking. | Dip the alfajores in melted chocolate and let them set on a wire rack for an extra decadent treat.

recipe_name: Algerian Bouzgene Berber Bread with Roasted Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 2 Red Pepper, 4 Tomato, 1 tablespoon Olive Oil, 4 Cloves Chopped Garlic, 1 chopped Jalapeno, To taste Salt, 2 Lbs Semolina, 1 1/2 tsp Salt, 3 Cups Water, 4 tablespoons Olive Oil, 6 tablespoons Olive Oil
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Place red bell peppers and tomatoes on a baking sheet, and roast under the broiler for about 8 minutes, turning occasionally. This should blacken the skin and help it peel off more easily. Cool, then scrape the skins off of the tomatoes and peppers, and place them in a large bowl. Remove cores and seeds from the bell peppers. | Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the jalapenos and garlic, and cook until tender, stirring frequently. Remove from heat, and transfer the garlic and jalapeno to the bowl with the tomatoes and red peppers. Using two sharp steak knives (one in each hand), cut up the tomatoes and peppers to a coarse and soupy consistency. Stir, and set sauce aside. | Place the semolina in a large bowl, and stir in salt and 4 tablespoons of olive oil. Gradually add water while mixing and squeezing with your hand until the dough holds together without being sticky or dry, and molds easily with the hand. Divide into 6 pieces and form into balls. | For each round, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large heavy skillet over medium heat. Roll out dough one round at a time, to no thicker than 1/4 inch. Fry in the hot skillet until dark brown spots appear on the surface, and they are crispy. Remove from the skillet, and wrap in a clean towel while preparing the remaining flat breads. | To eat the bread and sauce, break off pieces of the bread, and scoop them into the sauce. It will slide off, but just keep reaching in!

ingredients: 1 1/2 cup Water, 2 Lbs Carrots, 5 tablespoons Olive Oil, 1 tsp Salt, 1/2 teaspoon Black Pepper, 1/2 teaspoon Ground Cinnamon, 1/2 teaspoon Ground Cumin, 3 Cloves Crushed Garlic, 1/2 teaspoon Thyme, 1 Bay Leaf, 1 tsp Lemon Juice
instructions: Place a steamer insert into a saucepan, and fill with 1 1/2 cups of water, or just below the bottom of the steamer. Cover, and bring the water to a boil over high heat. Add the sliced carrots, reduce the heat to medium, and cover the pan again. Steam until tender but not mushy, 4 to 6 minutes depending on the thickness of the slices. Reserve 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid. | Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the salt, pepper, cinnamon, cumin, garlic, and thyme. Cook the spices and garlic, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 10 minutes. Add the 1/2 cup reserved cooking liquid and the bay leaf, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes. | Stir in the carrots, tossing well to coat with the spice mixture, and cook until heated through, about 2 to 3 minutes. Sprinkle with lemon juice and remove the bay leaf before serving.

ingredients: 3 Green Pepper, 1 tablespoon Olive Oil, 1 tablespoon chopped Red Onions, 1 clove peeled crushed Garlic, To taste Salt, To taste Pepper, 1 Diced Plum Tomatoes
instructions: Preheat an oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Place the whole peppers on aluminum foil. Bake until the skin is spotted black and the peppers are soft, 30 to 45 minutes, turning the peppers once if necessary. | Remove peppers from the oven and set aside to cool for 10 minutes. Peel off the skin and remove the stem and seeds. Chop the roasted peppers into half-inch pieces. | Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
